For guardians struggling with ‘house wolves’ that destroy family happiness by biting, tearing, tasting, and enjoying(?) them, ‘dog expert’ Dog President Kang Hyung-wook and ‘human expert’ National MC Kim Sung-joo have teamed up! A ‘Dog Life X Life Improvement Project’ that closely observes and analyzes the daily lives of pet families, providing customized solutions for both the dog and the owner! Is your dog a dog or a wolf? Are you a guardian or an owner to your dog?

A time to confront and ponder the problems between you and your dog, and to find the true root cause of the issues. Hyper-realistic, close-up observation and behavioral correction solutions viewed from a ‘dog’s’ perspective and heard from a ‘human’ standpoint. A wolf escape project for problem dogs: ‘Time Between Dog and Wolf.’

fields.title: Personal taste
fields.description: It is a trendy drama depicting the bold, honest, and candid cohabitation diary of a cheeky fake gay man and a quirky, dating-challenged woman. The work features episodes of a man who suddenly becomes gay in order to become the roommate of a woman who wants to date a gay boyfriend.

fields.title: Jiyoung, the individualist
fields.description: A comedic romantic psychological drama about a woman who lived as a complete individualist, cutting off all ties with others, meeting a dependent man who cannot live without relationships; together, they heal each other and straighten their skewed lives. A healing romance for today's generation, who have blocked even the opportunity to be happy themselves in order to avoid becoming unhappy or getting hurt!

fields.title: Gae-maeul Cha Cha Cha
fields.description: A heartwarming, back-and-forth romance unfolds between realistic dentist Yoon Hye-jin and all-around unemployed Hong Ban-jang in Gongjin, a seaside village filled with the scent of human warmth and hardship. A dentist who gave up big-city life opens a clinic in a seaside town. In this incredibly close-knit community, she meets an all-around unemployed hero. He is the polar opposite of her in every way, yet he is surprisingly charming?

fields.title: The Lie of Lies
fields.description: A suspense melodrama about a woman who starts a life-altering lie to get her biological daughter back.

fields.title: Unstoppable High Kick
fields.description: A sitcom that comically depicts the daily life of a family living together across three generations.

fields.title: Mr. Gunbbang and Star Candy
fields.description: In a sense, aren't school troublemakers, including the Iljinhoe, a scream screaming with their whole bodies, declaring how much our society and our families are hurting and how sick they are? Here is a woman who was ostracized from school early on for problematic behavior during her high school years, endured all the harsh storms of life, and finally returned to her alma mater as a teacher. Through her problematic approach (education) toward these troublemakers, I intend to warmly embrace the wounds of our schools, families, and society.

fields.title: Introduction to Architecture
fields.description: At twenty, Seung-min, a vibrant yet shy architecture student, falls for Seo-yeon, a music student he meets for the first time in an Introduction to Architecture class. As they work on assignments together, they gradually open up and become close; however, the innocent Seung-min, clumsy at expressing his feelings, keeps his unspoken confession bottled up inside. Due to a small misunderstanding, they drift apart. Now a thirty-five-year-old architect, Seo-yeon suddenly reappears before Seung-min after fifteen years. Unable to hide his bewilderment, Seung-min is asked by Seo-yeon to design a house for her. As Seung-min builds Seo-yeon's house as his first project under his own name, memories of their past—which might have been love—resurface as they complete the home together, and new feelings begin to develop between the two...

fields.title: Lawless Lawyer
fields.description: Every contact leaves a trace! In crime, and in life. Thus, there is no such thing as a perfect crime. However, their collaboration is perfect. A very special partnership unfolds between an eccentric forensic pathologist who performs autopsies on victims and a rookie prosecutor who investigates perpetrators. This drama depicts the joint investigation of Baek Beom, a perfectionist and eccentric forensic pathologist, and Eun Sol, a prosecutor with photographic memory but full of clumsy charm.

fields.title: Prosecutor Princess
fields.description: A spoiled woman from a privileged background. She passes the bar exam on her first try and easily becomes a prosecutor, but soon realizes that there is much to learn as a rookie prosecutor.

fields.title: The Prosecutor's Outlaw
fields.description: Byun Jae-wook is a hot-tempered prosecutor famous for his rough investigative methods. He is arrested on murder charges after a suspect he was interrogating is found dead. Trapped in a murder he cannot escape, Byun Jae-wook is eventually sentenced to 15 years in prison. While incarcerated, Jae-wook plots his revenge. Five years later, he coincidentally encounters Chi-won, a handsome, bluffing con artist who knows about the case that framed him, and instantly senses that Chi-won is the perfect agent to execute his operations from outside of prison. Mobilizing all his prosecutorial expertise, Jae-wook secures Chi-won's release without charges and prepares for a counterattack. However, now free, Chi-won is constantly on the lookout for an opportunity to escape from Jae-wook…

fields.title: Please enter a search term WWW
fields.description: From teenagers to those in their sixties, there is no one who hasn't searched online. There is no one who doesn't access a search portal. And here are three women, bound together by a burning desire for success, who are willing to sacrifice themselves to outdo each other. There is Bae Ta-mi, a professional troublemaker who turns the tables with her blunt remarks. There is Cha Hyun, a convicted violent offender with anger management issues. And there is Song Ga-kyung, an innocent yet cold beauty who holds no mercy in the face of success. For these three women who want to make it big, there is no such thing as a trigger for their ambition. They say: "Why do you need a reason to succeed?" Three women with clear and distinct values. No one is wrong; they are just very different. A real romance between women working confidently at a trend-leading portal site and the men who stir their hearts.

fields.title: Black Priests
fields.description: Seoul, 2015. A young girl suffers from mysterious symptoms following a hit-and-run accident. Father Kim, ostracized by the church for his frequent erratic behavior, devises his own plan to save the girl amidst opposition and suspicion. To accomplish this, he requires another priest who meets all the necessary qualifications; while everyone else avoids the role, seminarian Deacon Choi is chosen and given the mission to assist Father Kim while simultaneously keeping him under surveillance. Finally, with only one day left to save the girl, Father Kim and Deacon Choi begin a dangerous ritual that could cost them all their lives…

fields.title: Black Sun
fields.description: A thriller that began airing on MBC in July 2021. He is a man like a sharp blade, known as the National Intelligence Service's top field agent. An unexpected accident befalls him, a man who has staked everything solely on the organization and his mission. Through this incident, he witnesses the dark underbelly of the intelligence agency that he was previously unaware of, and begins to question everything from the very beginning. This drama tells the story of a man called the NIS's best agent who sets out to find the internal traitor who brought him down, ultimately confronting a massive monster lurking behind the organization. It is a record depicting the process of him facing the deep darkness residing within himself in order to achieve this goal.

fields.title: Winter Sonata
fields.description: Jun-sang and Yu-jin were each other's first love during their high school years. However, after Jun-sang dies in an accident, Yu-jin becomes engaged to Sang-hyuk, Jun-sang's former rival, ten years later. Suddenly, Min-hyung, who looks exactly like Jun-sang, appears.

fields.title: Marriage contract
fields.description: A classic melodrama about a man who believes the only value in life is money and a woman standing on the brink of despair who meet in a dramatic relationship and discover the true meaning of love.

fields.title: Marriage White Paper
fields.description: Isn't a proposal the happy ending of a romance? However, for this couple, the proposal was not the end, but the beginning. It was the prelude to the arduous war of wedding preparations.

fields.title: Goddess of Marriage
fields.description: A drama that portrays the true meaning and preciousness of marriage in our time through the love and conflicts of protagonists with different beliefs, values, and worldviews.

fields.title: Marriage Lyrics, Divorce Composition
fields.description: A story about the unimaginable misfortunes that befall three attractive, successful female protagonists in their 30s, 40s, and 50s, and a drama dealing with the disharmony of couples searching for true love.

fields.title: Number of cases
fields.description: A realistic youth romance about a woman and a man who have been harboring unrequited love for 10 years. Woo-yeon is clueless about romance, engaging only in superficial relationships without any genuine feelings. On their long-awaited 100-day anniversary, Woo-yeon is dumped by her boyfriend and is reminded of her curse. A curse that prevents her from loving anyone, except for that one person, Lee-soo. What happened to Woo-yeon, to her first love, 10 years ago?

fields.title: the uncanny counter
fields.description: Centered around the master-like kitchen lady Chu Mae-ok, kitchen assistant Ga Mo-tak with a gangster aura and deep knife scars, cynical waitress Do Ha-na who insists side dishes are self-service, and high school part-timer So-mun. These four people, who run a noodle shop where they work perfectly together with just a glance without speaking, actually work as superheroes. They were reborn as demon hunters after crossing the River of Death. Saving lives and capturing evil spirits—these warm-hearted neighbors—the Counters' exhilarating demon hunt begins.

fields.title: Police class
fields.description: A chaotic campus story about a detective who puts his whole body into catching criminals and a former hacker-turned-criminal student who solves everything with his sharp mind, meeting as professor and student at the Police University to conduct a joint investigation.

fields.title: Tale of Gyeryong Fairy
fields.description: What if that suspicious old barista grandmother in the remote mountains is actually the very fairy from "The Fairy and the Woodcutter"...? There is an old woman at the foot of Mt. Gyeryong who habitually engages in riddles and Zen-like dialogues, but it turns out she is a barista who brews amazing coffee and, moreover, a fairy who has been waiting for the reincarnation of her husband—who suddenly passed away without revealing where his winged robes are—for 699 years. Starting from the folktale of "The Fairy and the Woodcutter" that we all know, this story gently flies into our daily lives rather than remaining a legend as she meets two real-life potential husbands.

fields.title: Gye Baek
fields.description: It is a fusion historical drama that sheds new light on King Uija, the 31st and last king of Baekje, and General Gyebaek.

fields.title: High School King of Savvy
fields.description: A romantic comedy drama depicting the episodes that unfold when an immature high school student joins a large corporation as an executive.

fields.title: Confession Couple
fields.description: A war-like, real-life-changing drama about a couple who regret their marriage. Everyone has a moment in their life when they wish they could return to the moment they regret the most. Here is exactly that story for a couple of the same age who are practically at each other's throats. Blinded by love, they tied the knot at the tender age of twenty-four, a bond stronger than blood. Now, the romantic life of their twenties unfolds before this couple, who live regretting their immature days! The war-like, real-life-changing project of this arch-rival couple begins. However, there is one thing they are overlooking: the choice they made at that moment of regret might actually have been the best choice for them at that very moment. Even if they were to go back, would they be able to make a different choice? Would they cast aside all the medal-like memories of the 18 years they have lived together since that choice...?

fields.title: Ghost Doctor
fields.description: A medical story about two doctors with polar opposite backgrounds and skills—an arrogant genius doctor with god-like medical skills and a golden-spoon resident with not a shred of duty—who share a body.

fields.title: High-class unrequited love
fields.description: The Midas touch that turns every rookie he mentors into a top star! An unpredictable romantic comedy unfolds as Sehun, a next-generation arrogant CEO, struggles to cast Iryeong, a pure mountain maiden he meets by chance.

fields.title: Van Gogh's Starry Night
fields.description: A multiple-choice office romance about Goho, a 29-year-old advertising professional who wants to have both a career and a love life, and five boyfriend candidates.

fields.title: Gokseong
fields.description: The village is turned upside down by a series of mysterious incidents that occur after a strange outsider appears. The police tentatively conclude that the events are caused by mass wild mushroom poisoning, but rumors and suspicions that the outsider is the cause of all the incidents spread uncontrollably. Detective Jong-gu begins to believe the rumors about the outsider after meeting Mu-myeong, a woman who claims to have witnessed the scene. Becoming desperate when his daughter Hyo-jin starts falling ill with symptoms similar to those of the victims, Jong-gu goes on a rampage in search of the outsider and calls in a shaman named Il-gwang...

fields.title: Peacock City
fields.description: A mystery psychological thriller drama set against the backdrop of the art museum of the Seongjin Group, which holds sway over South Korea's political and business world, capturing the fierce desire to reach the top.

fields.title: Cooperation
fields.description: Desperate to recover the copper plate, North Korea requests the first-ever inter-Korean joint investigation to capture Cha Gi-seong, the leader of an organization that has infiltrated the South, and dispatches Cheol-ryeong to Seoul as the right person for the job. Meanwhile, suspicious of North Korea's true intentions, South Korea plans an operation to capture Cha Gi-seong first and orders Kang Jin-tae, a struggling detective currently suspended, to closely monitor Cheol-ryeong under the guise of a joint investigation. Cheol-ryeong must complete his mission, while Jin-tae must prevent it. With only three days to spare, the unpredictable joint investigation of these two detectives—who are incapable of being a team—begins...

fields.title: The Princess's Man
fields.description: The love story of Yi Se-ryeong and Kim Seung-yu, the two children of political arch-rivals Grand Prince Suyang and Kim Jong-seo

fields.title: On the way to the airport
fields.description: A second adolescence is coming to life. In the middle of life, having reached the halfway point yet wavering in the thirties—amidst the ups and downs of life crashing in like waves—what we need is simply a small word. A momentary lean. Anything at all. And the one person who offers it without hesitation. We need this person right now, and we desperately crave the ‘comfort’ they offer. So, we strive. Enough to make the onlookers want to cheer us on. The warmest comfort in the world, the most heartfelt love is coming!

fields.title: It's Okay, It's Love
fields.description: A work set in a psychiatric clinic that depicts the lives and loves of modern people burdened with mental illness.

fields.title: monster
fields.description: The story of two men who break the law and principles to catch a serial killer. An elite police inspector appears before a crazy detective. Completely different from each other, the two become unwanted partners, displaying perfect discord at every turn…

fields.title: monster
fields.description: While taking a long nap at the riverside snack bar run by his father, Gang-du accidentally witnesses a peculiar sight. Something he has never seen before is hanging from the Han River bridge and moving. The unidentified monster climbs onto the riverbank, ruthlessly trampling people and biting them indiscriminately. The banks of the Han River instantly turn into a scene of utter chaos. Gang-du belatedly flees in a panic with his daughter, Hyun-seo, but ends up losing his grip on her hand. Gang-du's family loses everything overnight—their home, their livelihood, and Hyun-seo. With no money and no connections, they set out to find Hyun-seo, who is likely somewhere along the Han River, which has been declared a danger zone.

fields.title: sightseeing
fields.description: Goo Kyung-yi, an insurance investigator and former police officer. Having lived in isolation from the outside world, she steps out to chase a serial killer. Cases perfectly disguised as accidents. The killer is among us!

fields.title: Love in the Moonlight
fields.description: The Crown Prince of a nation falls in love with a eunuch! An unpredictable palace disguise romance between the tsundere Crown Prince Lee Young and Hong Ra-on, a eunuch disguised as a man. Hong Ra-on, a heart expert who gives paid dating advice in Unjong-ga! Ra-on goes to meet the recipient of the love letter in place of Jeong Do-ryeong, but the person who appears before her is not a pretty young woman, but a tall and handsome man. What they hand to Ra-on—who is dressed in men's clothes but is actually a woman—is none other than a eunuch contract...!

fields.title: Tale of the Nine-Tailed
fields.description: In 1999, Jia, a 9-year-old girl, lost her parents in a bizarre traffic accident at Yeougoe. Twenty-one years later, at the age of 30, Jia is working as a producer for the investigative news program "In Search of Urban Legends," which uncovers the world's hidden mysteries. However, one day, a tip comes into Jia's office regarding a suspicious 'monster'...

fields.title: Ex-Girlfriend Club
fields.description: An older divorcee, a high-spec but clumsy woman, a third-rate sexy actress—that guy who can do it all but me, Bang Myung-soo! A scandalous showdown begins as the public enemy and public boyfriend, who exposed all his past love affairs to the world through a trending webtoon, gathers in one place with his four women.

fields.title: Save Me
fields.description: It portrays how ordinary people filled with anxiety and fear fall into the clutches of cults and scammers who use religion as a pretext, prompting reflection on what is real and what is fake. It is the solitary salvation story of a crazy, rebellious outcast who struggles to recognize the vain beliefs that everyone else holds as truth.

fields.title: Fellow citizens!
fields.description: A comedic crime drama about a con artist who unexpectedly marries a police officer, gets entangled in unwanted incidents, and runs for National Assembly. Rather than the "sympathy-based" healing that shares the pain of the "underdogs" living in the same era as us, this drama aims for a "fighting fire with fire" style of healing that helps viewers overcome their sense of loss, at least while watching, by delivering a satisfying blow to the "powerful" who hurt us. Therefore, I want to speak to the "underdogs" who are marginalized despite upholding the law and principles: we have the right to live in a better world, and we have the duty to create a better world.

fields.title: Military Prosecutor Doberman
fields.description: A man who became a military prosecutor for money and power. His plans are put on the brakes by the arrival of a new military prosecutor who joined the army for a different purpose.

fields.title: Monarch - Master of the Mask
fields.description: The Pyeonsuhoe, having amassed immense wealth and power by monopolizing the water resources of the Eight Provinces of Joseon. Now, there is no longer a king sent by Heaven to serve Joseon. Yet, a powerless Crown Prince attempts to fight against this massive behind-the-scenes organization. For the people, not for the throne rightfully deserving of wealth and power! The Crown Prince (Yoo Seung-ho), who visited Woo-bo to find out why he must live behind a mask, meets his first love Ga-eun (Kim So-hyun) and a friend named Yi-seon (Kim Myung-soo), and begins to uncover the true nature of the Yangsucheong and the Pyeonsuhoe... Meanwhile, Dae-mok (Heo Jun-ho) discovers that the Crown Prince has secretly slipped out of the Royal Ancestral Shrine without the King's knowledge...

fields.title: Battleship Island
fields.description: In 1945, during the Japanese colonial period, Kang Ok, the bandleader of the Bando Hotel in Gyeongseong (Seoul), and his only daughter So-hee; Chil-seong, a gangster who dominated the Jongno district; and Mal-nyeon, who has endured all kinds of hardships under Japanese rule—Koreans with diverse backstories—are lured to Gunhama Island by promises of making money in Japan. However, the ship they boarded arrived at Gunhama Island, a hellish island where Koreans were forcibly conscripted and exploited as laborers. On Gunhama Island, Koreans dragged there without knowing why are forced to labor in mines 1,000 meters below sea level, risking daily gas explosions. Kang Ok does everything in his power to appease the Japanese officials and protect at least his daughter So-hee, while Chil-seong and Mal-nyeon endure their agonizing days in their own ways. Meanwhile, as the war draws to a close, Moo-young, an OSS agent affiliated with the Korean Liberation Army, is ordered to infiltrate Gunhama Island to rescue key figures of the independence movement...

fields.title: Good Doctor
fields.description: A human medical drama capturing the efforts and love of specialists set against the backdrop of a university hospital's pediatric surgery department.

fields.title: Goodbye Wife
fields.description: A romantic comedy drama depicting the story that unfolds when a couple in their fifth year of marriage, who had a boisterous wedding, have their respective first loves reappear.

fields.title: Good job
fields.description: A work depicting the thrilling romantic detective investigation unfolding when chaebol detective Eun Sun-woo meets Don Sera, a busybody equipped with super-sightedness.

fields.title: Good Casting
fields.description: An action-comedy drama about middle-aged women, pushed out of the National Intelligence Service and barely holding onto their desk jobs, who are unexpectedly recruited as agents and sent undercover into the field. Chan-mi is an NIS agent demoted three years ago following a failed operation. She is assigned to a mission to catch an industrial spy, but the team members waiting for her are Ye-eun, who is new to the field, and Mi-soon, who suffers from arthritis. Will they be able to pull it off?

fields.title: palace
fields.description: Based on the popular manga *Goong*, this is the story of Chae-kyung, an ordinary high school girl who enters into a political marriage with Crown Prince Lee Shin, the heir to the throne, due to a promise made between their grandfathers.

fields.title: Whisper
fields.description: Set against the backdrop of the law firm ‘Taebaek,’ this is the story of a man and a woman who evolve from enemies to allies and eventually lovers, delivering satisfying retribution against legal corruption through a love that risks their lives.

fields.title: That Winter, the Wind Blows
fields.description: This is a story about a man living a meaningless life after being abandoned by his parents in childhood and failing in his first love, and a woman living a lonely and weary life due to her parents' divorce, separation from her older brother, and sudden onset of visual impairment, as they meet and find hope and the true meaning of love in their cold and lonely lives.

fields.title: The Man's Memory Method
fields.description: A romantic human melodrama telling the story of a man who remembers every single one of the 8,760 hours of the 365 days of the year due to hyperthymesia, and a woman who has forgotten the important moments of her life—two people with the same wounds who meet by fate and fall in love. HBN News Live anchor Lee Jung-hoon. Rising star actor Yeo Ha-jin. The encounter between these two completely different people begins! Ha-jin is invited to News Live to promote a movie. Unpredictable! Due to her impulsive behavior, Jung-hoon finds himself in an awkward situation...

fields.title: That year we
fields.description: A first love reverse romance unfolds as a separated couple is forcibly brought back into the spotlight due to the sudden popularity of a documentary filmed during their high school days.

fields.title: The lilac I left behind there
That man, Oh Soo
fields.description: A sure-fire "almost-relationship" romance unknown only to the two of them: Oh Soo, a modern-day Cupid with no romantic instincts, and Yuri, a woman clueless about love. An MIT-educated genius Ph.D., a successful venture capitalist—all these descriptions apply to Oh Soo (Lee Jong-hyun). However, he harbors a secret: his family has a generational tradition of reading people's emotions and altering them with pollen! Having agreed to look after the cafe in his grandfather's place, Oh Soo prescribes pollen suited to the mood of a man who ordered coffee. He gazes at their table with a pleased smile, but then a single sentence comes from the mouth of the man who was clearly shouting "I love you" just moments ago: "Let's break up." What? Surely not because of the pollen I gave him? This is ridiculous!

fields.title: Just in love
fields.description: A drama depicting the process of two men and women, who dramatically survived a life-altering accident in their childhood, comforting each other's wounds. It portrays the story of warm love shared by seemingly insignificant people who are all the greater because they steadfastly endure and persevere through the harsh winds of daily life.

fields.title: She loves lies too much
fields.description: A music romance drama depicting a refreshing romance that evokes pure love between Kang Han-gyeol, a genius composer hiding his true identity, and Yoon So-rim, a high school girl with a vitamin-like voice who falls for him at first sight. “First love”—a phrase that makes your whole body tingle just by hearing it. It is the audacious affection a nineteen-year-old girl has for a twenty-four-year-old man, as well as a passionate “dream” to which one would dedicate their entire life without regret. It is a path that exists in everyone’s heart and is inevitable to pass through in life; a first love that everyone feels shy yet longs for, and that everyone feels painful yet tender. I ask you to join me in cheering for this first love.

fields.title: She was pretty.
fields.description: A witty, sweet, and thrilling romantic comedy about four individuals as Hyejin, who transformed from an icon of first love into a 'loser,' and Sungjun, who transformed from a chubby loser into a 'perfect man,' are joined by Hyejin's best friend Hari and a mysterious colleague Shinhyuk in their search for their first love.

fields.title: Find her
fields.description: The story of Jan, a Dutchman who flew 8,000 km to find the woman he fell in love with at first sight, and the events that unfold as he meets various Koreans in Itaewon.

fields.title: Her bucket list
fields.description: ‘Chara-ri,’ who is fulfilling a bucket list to die, and ‘Kang Han-sol,’ who wants to overcome stage fright—a precarious contractual relationship between two people that begins while hiding each other’s secrets.

fields.title: Her private life
fields.description: This drama depicts a full-fledged fan-girl romance that unfolds when Sung Deok-mi, a highly capable curator at an art museum who is secretly an idol fan, meets her prickly boss, Ryan. Making a flowery path for your bias and unconditionally supporting every choice they make! Whether they pursue their dreams or give them up, the fan will always be by their side. And eventually, once you become a fan of someone, you will realize that fan-girling is just another name for love. Love, like a fan!

fields.title: He's just like the other guy.
fields.description: A thrilling fantasy romantic comedy about a woman who became a "non-marriage advocate" because "all guys are the same," only to receive straightforward romantic advances from two men with contrasting charms one day.

fields.title: So I married an anti-fan
fields.description: A bickering, antagonistic romance unfolds as global K-pop star Hujun and Lee Geun-young, a magazine reporter branded as his official anti-fan, film a 24-hour close-up reality program.

fields.title: grid
fields.description: Earth, having survived solar storms under the protection of the Grid, a global defense shield. Grid Administration employee Kim Sae-ha encounters a murderer, while Detective Jung Sae-byeok witnesses an astonishing phenomenon while pursuing the killer. The Ghost, the creator of the Grid, has reappeared after 24 years. But why is the Ghost helping the murderer? A chase thriller uncovering the truth behind the mysterious entity that saved humanity from crisis.

fields.title: Green Rose
fields.description: A thrilling revenge drama in which a man, after falling victim to a conspiracy at the peak of his life and being framed as a murderer and fugitive, returns to Korea after many twists and turns to exact vengeance on those who drove his mother to her death and made him the enemy of his beloved.

fields.title: Extreme Job
fields.description: Despite working tirelessly day and night, the Narcotics Squad has hit rock bottom and faces the threat of disbandment! With nowhere left to retreat, Chief Go, the team's senior member, detects signs of an international criminal organization smuggling drugs into the country and sets out on an undercover operation with four team members: Detective Jang, Detective Ma, Young-ho, and Jae-hoon. To maintain 24-hour surveillance, the squad takes over a chicken restaurant in front of the criminal organization's hideout and opens it as a front business. Thanks to Detective Ma's hidden talent—a surprisingly exceptional sense of taste—the chicken shop quickly gains a reputation as a gourmet hotspot. With the investigation taking a backseat and the squad frantically busy with the chicken business, a golden opportunity presents itself one day…

fields.title: King Geunchogo
fields.description: This work depicts the story of King Geunchogo, who brought about the golden age of Baekje. It is an epic drama adapted from novelist Lee Mun-yeol's novel *The Sorrow of the Continent*, portraying the turbulent life of the legendary 13th King Geunchogo of Baekje.

fields.title: Come out, gold, presto!
fields.description: A family drama that seeks to find the meaning of marriage and family while satirically portraying the pretense and reality of the middle class

fields.title: silver spoon
fields.description: A parent-changing adventure fantasy about a child born into a poor family who swaps destinies with a friend born into a rich family through a golden spoon obtained by chance, becoming an acquired golden spoon.

fields.title: I am in my nature to be positive.
fields.description: Support for their graduation film production has been confirmed! But numerous obstacles lie ahead! Will their film and love be able to come to fruition?

fields.title: Greasy Melo
fields.description:
This is a romantic comedy kitchen action drama that deeply stimulates your salivary glands with the intense love stories of three men and women, hotter than the boiling oil inside a scorching wok. Warning: 'Absolutely do not watch on an empty stomach.'

The main setting is the neighborhood Chinese restaurant, 'Hungry Wok.' Including the male and female leads, there isn't a single character in this drama who isn't working like crazy. There are no men pushing pens, nor are there women typing on keyboards in front of monitors. Meetings aren't proper unless profanity is exchanged. Woks—whether balls of fire or chunks of metal—fly through the air beyond broken plates, and knives fly around. In this battlefield-like place, the Jajangmyeon made with lives on the line is truly a delicacy of the world! It is a new concept 'kitchen action drama' about lives trying to survive within the 6-pyeong workplace known as a kitchen!!

fields.title: Meteorological Agency People: The Cruel History of Office Romance
fields.description: A workplace romance drama depicting the work and love lives of weather agency employees, hotter than a tropical night and more unpredictable than a localized downpour.

fields.title: Manager Kim
fields.description: An office comedy drama about Kim Seong-ryong, an accounting manager specializing in embezzlement with a natural knack for money, who desperately joins TQ Group for a bigger score, but ironically ends up fighting against corruption and injustice to save the collapsing company.

fields.title: What's Wrong with Secretary Kim?
fields.description: A push-and-pull romance between a narcissistic vice president who possesses everything—wealth, good looks, and business acumen—but is completely consumed by self-love, and his secretary who has perfectly assisted him, as she contemplates quitting. A handsome face, perfect proportions, a brilliant mind, and exceptional management skills! From birth until now, he has always been the undisputed number one in every field. He loves himself so much that he has never dated, and because he considers himself so superior, he cannot tolerate the shortcomings of those around him. The only person he allows by his side is his secretary, Kim Mi-so, with whom he boasts chemistry like a long-married couple. However, one day, Secretary Kim suddenly announces her resignation. "Why on earth? You're turning down the super-premium honor of serving me...?" Just... why would Secretary Kim do this?

fields.title: Kkondae Intern
fields.description: A comedic office drama depicting a man's satisfying revenge plot of a power reversal after being forced to work under the worst kind of condescending boss, as well as a senior intern's brutal struggle to survive in the workplace. Lee Man-sik, the ultimate bossy boss, and Ga Yeol-chan, the troublesome intern. Two completely different people have met. Yeol-chan, who visits a soup restaurant currently in a lawsuit with the company on Man-sik's orders, witnesses a shocking sight...

fields.title: Let's walk only on flower paths
fields.description: The Kkon-nip family is left without a biological son, and is now teeming with troublesome stepchildren. In this house live Kkon-nip, a generous mother-in-law who embraces anyone who enters as her own child, and Kang Yeo-won, a "national daughter-in-law" who has mastered the turbulent and peculiar life of a daughter-in-law. Although different from others, this family displays extraordinary family love and is maturing into a true family. The story of this family with many stories, along with a healing romance that offers comfort in life, begins now. Furthermore, through Bong Cheon-dong, a young man who forms a new bond with the Kkon-nip family through life-saving donations, we aim to reflect on the precious values of life that are often forgotten, such as generosity and grace.

fields.title: Boys Over Flowers
fields.description: A drama depicting the chaotic story of a girl from an ordinary working-class family who transfers to a high school filled with children of the wealthy and meets four handsome chaebol boys.

fields.title: Endless love
fields.description: A drama about the dreams, ambitions, and love of people living in the 1980s.

fields.title: Second to last love
fields.description: A bickering action romance between a woman who desperately wants something to happen and a man who desperately wants nothing to happen. A person who has made countless choices and knows how to take responsibility for them. An adult. However, an "unfinished child" lives within this "fully grown adult." Are we currently living the kind of adult we dreamed of as children? We became adults by chance, yet we worry more because we know so much, and our fears are greater because we have fallen countless times. A bittersweet story of adults for whom work takes precedence over love, children over oneself, health over dating, and old age over the present. A woman who has loved to death and experienced painful breakups, and a man who needed courage even to choose an ordinary life after losing love. May the love shared by these two not be the last love of their lives, but the "second-to-last love"... We aim to offer hope and comfort to a love that has not yet ended. A spirited youth drama for middle-aged people that is more childish than teenagers, more lively than those in their twenties, and hotter than those in their thirties! An anti-aging middle-aged romance begins between a man who insists on sticking to established principles and a woman who enjoys the unpredictable! It is a bickering, action-packed romance between a woman who desperately wants something to happen and a man who desperately wants nothing to happen. A person who has made countless choices and knows how to take responsibility for them. An adult. However, an "unfinished child" lives within this "fully grown adult." Are we currently living as the adults we dreamed of as children? We became adults by chance, yet we worry more because we know so much, and our fears are greater because we have fallen countless times. A bittersweet story of adults for whom work takes precedence over love, children over ourselves, health over dating, and old age over the present. A woman who has loved to death and experienced painful breakups, and a man who needed courage even to choose an ordinary life after losing love. May the love shared by these two not be the last love of their lives, but the "second-to-last love"... We aim to offer hope and comfort to a love that has not yet ended. A spirited youth drama for middle-aged people that is more childish than teenagers, more lively than those in their 20s, and hotter than those in their 30s! An anti-aging middle-aged romance between a man who insists only on established principles and a woman who enjoys the unpredictability! It begins.

fields.title: My All-Alone
fields.description: It depicts an imperfect romance where the more they love, the lonelier they become, as Soyeon, who suffers from prosopagnosia (face blindness), Holo, a warm-hearted and perfect AI assistant, and Nando, a prickly genius inventor who shares the same face but has a polar opposite personality, meet. By her side, who is always alone.

fields.title: I picked up a celebrity on the street
fields.description: It is a full-fledged comedy confinement romance that unfolds as Lee Yeon-seo, a single woman living day by day, picks up world star Kang Jun-hyuk on the street due to a chance incident.

fields.title: The Spy Who Loved Me
fields.description: A thrilling secret romantic comedy about a woman caught in an espionage war with two husbands full of secrets.

fields.title: Navillera
fields.description: A coming-of-age drama about Deok-cheol, who started ballet at the age of seventy, and Chae-rok, a twenty-three-year-old ballet dancer wandering in front of his dreams.

fields.title: My country
fields.description: Set against the backdrop of the late Goryeo and early Joseon periods, this action historical drama explosively portrays the desires for power and protection as characters point their swords at one another over their differing beliefs regarding "my country." In the late Goryeo era, amidst turbulent public sentiment and the nation's decline, the world felt too overwhelming to bear alone for Seo Hwi (Yang Se-jong), for whom protecting his sister—his only remaining family member—was his top priority. A chance encounter that comes to Hwi becomes the catalyst that allows him to harbor a dream for the first time. Hwi's lifelong friend, Seon-ho (Woo Do-hwan), also strives to seize the opportunity that comes his way to overcome the social status and family constraints that bind him. To them, the arrival of Hee-jae (Kim Seol-hyun) marks the starting point that signals the prelude to everything…

fields.title: My Mister
fields.description: A story about the process of healing through each other's lives between three middle-aged brothers who stoically endure the weight of life in their own ways and a woman in her twenties who has lived a rough and cold life.

fields.title: My Liberation Journal
fields.description: Three siblings living in a remote corner of Gyeonggi Province that is no different from the countryside, slightly behind even the ordinary. Exhausted by the monotonous daily routine that repeats itself since becoming adults, the three siblings reach the limit of their stifling frustration one day and set out to find special achievement and freedom within their endlessly ordinary lives. This is the unbearably lovable story of happiness revival by three unbearably rustic siblings who have decided to liberate themselves from their respective lives.

fields.title: Nine Room
fields.description: A death row inmate in her 60s and a lawyer in her 30s—the lives of two women have been swapped! During a consultation regarding a request for a retrial, a soul exchange occurs between the lawyer and the death row inmate. While this supernatural phenomenon may be a miracle from heaven for the death row inmate, Jang Hwa-sa, it is an absurd death sentence for the lawyer, Eulji Hae-yi. Will Hae-yi be able to reclaim her life? Or will Jang Hwa-sa permanently possess Hae-yi's body to exact revenge on those who framed her and turned her into a death row inmate, thereby revealing the truth? Eulji Hae-yi and Jang Hwa-sa. Who will be the ultimate winner between the two? The drama [Room No. 9] is a life-reset drama depicting the fierce survival game of two women whose lives have been turned upside down, as well as the special friendship and growth that blossoms within it.

fields.title: Melt me
fields.description: A man and a woman secretly participated in a 24-hour cryogenic freezing project. However, due to a mysterious conspiracy, they awaken 20 years later only to find themselves aged significantly overnight. While struggling to adapt to a world and people that have changed drastically—despite the destruction of hierarchy and common sense at both work and home—they discover a side effect of the cryogenic experiment... namely, that a rise in body temperature causes fatal physical abnormalities! And then, an unavoidable crisis befalls them... It is love!

fields.title: I'll visit if the weather is nice.
fields.description: Haewon, having quit her job teaching the cello, decides to stay for a while with her aunt, who runs the Walnut House Pension. Haewon is puzzled to see that the tiled-roof house where an elderly couple used to live has been transformed into a small bookstore called ‘Goodnight Bookstore.’ Meanwhile, Eunseop, who was at the rice paddy skating rink, pauses in surprise upon seeing Haewon peeking into his bookstore...

fields.title: boy friend
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of a woman who seems to have it all and an ordinary man who has nothing, exploring whether it is harder to give up wealth and fame or to surrender an ordinary life. Su-hyun, the CEO of Donghwa Hotel, is the daughter of a politician and a former daughter-in-law of a chaebol family who has never lived a free life. While visiting Cuba on business, she forcibly tries to sleep, even skipping dinner, but is drawn outside by a photograph of a sunset she happens to see. There, beneath a picturesque sunset, she coincidentally meets Jin-hyuk, a man with a free and pure soul...

fields.title: Namhansanseong
fields.description: 1636, the 14th year of King Injo's reign, the Second Manchu Invasion. As the massive Qing army launched an attack, the King and his court took refuge in Namhansanseong Fortress to escape the enemy. Completely surrounded by the Qing forces amidst cold, hunger, and absolute military inferiority, the opinions of the ministers were sharply divided. There was Choi Myeong-gil, the Minister of Personnel, who argued that they must endure momentary humiliation to protect the country and its people, and Kim Sang-heon, the Minister of Rites, who insisted that they must fight to the end against the humiliating Qing attack to uphold the greater cause. Caught between these two opposing views, King Injo's anguish deepened, while the Qing's unreasonable demands and pressure intensified...

fields.title: Romantic Doctor Kim Sa-bu
fields.description: At a humble stone-walled hospital in the countryside, there is Dr. Kim, an eccentric genius doctor who was once known as the "Hand of God" but now calls himself the "Romantic Doctor" and enjoys a secluded life. A passionate young doctor comes to visit him.

fields.title: Day and night
fields.description: A premeditated murder mystery that uncovers the secrets of a mysterious incident that occurred in a village 28 years ago, connected to current mysterious events.

fields.title: Terius behind me
fields.description: A suspicious, fantastic spy collaboration between a vanished legendary Black Agent and the woman next door who is thrown into an espionage war by fate.

fields.title: My Daughter, Geum Sa-wol
fields.description: A drama depicting the 25-year silent war and life-or-death showdown between a couple seeking to hide the truth and those seeking revenge.

fields.title: Can you hear my heart?
fields.description: It is a human drama depicting the beautiful love story of a man and woman overcoming acquired hearing loss.

fields.title: Springtime of my life
fields.description: A human melodrama about a woman living on borrowed time who receives a new heart through an organ transplant, and the husband of the woman who donated the heart, who meet and fall in love.

fields.title: My ID is Gangnam Beauty
fields.description: I was always teased about my appearance. Then, at twenty, I stepped onto the operating table for a new life. I became surprisingly beautiful, but all I gained was the nickname "Gangnam Beauty"—a plastic surgery monster. To make matters worse, a classmate who knew my past was in the same department. Was the college life I dreamed of just going to end as a dream? I thought a new face would open up a new life! I had plastic surgery to escape the ridicule of being ugly, but now, instead of being a natural beauty, I am mocked. Am I destined never to be ordinary? The story of a twenty-year-old escaping a trauma compounded by misfortunes regarding her looks begins now!

fields.title: My Girlfriend is a Gumiho
fields.description: A fantasy melodrama about Cha Dae-woong, a rich young man who is immature but kind, self-centered but has a soft side, who falls in love after accidentally meeting a Gumiho.

fields.title: My Name Is Kim Sam-soon
fields.description: A drama that lightheartedly portrays the life and love of Kim Sam-soon, a single woman in her 30s who lives confidently as a professional pastry chef despite having complexes about her old-fashioned name and chubby appearance.

fields.title: When I Was the Prettiest
fields.description: Brothers who wanted to protect a woman. And the heartbreaking love story of a woman trapped in fate, a path she cannot take, caught between them.

fields.title: Lie to me
fields.description: Her name is Gong Ah-jeong. She is very accomplished, but she has no intention of getting married. She thought she would be free forever because she remained unmarried, but one day, suddenly, it feels like a burden. She used to mock her friends who would grow old under the label of "ajumma" (middle-aged woman), but now she is anxious that she might end up becoming a human being worse than a mere ajumma. She studied like crazy, worked like crazy, and ran hard without complaining, yet she has been pushed to the lowest rank in all kinds of social benefits and is facing discrimination.

fields.title: My Lovely Girl
fields.description: A romantic love fantasy drama with a comedic sensibility set in the music industry, where wounded young men and women heal each other's scars and cultivate true love through music.

fields.title: Insiders
fields.description: A leading presidential candidate, a chaebol chairman, and the political thug Ahn Sang-gu who supports them. The mastermind behind this backroom deal is Lee Kang-hee, a renowned editorial chief who influences public opinion in South Korea. Desiring greater success, Ahn Sang-gu prepares to trade using their slush fund files but is caught, leaving him a broken man. Prosecutor Woo Jang-hoon, who always falters just when promotion is within his grasp, finally seizes the opportunity to become the lead in a massive slush fund investigation ahead of the presidential election. However, the investigation is terminated because Ahn Sang-gu intercepted the files, and Woo Jang-hoon ends up taking the blame and being demoted...

fields.title: Introverted Boss
fields.description: Eun Hwan-gi, the president of Korea's number one PR agency, is a mysterious man nicknamed the "Quiet Monster." This man always avoids eye contact and pretends to be indifferent and arrogant. It turns out, however, that he is actually very introverted! Then, a new employee named Chae Ro-woon appears before him. With her very lively and extroverted personality, and having started to gain recognition for her work, her attention is solely focused on Eun Hwan-gi! Her plan to expose his true nature begins.

fields.title: tomorrow
fields.description: A man who became half-human, half-soul after an accident. He is hired by an underworld company run by Grim Reapers and sets out to carry out a special mission. The Grim Reapers, who used to guide the dead, now save those who wish to die! An afterlife fantasy "Warm" made drama.

fields.title: Tomorrow with you
fields.description: Marin is a 31-year-old woman with no privileged background, a stable job, a hefty bank account, a house, a car, or even a man willing to let her show up empty-handed. She had long since cast aside the audacity to dream of a life-changing turnaround, along with her once-firm skin. Just as her life was evolving into a husk day by day, a miraculous event occurred. Sojun, a man beyond perfect. Even if Marin shamelessly mobilized every imagination she could muster, he was a man she could never have dared to dream of—or rather, a man she shouldn't even dream of—yet he fell for her and they ended up tying the knot! To think I had the fate of a Cinderella! Has there ever been another woman in the 5,000-year history of the Korean Peninsula who married this well? However, that joy was shattered into pieces less than a week after the wedding. They say a married couple is one in heart and mind, yet her husband was hiding far too many secrets from her. The more she learned, the deeper she dug, the more his true identity became a mystery...

fields.title: I wish the world would end tomorrow.
fields.description: Their nationalities are all different. Their personalities are all distinct. This is an international dormitory at a Korean university where foreign students gather. Here, they build friendships, get excited by love, and learn about the world. Though, for the most part, it's a total mess and a jumble.

fields.title: Sunny tomorrow too
fields.description: A drama depicting the life reset story of a protagonist from a disadvantaged background with no qualifications who overcomes setbacks to achieve the eighth, along with the heartwarming stories of his surrounding family.

fields.title: Tomorrow Cantabile
fields.description: A pinnacle classic healing music drama where young people, united by the medium of music, weave together youth, music, passion, and love in their own unique ways.

fields.title: Queen of Housewives
fields.description: This is the story of a housewife who married a Seoul National University graduate dreaming of being Cinderella, but whose dreams were shattered by an incompetent man unable to adapt to corporate life, and who now seeks to re-achieve them by supporting her husband.

fields.title: The Girl Who Sees Smells
fields.description: A drama telling the story of an emotionless man who lost his younger sister in the ‘Barcode Murder Case’ three years ago, and a woman with extrasensory perception who miraculously survived the same accident but lost all her previous memories.

fields.title: You Are My Spring
fields.description: A story that begins when people living under the name of 'adults,' each harboring their own seven-year-old selves in their hearts, come to live together in a building where a murder occurred.

fields.title: Are you human too?
fields.description: In a world where you want to ask, "Are you human?", a nationwide human impersonation project unfolded by Namshin III, an AI robot more human than humans, and the passionate bodyguard Kang So-bong.

fields.title: I remember you
fields.description: A sweet yet thrilling investigative romance unfolds between Lee Hyun, a perfect genius profiler who is all the more attractive because of his danger, and Cha Ji-an, a passionate elite investigator from the Police Academy who has been observing him.

fields.title: A person who resembles you
fields.description: A woman who has become a successful painter and lives an enviable life. And a woman who lost the radiant light of her life due to her encounter with that woman. The moment these two women meet again, everything begins to twist.

fields.title: The time I loved you
fields.description: A drama depicting the growing pains experienced by a man and a woman who have maintained a long-standing friendship as they turn thirty. Hana finds everything going awry when her model disappears just before a shoe launch. On top of that, her boyfriend delivers the shocking news that he is getting married soon, and Hana feels as though Won is the root cause of all her relationship troubles. Won, who has been silently listening to Hana's grievances, feels frustrated because of circumstances he cannot share with her...

fields.title: How to Hate You
fields.description: Miri's Struggle to Win Back Her Best Friend's Boyfriend

fields.title: The speed to get to you is 493 km/h
fields.description: Fresh-faced twenty-five-year-olds, Park Tae-yang, for whom sports is everything, and Park Tae-jun, for whom sports is his profession, engage in a hot sports romance on a professional badminton team.

fields.title: You and Me Police Class
fields.description: Young people who proudly entered the Police University with the dream of becoming police officers—their joy at becoming college students is short-lived. Amidst unimaginable training and strict rules, every day feels like hell, yet these youths feel they have nothing to fear as long as they are by their side. Meanwhile, Seung-hyun, the top-ranking incoming student bearing everyone's expectations, and Eun-kang, a late admission student brimming with a straightforward instinct, clash at every turn, finding themselves at the center of incidents and accidents at the Police University, where they uncover clues to the hidden truth…

fields.title: Your Wedding
fields.description: In the summer of his senior year of high school, Woo-yeon fell in love at first sight with Seung-hee, a transfer student. After relentlessly pursuing her, just as they were about to become an official couple, Seung-hee vanished, leaving behind only a single phone call wishing them well. It seemed as though Woo-yeon's first love had come to an end. A year later, Woo-yeon had successfully gained admission to the same university through persistent effort and tracking down traces of Seung-hee. However, standing in his way was… none other than her boyfriend!

fields.title: Let me hear your song
fields.description: A unique and mysterious love story about the secret of a woman who can only fall asleep listening to a tone-deaf singer, the full story of a terrifying murder buried in her lost memories, and the search for the traces of love submerged within. Yoon, a dangerous man who approaches Lee-young for unknown reasons. A perilous yet beautiful adventure of Lee-young, who, while swaying like a floating weed under the spell of this sudden, dreamlike love, strives to recover her lost memories of the past.

fields.title: I Can Hear Your Voice
fields.description: A drama that excitingly depicts the events that unfold when Jang Hye-sung, a snobbish public defender, Park Su-ha, a mysterious boy with the supernatural ability to read minds, and Cha Gwan-woo, an upright man, meet.

fields.title: I'll be your night
fields.description: A sweet yet dangerous, mental healing romance between a world-famous idol suffering from sleepwalking and a live-in doctor disguised as a doctor who must secretly treat him!

fields.title: You fell for me
fields.description: A youth melodrama set against the backdrop of an arts college featuring dance, song, acting, and literature, capturing the innocent love, passionate friendship, refreshing youth, and lofty dreams of protagonists racing toward their aspirations.

fields.title: Where did you come from?
fields.description:
A girl from a remote, deep mountain village in Gangwon Province turns out to be the daughter of an incredibly wealthy family in Gangnam, Seoul. How wonderful! She has fulfilled the fantasy of everyone overnight… But is she truly happy? Is she genuinely joyful? The core objective of this drama is to provide entertainment and inspiration by portraying the process in which people who seem unreachable and incapable of communicating come to view the world through each other's prisms; the process of understanding and communicating through clashes and conflicts; the process of healing wounds and discovering one's true self; and ultimately, the realization that everyone in this world is the center of the universe and the protagonist in their own right.

Whether haves or have none, educated or uneducated, young or old, with or without a lover… isn't life generally weary and lonely for everyone? Becoming a mature being means realizing that this lonely journey is not solely one's own, and opening oneself wide to others.

Only those who can do so can taste the true joy of love. Happiness, ultimately, lies within the heart.

As we watch the protagonists' love, victory, and growth…

I hope that pleasant emotion and warm happiness will spread through the hearts of people living in this desolate, gray civilization.

fields.title: I'm going to touch you
fields.description: Do Jin-woo possesses a mysterious ability to see a person's future by touching their skin. Hiding his power while enjoying celebrity-level popularity as a fortune teller of the new generation, he one day spots the angelic Hee-young and falls in love at first sight. Hee-young, a heavenly and innocent woman, visits the fortune teller wondering when her boyfriend of one year, Hyun-woo, will propose. However, when the somewhat unpleasant fortune teller grabs her hand and warns her to watch out for the "falling water" and stay home, she gets frustrated, gets angry, and storms out of the fortune-telling cafe. Jin-woo, who never interfered with the futures of others, cannot forget Hee-young, whom he fell for at first sight. To save her from the impending dangers of the future, he secretly gets a job as a part-timer at the cosmetics store where she works, wearing an awkward disguise. However, whenever he gets the chance, he approaches her to touch her skin, only to be mistaken for a "pervert." In the meantime, he accidentally meets Heeyoung's boyfriend, Hyunseo, and while shaking hands with him, he sees Hyunseo's future. He sees Heeyoung reflected in Hyunseo's eyes and rushes to the proposal location Hyunseo had prepared to save her…

fields.title: who are you
fields.description: A human melodrama-comedy about a father's soul living in the body of a cold-blooded corporate raider, depicting his last 49 days on earth with his daughter. Young-in is startled by loan sharks who have come to the school and hides behind Ji-sook's wheelchair. Seung-hyo, having found a strand of hair on the documents, takes out his anger on the female secretary. Young-in is shocked to see Il-geon and Young-ae together. Il-geon grants Young-in permission to live in the dormitory for just one year. Il-geon, haunted by an ominous dream from the previous night, forcibly puts the reluctant Young-in on his motorcycle and heads to school... Seung-hyo, leaving the company after being pelted with eggs, loses his temper and drives himself, colliding with a truck... Young-in turns pale at the news that her father has died.

fields.title: The Snow Queen
fields.description: The entrance ceremony at Korea Science High School in 1998. As Tae-woong entered the hall holding the lunchbox his mother had carefully packed for him, he saw Jung-kyu taking the freshman oath, drawing the attention of the students. Jung-kyu and Tae-woong began to clash from the very first math class. Jung-kyu started to find Tae-woong irritating, as he appeared ordinary yet displayed a glimpse of genius. Then one day, Jung-kyu discovered a mathematics journal containing content identical to the report Tae-woong had submitted... Meanwhile, Tae-woong, unaware of anything, was looking for a book in the library when he saw a girl speaking loudly. It was Bora, the girl who boldly asked the librarian to sell her the fairy tale book "The Snow Queen." On his way back, Tae-woong helped Bora, who was being bullied by other children. Bora handed him a pager and disappeared. The next day, during class, Tae-woong was hurt by the news that he had plagiarized his report, and he ran out of school...

fields.title: Dazzlingly
fields.description: "My name is Kim Hye-ja, an extremely ordinary 25-year-old woman." A time-slip romance between a woman who loses her allotted time before she can even fully experience it, and a man who throws away his most brilliant moments to live a listless life—two people living in the same time but experiencing different realities.

fields.title: The World We Met Again
fields.description:
Seong Hae-seong, the boy who died in an accident, has returned looking exactly as he did at age 19.

To set right the lives of those around him, which had been twisted by his death,

and for his first love, Jeong Jeong-won, a 31-year-old peer who has not been able to forget him for the past 12 years.

fields.title: Shut Up and Flower Boy Band
Doctor Stranger
fields.description: This drama depicts the long and arduous journey of a stranger man searching for his woman. The ideological conflict between North and South Korea and revenge against those in power are merely secondary stories. What permeates this drama is a man's noble and fierce love for one woman.

fields.title: Dr. Jin
fields.description: Based on a manga that was adapted into a hugely popular drama in Japan, this series tells the story of a doctor with 21st-century medical knowledge and skills who travels back in time to the late 19th century to treat diseases.

fields.title: Dr. Prisoner
fields.description: A new concept prison x medical suspense drama unfolding after Na Yi-je, an ace surgeon expelled from a major hospital, becomes the head of the prison medical department.

fields.title: Doctors
fields.description: A human medical drama about a man and a woman who overcome past traumas to become doctors, grow as they encounter various types of people, and begin a once-in-a-lifetime love.

fields.title: Only one love
fields.description: An unpredictable, fantastic heavenly romance depicting the story of Lee Yeon-seo, a ruthless ballerina devoid of love, and Dan, an optimistic, troublemaker angel. Through the process of a perfect angel wishing to become an imperfect human, the story seeks to re-examine the "humanity" that a person should aspire to. That humanity is love. It aims to tell the story of the noble choice made when a woman with a cold heart meets an immature and naive angel, who, faced with unexpected tragedies and arduous trials, lay down everything solely for the other person. Regardless of the outcome, it dreams of the possibility that those who love in this way can become angels for one another. Here, a single miracle descends to touch the hearts of those who dream of fantastic love amidst a cold and harsh reality.

fields.title: Dali and Gamjatang
fields.description: An 'art' romance in which a 'cost-effective' man—lacking in the three elements of ignorance, lack of education, and practical skills—but possessing unrivaled survival skills, and a woman who exudes an air of class but is completely clueless about daily life, prioritizing 'emotional satisfaction,' bridge the gap between them through the medium of an art museum.

fields.title: Moon Lovers: Scarlet Heart Ryeo
fields.description: A 21st-century woman who time-travels 1,000 years back to the Goryeo Dynasty. She gets caught up in court intrigues and receives the love of several princes.

fields.title: Dalja's Spring
fields.description: Oh Dal-ja (Chae Rim), who is on the verge of turning thirty-three yet still has no luck with men, unexpectedly receives a proposal from her colleague Shin Se-do (Gong Hyung-jin) and begins the romance of her dreams. However, he is a notorious womanizer at work. To make matters worse, it turns out he is two-timing her with show host Wi Seon-ju (Lee Hye-young), who is Dal-ja's arch-nemesis. With her sincerity trampled upon, Dal-ja tells a lie to save herself from embarrassment, only for the situation to escalate, leading her to unexpectedly meet Kang Tae-bong (Lee Min-ki), who offers to act as her boyfriend for hire…

fields.title: My Sweet City
fields.description: A drama depicting the turbulent daily life of Oh Eun-soo, a 31-year-old in her seventh year of working.

fields.title: Sweet Spy
fields.description: Nam Sang-mi plays Lee Sun-ae, a widowed police officer who suddenly becomes entangled in the international espionage activities of secret agent Han Yu-il. Kang Joon recently transferred to the Criminal Investigation Division. He uncovers old cases related to Sun-ae's past, intertwined with current political and economic forces and their secrets. Strangely enough, one of them is Han Yu-il. Who is this man? Why is he here?

fields.title: Sweet Life
fields.description: A drama depicting the complex love-hate relationship between four men and women, such as Dong-won, who prided himself on leading a perfect double life, getting caught by his wife Hye-jin for his relationship with Da-ae, and Da-ae breaking up with Dong-won after developing feelings for Jun-su.

fields.title: Will you stay there?
fields.description: The present-day Su-hyun saves a young girl's life while volunteering for medical services and receives ten mysterious pills as a thank-you gift from the girl's grandfather. Swallowing the pills out of curiosity, Su-hyun instantly falls asleep, and when he opens his eyes, he finds himself facing his past self from 30 years ago. The past Su-hyun, who was spending happy days with his long-time girlfriend Yeon-a, happens to help a man who has collapsed on the street. The man claims to be Su-hyun from 30 years in the future; initially bewildered, the past Su-hyun becomes increasingly confused as he examines the evidence the man presents. Hearing the present Su-hyun say he desperately wanted to see the Yeon-a he loved just once, the past Su-hyun feels an inexplicable unease and subsequently learns about an unbelievable future...

fields.title: You are closer than you think
Your house helper
fields.description: A 'life healing' drama in which a perfect male house helper professionally cleans out and organizes the messy lives and homes of women whose minds and houses are in disarray.

fields.title: If you make a wish
fields.description: A story about a vulnerable young man driven to the brink of life who grants the last wishes of people at the end of their lives in a hospice.

fields.title: While You Were Sleeping
fields.description: The story of a woman who can foresee unfortunate events and accidents in her dreams, and a prosecutor who struggles to prevent those dreams from becoming reality.

fields.title: Big catch
fields.description: A former announcer who earned the title of South Korea's first female president. However, upon entering the Blue House, she faces a fierce offensive aimed at her downfall.

fields.title: oh my god
fields.description: We delve into the war of gamblers surrounding the throne—the one and only royal throne. ‘Tujeon, Golpae, Baduk, Janggi, Ssangnyuk, Geompae, Seunggyeongdo...’ The brilliant yet dangerous world of games that dominated the Joseon Dynasty. And the war of gamblers unfolding within it. However, gambling is merely a form of entertainment and a starting point; the goal of these life-risking masters is only one: the throne! Lee In-jwa, the unparalleled genius backed by King Gyeongjong ‘Yun’! Lady Sukbin Choi, who holds the royal heart in her hands, and her son, King Yeongjo, Lee Geum! Dae-gil, the greatest master gambler of Joseon! The war these groups wage over the throne is none other than Daebak.

fields.title: Daebak Real Estate
fields.description: A slice-of-life exorcism drama in which a licensed real estate agent turned exorcist teams up with a professional exorcism con artist to drive out vengeful spirits and earthbound spirits from haunted properties and unravel tragic stories.

fields.title: King Sejong the Great
fields.description: A political drama dealing with the confrontation, conflict, and process of consensus among diverse characters with different ideologies and values.

fields.title: The Great King's Dream
fields.description: An epic drama that reexamines with interest and entertainment the life stories of heroes such as King Taejong Muyeol and Kim Yu-sin, who, for the first time in our history, pacified a turbulent era, established a unified nation, and brought about the golden age of our national culture.

fields.title: Dae Jang Geum
fields.description: It depicts the turbulent life of Jang Geum, a female physician who, under a feudal system of male dominance, became the best chef in the royal court with fierce tenacity and will, and after many twists and turns, became the best female physician in Joseon, defeating numerous male physicians from the Royal Medical Office, including the Royal Physician, to become the only personal physician of the King in the Joseon Dynasty.

fields.title: Dae Jang Geum is watching
fields.description:
The reign of King Jungjong of the Joseon Dynasty.

Do you remember ‘Dae Jang Geum,’ who made a name for herself with her absolute sense of taste, smell, and culinary skills?

We were curious,

What are her descendants living like today?

And now, we would like to show you their delightful daily lives.

A romance-filled, saliva-stimulating variety drama about three siblings who live to eat.

We invite you to the dining table of the three siblings with mukbang superpowers,

who can turn even king oyster mushrooms into wild pine mushrooms.

fields.title: The K2
fields.description: K2, a bodyguard and former war mercenary, the wife of a presidential candidate who hired him, and a girl living isolated from the world! A secret and intense bodyguard action drama surrounding a royal family.

fields.title: The King
fields.description: Tae-su, a prosecutor aspiring to stand at the pinnacle of power and wanting to wield absolute authority and live a stylish life, meets Han Kang-sik, the architect of power, after many twists and turns, and rises through the ranks to great success. At a critical juncture of a regime change, an unexpected crisis strikes them as they set up a new game and bide their time… Is what is now flying toward him, the man who cast justice aside like a worn-out shoe, an inevitable boomerang?

fields.title: The King: Eternal Monarch
fields.description: A drama depicting a romance of a different dimension through the collaboration of a science-minded Emperor of the Korean Empire attempting to close the dimensional gate against the devil, and a humanities-minded detective from the Republic of Korea striving to protect someone's life, people, and love. On the night of the treason in the Korean Empire in 1994, Crown Prince Lee Gon loses his father and obtains half of the Manpasikjeok flute and an identity card with an unknown owner. 25 years later, Lee Gon arrives in the Republic of Korea in 2019 through a mysterious dimensional gate. There, he meets Jung Tae-eul, the owner of the ID card whom he has longed for and wondered about for 25 years...!

fields.title: The package
fields.description: A lighthearted drama set in Paris, France, capturing the chaotic adventures of a local guide and eight tourists. It is a package tour where strangers meet and experience the space between fantasy and madness. Thus begins a group's journey through France. It is a time when their individual stories and connections grow stronger at their destinations. And they come to realize that they have come to know each other better than at any other place they had visited.

fields.title: The King 2 Hearts
fields.description: A human melodrama black comedy telling the story of a female North Korean special forces officer and a wild, arrogant South Korean prince who grow a love story while overcoming prejudice against each other and the world's distrust and obstacles.

fields.title: Princess Deokhye
fields.description: Following the forced loss of national sovereignty, pro-Japanese collaborators, including Yi Wan-yong, blatantly cornered Emperor Gojong. One day, Gojong met a mysterious death, and Han Taek-su, a subordinate of Yi Wan-yong, persuaded Prince Yeongchin to forcibly send Princess Deokhye to study in Japan. Left with no choice, Princess Deokhye lived a life like a bird trapped in a cage, accompanied by her nanny, Bok-sun. As she lived each day longing for her homeland, Jang-han, a childhood friend, reappeared before her, and she found herself entangled in a plot to help Prince Yeongchin escape into exile...

fields.title: My Husband Oh Jak-doo
fields.description: A reverse-romance drama that begins with a working woman in her mid-30s living in extreme reality seeking a live-in husband solely to secure the social position of a married woman.

fields.title: goblin
fields.description: A drama that began airing on tvN in December 2016. Based on the Goblin folklore, writer Kim Eun-sook had been planning this series for three years, emphasizing fantasy elements that oscillate between historical and contemporary settings. If someone pushed you back into the world when you were drifting away from it, that is the moment a god stayed by your side. A Goblin who needs a human bride to end his immortal life, and an amnesiac Grim Reaper who begins a strange cohabitation with him. A mysterious romantic tale unfolds as a girl destined to die appears before them, claiming to be the Goblin's bride.

fields.title: Do Do Sol Sol La La Sol
fields.description: Penniless, yet the world is still beautiful. A self-luminous pianist heads to the countryside. Let's start a sparkling new life. Love finds those who do not lose hope!

fields.title: The Love Method of City Men and Women
fields.description: A KakaoTV original drama capturing the real love stories of young people living fiercely in a complex city, harboring another self within.

fields.title: Dokgo Rewind
fields.description: A story about three men from different walks of life who unite to fight against school violence! Hyuk has been wandering the streets since being expelled two years ago for a major incident in which he beat up 30 members of a gang of bullies. While wandering, he coincidentally meets Pyo Tae-jin, a promising wrestler from Dangyeong High School, and Kim Jong-il from Gicheon High School, who harbors a strong aversion to the gang, and they begin to build a friendship. Then, one day... a tragic incident occurs in which Kang Hyuk's friend, Gyu-sun, dies from an indiscriminate beating by the "Gang of Bullies Alliance." Enraged by the violence and viciousness of the Alliance and the adults' inaction, Kang Hyuk, Kim Jong-il, and Pyo Tae-jin join forces to devise and execute a plan to bring down the Gang of Bullies...

fields.title: Money flower
fields.description: A drama depicting the stories of people who live under the illusion that they control money, but are actually consumed by it. Pil-joo (Jang Hyuk), the lawyer and fixer for Cheong-ah, a leading South Korean conglomerate! Bu-cheon (Jang Seung-jo), the precarious legitimate heir and crown prince of the Cheong-ah Group! To place Bu-cheon on the throne of Cheong-ah, Pil-joo begins to execute a meticulously planned operation...

fields.title: Come Back, Uncle
fields.description: Based on the work *Section Chief Tsubakiyama's 7 Days* by Japanese author Jiro Asada, this is a human fantasy comic drama about the story of classmates from the afterlife who make a stylish return.

fields.title: When the Camellia Blooms
fields.description: "Love conquers all!"—a bombardment-style romance by the rustic femme fatale Hwang Yong-sik, who awakens Dong-baek, a beast trapped by prejudice. Surrounding them is a slice-of-life, passionate romance: "What nonsense about love." It is the story of a woman trapped by prejudice who not only breaks free from the constraints that confined her but completely shatters them. And it is the story of a miraculous man who ignited that revolution. It is clearly a heartwarming love story, but one that isn't all about love. The "real stories" of "real people" begin.

fields.title: Dong-i
fields.description: The story of Lady Sukbin Choi, the first person in Joseon history to rise from the lowest rank of palace maid to the highest rank in the Inner Court.

fields.title: second husband
fields.description: A passionate romance drama about a woman who unjustly loses her family in a tragedy born of uncontrollable desire and sets out for revenge amidst intertwined fate and love.

fields.title: There is no second chance
fields.description: A drama depicting the stories of long-term guests staying at Nakwon Inn, located in Huam-dong, Yongsan-gu, Seoul. Park Ha (Park Se-wan) gives birth to a baby at Nakwon Inn, run by Mak-rye (Yoon Yuh-jung). Park Ha heads to Guseong Hotel to uncover the truth behind her husband's wrongful death...

fields.title: Second Twenty Years
fields.description: A woman who unexpectedly became pregnant at eighteen and has lived for twenty years knowing nothing but her husband and son. A second youth comes to her as she belatedly enters college, determined to win back the heart of her husband who left her. Along with it comes a new life and a new love.

fields.title: The King of Dramas
fields.description: A comedy-style drama depicting the behind-the-scenes story of a drama production featuring a veteran outsourced production company CEO who insists that dramas must be profitable, a rookie writer who argues that dramas are about 'humanity,' and a top domestic star actor who refuses to compromise.

fields.title: Dream
