fields.description: This is a drama about a mixed martial arts fighter and a sports agent who overcame difficulties and achieved success after being released from a juvenile detention center.

fields.title: Dream High
fields.description: A drama set against the backdrop of an entertainment arts high school, depicting the dreams and love of young people striving to become stars.

fields.title: Dear My Friends
fields.description: A drama depicting the hymn of life sung by "twilight youths" who proclaim, "It’s not over. We are still alive." Wan is dragged to his mother Nan-hee’s alumni reunion. As expected, the gathering of old-timers was chaotic and disorganized. From Uncle Seok-gyun giving a long speech, Aunt Jeong-a badmouthing her husband, Aunt Hee-ja chiming in, and the deaf grandmother, to Aunt Chung-nam adding fuel to the fire—it was absolute pandemonium. But above all, the reunion falls into complete disarray because of his mother’s clash with Aunt Yeong-won...

fields.title: A warm word
fields.description: A drama that portrays the complex and subtle reality of married life, realistically dealing with the conflicts of two couples who walk a precarious tightrope to protect their families while embracing all their wounds and disabilities.

fields.title: The Effect of a Flick on the Forehead on a Breakup
Tantara
fields.description: "Ttanttara" is a derogatory term used to refer to people working in the entertainment industry. But can we truly use such a term to look down on them? Is there no such sentiment of a "Ttanttara" within our own lives? Whether at a company dinner or a family gathering, don't we liven things up by saying, "Let's sing a song"? Even in a grueling workplace, don't we keep music close by, perhaps through the radio? These are the people who provide music that brings joy to our lives and soothes our sorrows. That, too, is a fiercely competitive industry. Within that fierceness, there is likely "ruthlessness" and "coldness," but "warmth" and "sincerity" must also coexist. One man rises to the very top of the Ttanttara industry through "ruthlessness" and "coldness." Then, he falls back to the bottom. When he seeks to return to the top... he now advances, powered by "warmth" and "sincerity."

fields.title: Ddanppo Girls
fields.description: A coming-of-age drama about girls' high school students who practice dance sports in Geoje, a declining shipbuilding city currently undergoing restructuring.

fields.title: Terroir
fields.description: A work set in a wine restaurant that depicts the conflict and reconciliation of the protagonists surrounding Korean traditional liquor and French wine.

fields.title: Another Miss Oh
fields.description: A drama that began airing on tvN in May 2016. "Everything started with a misunderstanding!" A romance of mistaken identity where two women with the same name, 'Oh Hae-young,' and a man, 'Park Do-kyung,' who begins to see the future between them, become unintentionally entangled in each other's lives. The timing comes to make a different choice. What if you start seeing future events flash through your mind? But what if the situation doesn't change no matter how hard you try? Then what kind of ability is this? Isn't it just no ability at all? Then the man realizes. That only his heart can bring variation. Because the heart is the most important thing of all.

fields.title: Radio Romance
fields.description: A human romance drama about the story that unfolds when a top star, specialized in scripts and only able to speak with one, becomes a radio DJ who absolutely never follows the script.

fields.title: live
fields.description: It depicts the story of police officers working at the busiest precinct in the country, Hongil Precinct, who work tirelessly day and night to solve cases and uphold the small values of everyday life and justice. The story begins when Jeong-o, a job seeker, and Sang-su, an intern at a bottled water company, pass the police civil service exam and enter the Central Police Academy. It embodies the hope that the police will be remembered by the public not merely as a force of state power, but as diligent citizens in uniform—as described by the majority of police officers—and as emotional laborers who resolve civil complaints and maintain public order.

fields.title: Live On
fields.description: A romance unfolds with contrasting chemistry as Baek Ho-rang, an arrogant star at the pinnacle of the popularity pyramid at Seoyeon High School—where trendiness and fame define social class—joins the broadcasting club led by the perfectionist, old-fashioned president, Go Eun-taek, in order to find the anonymous sniper attempting to expose his past.

fields.title: Liar Game
fields.description: A 12-episode Monday-Tuesday drama aired on tvN from October 20, 2014, to November 25 of the same year at 11 PM. It is a remake of the Japanese manga of the same name, for which the rights were purchased. Since only the rights to the original manga were acquired, it is a remake of the original manga, not a remake of the Japanese drama version. In fact, the original source material for the drama only lists the original manga authors, such as 'Shinobu Kaitani/Shueisha'.

fields.title: Life
fields.description: A medical drama that began airing on JTBC in July 2018. Equipped with 34 medical departments and 2,000 beds, Sangguk University Hospital has been breathing on this land for over 60 years as an organism embracing countless patients and medical staff. One day, a professional manager from a chaebol group—rather than a doctor—arrives here as the hospital president. He is, in effect, the new ruler of Sangguk University Hospital, which had previously consisted solely of patients and medical staff. A young doctor reacts to this. Having quietly done only his own work until now, he rises from his seat, picks up the stone thrown by the president, and throws it back with all his might. Where will the fierce immune reaction between these two take this massive medical institution, where 8,000 patients pass through daily?

fields.title: Life on Mars
fields.description: In 2018, a detective who collapsed after being shot by an assailant wakes up in 1988, unsure if it is a dream or reality. Desperate to recover his memories, the 2018 detective meets the 1988 detective and solves cases together, discovering traces of the serial killer he was chasing and getting closer to the secrets of his lost memories...

fields.title: Racket Boys
fields.description: A story of the Racket Boys' challenge at the National Youth Sports Festival, dreaming of becoming idols of the badminton world, and a real coming-of-age drama of sixteen boys and girls unfolding in a rural village at the southernmost tip of the land.

fields.title: Lingerie Girls' Generation
fields.description: A drama set in Daegu in the late 1970s depicting the growing pains and love of young girls

fields.title: Lucky
fields.description: Hyung-wook, a ruthless killer, loses his memory after slipping on a bar of soap and falling at a bathhouse he happened to visit after handling a case. Jae-sung, an unknown actor who has lost both popularity and the will to live and decided to end his life, spots Hyung-wook while settling his affairs at the bathhouse and switches his key with Hyung-wook's to escape. Afterward, believing himself to be Jae-sung, Hyung-wook strives to succeed as an actor…

fields.title: Run On
fields.description: A romance drama about people living in different worlds who communicate and build relationships through their own languages in an era where communication is difficult despite speaking the same Korean, as they 'run on' toward love.

fields.title: Leverage: The Fraudsters
fields.description: A caper drama about Lee Tae-joon, reborn from the nation's top elite insurance investigator into the ultimate fraud strategist, who teams up with the best players in various fields to catch the truly bad guys playing above the law and bring justice.

fields.title: Romance
fields.description: A drama depicting the love story between Chaewon, a high school Korean language teacher, and a high school senior.

fields.title: I Need Romance
fields.description:
This seasonal drama, billed as the Korean version of Sex and the City, gained immense popularity by vividly portraying the lives of people in their late 20s—stories likely found in our everyday lives—rather than simply being a clichéd Cinderella tale.

While seasons 1 and 2 featured romance stories between three friends of the same age, season 3 is structured around relationships between people of different ranks within the same company.

As the seasons progress, sexual themes are toned down, and the series delves into the true essence of love.

fields.title: Romance is a Bonus Book
fields.description: The night before a new book is released. Editor-in-Chief Cha Eun-ho calls out the names listed on the copyright page, the final chapter of the book. These are the people listed on the copyright page—people we, as readers, would likely overlook if they weren't there—the foolish individuals struggling to bring a mere book into the world! Even a fussy writer is a pot-bellied father at home. Even a sensitive editor-in-chief clutches her head over divorce issues. An editor is still a clumsy newcomer to the workforce, and a marketing director is just an ordinary woman approaching menopause. There is also a woman returning to the workforce to start her final love. Even while gathered at the publishing house to create a book, they are always agonizing over what to have for lunch. Like a humble eatery hidden amidst the city's tall and glamorous buildings, this drama tells the stories of the people who eat those meals.

fields.title: I'm not a robot
fields.description: A drama depicting a man who has never properly dated a woman due to an allergy to humans meeting a robot and falling in love.

fields.title: lobbyist
fields.description: "Beast" explores an intriguing and alluring professional world. For a long time, lobbying has been a common profession in the international community, even appearing as a subject in movies, and lobbyists conduct their activities with transparency. However, the term has often been misused—whether for clothes, cars, or referees—leading to perceptions in Korea that deviate from its original intent, such as bribery, shady backroom deals, or brokering. It is a global trend for lobbying activities to be recognized as an official and professional field, and arguments for legally recognizing and training lobbyists in Korea are gradually gaining traction. Recently, it is said that the profession of a lobbyist is considered an attractive and promising career among young people. What exactly is this intriguing and highly appealing profession of a lobbyist? This drama will unfold the glamorous yet ruthless lives of lobbyists, as well as the processes of successful or unsuccessful lobbying, in an engaging and detailed storyline.

fields.title: Law school
fields.description: A drama depicting a campus mystery unfolding as professors and students at South Korea's most prestigious law school become entangled in an unprecedented case, along with the process by which aspiring legal professionals come to realize sincerity, law, and justice through a brutal survival story filled with blood, sweat, and tears.

fields.title: Rugal
fields.description: Based on the webtoon of the same name, this action-hero drama follows 'Rugal,' a special organization comprised of human weapons equipped with extraordinary abilities through bio-biotechnology, as they fight against 'Argos,' South Korea's largest terrorist group. Argos is the nation's most powerful criminal organization, led by Hwang Deuk-gu (Park Sung-woong). While pursuing them, Detective Kang Ki-bum (Choi Jin-hyuk) is ambushed by Argos during a mission, losing his colleagues, his beloved wife, and even his own eyes. Although he claims Argos is responsible, the evidence is insufficient. Branded a murderer who killed his wife and blinded himself, Ki-bum is imprisoned. However, upon receiving a secret offer to receive new eyes, he risks his life to escape from prison...

fields.title: Luca: The Beginning
fields.description: A spectacular chase action drama in which Gio, hunted by the world due to his special abilities, confronts a massive conspiracy alongside Detective Gu-reum, the only one who remembers his appearance.

fields.title: Legal High
fields.description:
In 2019, the law of South Korea is a "nose ring if hung on the nose, earring if hung on the ear." The very comprehensiveness and ambiguity of the law, intended to ensure equality for all, act as contradictions, inevitably giving rise to dangerous variables depending on how it is interpreted and applied... Legal professionals, who know this all too well, exploit the "law" to make a living, so to speak.

Mega law firms composed of former judges and prosecutors have long since turned the courtroom into a rigged money game arena by currying favor with current judges and prosecutors. Through the character of Lawyer Gwetae, I intend to brazenly and exaggeratedly expose this reality that everyone knows but no one pretends to know.

"The one who throws away their conscience first wins!!

Once the retainer fee is deposited, I can just buy back that conscience..."

Hitting the client "front" with the industry's highest retainer fees. Stabbing them "back" by mobilizing every means and method to win the case. I wanted to portray a super bad boy lawyer with the kind of arrogant charm you'd only see in dramas—one who completely disregards school ties, regional connections, and senior-junior etiquette, and laughs hysterically at the authority of the prosecution and the courts.

Let's laugh! Let's laugh! Let's laugh!

Isn't there a law saying we shouldn't laugh because of the law?

Isn't there a law saying we shouldn't play games with the law?

fields.title: Real
fields.description: Just as the opening of the casino ‘Siesta’ is imminent, gang boss Jo Won-geun (Sung Dong-il) appears before him claiming ownership. Facing the risk of losing the casino due to Jo Won-geun’s intervention, Jang Tae-young sets out to find investors to resolve his financial problems. One day, a mysterious investor (Kim Soo-hyun) appears with the exact same name and appearance, offering to resolve not only the funding but also the issue of Jo Won-geun. With the arrival of this mysterious investor, a war begins between Jo Won-geun and the casino, and the true nature of the massive secrets and conspiracies surrounding them is gradually revealed. Only the genuine possesses everything!

fields.title: Rich Man
fields.description: A Wednesday-Thursday drama airing simultaneously on Dramax and MBN starting May 9, 2018. A remake of the popular 2012 Japanese Fuji TV drama *Rich Man, Poor Woman*, the series depicts the romance between an arrogant genius businessman who cannot recognize the face of the woman he loves due to prosopagnosia (face blindness) and a job seeker with an AlphaGo-like memory.

fields.title: return
fields.description: A mysterious body on the road! Four members of the upper class emerge as murder suspects. A social thriller in which lawyer Choi Ja-hye, a TV return show host, teams up with Detective Dokgo Young, a former juvenile delinquent, to uncover the truth behind the murder case.

fields.title: Link: Eat and Love, Kill
fields.description: Link, restarted after 18 years, is an emotion-sharing fantasy romance about a man who feels all the emotions of a stranger woman.

fields.title: Come to the Witch's Restaurant
fields.description: A soul-charging, brutal fantasy created by witch Heera, business partner Jin, and part-timer Gilyong alongside customers full of stories at the Witch's Restaurant, which sells wishes with a price.

fields.title: Witch's Court
fields.description: A legal investigation drama about the story that unfolds when a snobbish female prosecutor is transferred to the special task force for sex crimes.

fields.title: Witch's Love
fields.description: A drama depicting the romance between a woman who cannot open her heart due to a boyfriend who promised to marry her in the past but suddenly disappeared, and a younger man who lives life on his own terms.

fields.title: Mother
fields.description: A mother working at a local herbal medicine shop and living alone with her son. To her, her son Dojun is her whole world. Despite his 28 years of age, the clumsy Dojun is unable to take care of himself and constantly causes petty trouble, driving his mother crazy. One day, a young girl is murdered, and absurdly, Dojun is framed as the killer. The mother runs around trying everything to save her son. However, the police hastily close the case, and the incompetent lawyer is only interested in money. Ultimately, with no one to trust to save her son, the mother sets out to find the real killer. As the suspicion against Dojun solidifies, the mother grows increasingly desperate.

fields.title: The Devilish Joy
fields.description: A man who suffered a brain injury and cannot remember what happened the previous day when he wakes up. A woman who fell overnight from the nation's first love to a celebrity with a million anti-fans. Three years after that day when everything changed, the two meet again. Is this a twist of fate, or a gift from God?

fields.title: mouse
fields.description: A full-scale human hunter chase drama depicting how the destinies of Jung Ba-reum, a self-proclaimed upright neighborhood police officer, and Go Mu-chi, an outlaw detective who lost his parents to a murderer in his childhood and has been driven by revenge, are completely overturned after a confrontation with the most vicious Predator, known as the top 1 percent of psychopaths.

fields.title: The voice of the heart
fields.description:
"The Sound of Your Heart" is a webtoon by Jo Seok that was serialized on Naver Webtoon.

The production company is DuruPix. It is currently being produced with three 7-minute episodes forming a single chapter.

fields.title: My Name
fields.description: She lost her father. Right before her eyes, of all people. The surviving daughter makes a resolution. She vows to take revenge with her own hands, no matter what. To achieve her goal, the method does not matter. Even if it means becoming an undercover agent for a drug cartel and infiltrating the police.

fields.title: My Secret Hotel
fields.description: A killing romance depicting the tangled wedding operations and unprecedented murder case of Sang-hyo and Hae-young, a former couple who reunite after seven years as a groom and wedding manager at Korea's best hotel.

fields.title: My Only Love Song
fields.description: Arrogant actress Su-jeong runs away on her own accord when the set of her new drama doesn't go her way. She climbs into an old van—little did she know that would be the beginning of time travel.

fields.title: My Father
fields.description: James Parker, an adoptee who volunteered for the U.S. Forces Korea to find his biological parents. Adopted to the United States at the age of five, he grew up as a healthy young man in a harmonious family, but he could not shake off his desire to find his parents. Eventually, James volunteered for the U.S. Forces Korea to return to his homeland and, with the help of a KATUSA friend, visits an orphanage in Chuncheon where he briefly stayed before his adoption. There, he discovers that his Korean name is Gong Eun-cheol and appears on a TV program to inquire about the whereabouts of his biological parents.

fields.title: My Princess
fields.description: A romantic comedy drama depicting the tumultuous love story between Park Hae-young, the sole heir to a conglomerate, and Lee Seol, a thrifty college student who becomes a princess overnight.

fields.title: Mine
fields.description: The story of strong women breaking free from the world's prejudices to find their true selves.

fields.title: Mad Dog
fields.description: This is a sensational insurance crime investigation drama that sharply exposes the reality of South Korea through the myriad forms of insurance crimes. It delivers a refreshing counterpunch to the stifling reality through the exploits of the insurance crime investigation team 'Mad Dog,' who portray themselves as irreplaceable dark heroes ready to turn the world upside down.

fields.title: Mary is staying out overnight
fields.description: This drama depicts a lively and bubbly love triangle that unfolds when Wi Mae-ri, a woman who has always avoided dating, accidentally starts a relationship with Kang Mu-gyeol, the vocalist of a death metal group, but Jung-in, a man who is perfect in every way, gets caught between them.

fields.title: Mendorong Ttottot
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of people becoming close while running the restaurant Mendorong Ttottot on Jeju Island.

fields.title: Bare-handed firefighter
fields.description: The story unfolds as a firefighter who unexpectedly becomes a nude model is accused of an arson and murder case from 10 years ago.

fields.title: sweatshirt
fields.description: Kim Seol-woo, a secret agent disguised as a bodyguard for a mission. Facing international crime is a daunting task enough, but to think he also has to cater to the whims of an immature Hallyu star! A super-star Hallyu star and the mysterious ghost agent who becomes his bodyguard. A story of intense men fighting against crime and villains unfolds, along with a peculiar love triangle that blossoms within it.

fields.title: Blue spring when viewed from a distance
fields.description: A realistic coming-of-age drama about the struggles of people in their 20s that might look like youth 'from afar'.

fields.title: Moments I Want to Stop: About Time
Memorist
fields.description: Dong-baek is a state-certified detective with the supernatural ability to read memories. Just as he is suspended due to repeated assault controversies, a sensational serial kidnapping and murder case occurs. Han Seon-mi, the youngest elite superintendent who first grasped the case, tracks down the culprit using her genius profiling skills, while Dong-baek also secretly dives into the case, risking dismissal to save the kidnapping victims...

fields.title: Mental Coach Jegal Gil
fields.description: A full-fledged sports drama about defending one's mental fortitude, in which a former national Taekwondo athlete, permanently banned due to an accident, returns as a national team mental coach to fight against an unjust winner-takes-all world and engage in a true battle.

fields.title: Melancholia
fields.description: A drama set against the backdrop of a private high school riddled with corruption and preferential treatment, depicting a story more beautiful than mathematics itself, featuring a math teacher and a math genius who transcend conventional wisdom and prejudice.

fields.title: Melodrama is My Nature
fields.description: Thirty—those who still dream simply because they are thirty, even amidst a harsh reality. A fantasy of thirty-year-old women who grow step by step, confiding their worries about work and love to friends and receiving comfort. Even if the current situation is not easy! Even if they haven't achieved a single thing! I dedicate this drama to all thirty-somethings in South Korea who steadfastly keep moving forward.

fields.title: Meloholic
fields.description: A man with superpowers incapable of love meets a woman with two faces who is also incapable of love?! A sweet yet brutal love fantasy about eccentrics addicted to love. Kyung Soo-jin, the charming woman with two faces! What is the true identity of this snobbish, spoiled brat?! Han Ye-ri (Kyung Soo-jin), whose alter ego awakens whenever she receives a confession in front of others! Ye-ri is constantly anxious about the unpredictable behavior of her other self, Han Ju-ri (Kyung Soo-jin). Meanwhile, Eun-ho (Jung Yun-ho) steps in earnest to set Ye-ri and Byeong-cheol up…

fields.title: The Admiral: Roaring Currents
fields.description: In 1597, six years into the Imjin War, Joseon was in a state of extreme chaos due to the prolonged conflict. As the nation faced a crisis threatening its very existence due to the Japanese forces advancing northward toward Hanyang at a terrifying speed, Admiral Yi Sun-sin, who had been dismissed on false charges, was reinstated as the Commander of the Three Naval Districts. However, all that remained for him were soldiers who had lost their will to fight, citizens filled with fear, and only twelve ships. Joseon was thrown into further turmoil when even the Turtle Ship, the last hope, was burned, and Kurushima, a mercenary with a cruel nature and brilliant strategic skills, stepped forward as the commander of the Japanese forces. As 330 Japanese ships gathered one after another and everyone sensed defeat, Admiral Yi Sun-sin led his mere twelve ships toward the sea...

fields.title: True to its reputation
fields.description: A drama depicting the events that unfold when a scoundrel doctor, widely acknowledged as the best acupuncturist in Joseon but having lost his original passion due to the barrier of his low-born status, is transported 400 years into the future to Seoul in 2017, where he meets a prickly, tenacious doctor who is a staunch believer in modern medicine.

fields.title: Empress Myeongseong
fields.description: The story of Empress Myeongseong, the great Iron Lady who led Joseon history to a history of victory with her brilliant diplomacy and outstanding strategic brilliance.

fields.title: Hourglass
fields.description: A drama set against the backdrop of South Korea's turbulent 1980s, offering a glimpse into the lives of that era through the eyes of three young people named Taesu, Wooseok, and Hyerin.

fields.title: Model Taxi
fields.description: A private revenge drama in which the mysterious taxi company Rainbow Transport and taxi driver Kim Do-gi exact vengeance on behalf of innocent victims.

fields.title: Model Detective
fields.description: Detective Kang Do-chang, who arrested the killer of a female college student and a detective five years ago without a shred of doubt! Five years later, as elite detective Oh Ji-hyuk transfers to Violent Crimes Team 2, evidence pointing to the forgotten truth begins to surface. A fierce showdown begins between those seeking the truth and those trying to conceal it!

fields.title: I have a goal.
fields.description: A drama depicting the audacious and secretive operation of 19-year-old So-hyun (played by Kim Hwan-hee), who plans the 'Happiness Ruining Project' to take revenge on those who made her life miserable. Winner of the 2020 MBC Screenplay Contest.

fields.title: Monster
fields.description: A revenge drama about a man whose family and life were stolen by a conspiracy of a massive power group. A drama depicting the ugly true face of the privileged class, shrouded in an impregnable veil, and a beautiful love story that blossoms even in the mud.

fields.title: Bad love
fields.description: They say that if you love, you should expect nothing in return, yet we expect far too much from the people we love. They say that if you love, pride is unnecessary, yet we face separation because of such pride. They say that a heart is enough if you love, yet we eventually face reality. They say there is no reason to love, yet in truth, there is always a reason when we love. So... so, it seems that God! gave the greatest pain to greedy humans: love. A cruel and nasty love, a wicked love.

fields.title: Moorim School
fields.description: A global youth campus drama where teachers and students of diverse nationalities, gathered here for different reasons, clash and communicate through the special life lessons of 'Moorim School' to learn true chivalry.

fields.title: Lawless Lawyer
fields.description: Bong Sang-pil is a boy for whom avenging his human rights lawyer mother became his "purpose of life" and "absolute mission" after witnessing her death before his eyes. This revenge, which he has been preparing with burning determination for 18 years, begins as Sang-pil, now a lawyer boasting the highest win rate, descends into "Giseong." It is a city of silk that possesses a face as serene and pristine as summer mist, yet cannot be cut by any sharp sword. It is a massive black hole of evil where judges, prosecutors, the media, and politicians are all in collusion. Giseong! In his journey to complete a revenge that seemed absolutely impossible against Cha Moon-sook, the colossal evil lurking at the apex of this corrupt and impenetrable network, Sang-pil realizes that what he truly desired was a just world where he would not need to dream of revenge. A legal action drama about eradicating great evil, where a "lawless" lawyer who used fists instead of the law risks his life to fight against absolute power and grows into a true "martial law" lawyer.

fields.title: Move to Heaven: I Am a Relic Cleaner
fields.description: Even when a person passes away, their belongings remain. Their lives are imbued within them. A young man with Asperger's syndrome and his uncle, recently released from prison. Two estate organizers, who have lived without a shred of expectation for the world, listen to the unspoken stories of the deceased.

fields.title: Heartless City
fields.description:
A 20-episode Monday-Tuesday drama that aired on the general programming channel JTBC from May 27, 2013, to July 30 of the same year. The script was written by writer Yoo Sung-yeol.

Originally, it was scheduled as a weekend special [1] following *The End of the World*, but after *The End of the World* was shortened and canceled early, the schedule was changed to a Monday-Tuesday drama and began airing. It is the first Monday-Tuesday drama scheduled in nearly six months since the end of *Can We Get Married?*.

The drama is billed as a noir action thriller centered on the confrontation between a massive drug organization and the police attempting to dismantle it. It is also a unique and meaningful drama that utilizes new subject matter rarely seen in Korean dramas.

It began airing on the same date and at the same time as the previous KBS 2TV Monday-Tuesday drama *Shark*, drawing attention to the rivalry between the two dramas.

fields.title: Minamdang
fields.description: A chaotic mystery comic investigative drama about a fake shaman turned former profiler.

fields.title: You're a Handsome Man
fields.description: It tells the story of Go Mi-nyeo, who dreamed of becoming a nun, joining the idol group A.N.JELL as a member in place of her twin brother Go Mi-nam, who went to the United States for re-surgery due to side effects from double eyelid surgery.

fields.title: Beautiful Gong Shim
fields.description: A drama that comically and warmly portrays the chaotic romance of four young men and women whose lives are intertwined like a skein: an older sister who has it all—looks and ability—a younger sister with a beautiful heart, and the charming man from the rooftop apartment and the dandy man from a chaebol family who appear before the two sisters.

fields.title: The Birth of a Beauty
fields.description: A drama depicting the life of a woman whose life changes after losing weight

fields.title: Miracle
fields.description: A story of youths who overcome trials and grow through the miraculous power of love.

fields.title: Future Choice
fields.description: A time-slip drama where a future version of yourself visits to offer advice and suggest new choices to carve out a different destiny for the sake of a better self.

fields.title: Misaeng
fields.description: Jang Geu-rae, having given up on his dream of becoming a professional Go player, becomes an intern and begins a challenging work life relying on his fellow intern, Young-i.

fields.title: Miss Hammurabi
fields.description: An idealistic, passionate rookie judge dreaming of a court that is strong against the strong and lenient toward the weak; a super-elite judge who prioritizes principles over premature goodwill; and a realist presiding judge who understands the weight of the world—a raw, realistic, up-close courtroom drama unfolds with three judges who are polar opposites.

fields.title: Mr. Goodbye
fields.description: A man who could die if his heart raced met a woman who shook his heart. The story of a dying man's final love.

fields.title: Mr. Temporary
fields.description: A mysterious murder at a prestigious high school in the top 0.1% of South Korea. A male student stabbed and killed a female student he had been stalking?! Kim Mu-hyuk, a successful yet materialistic lawyer, takes on the case at the request of the firm's representative. The defendant, a male student, claims to have been the student's boyfriend! However, other students from the same school give testimonies that contradict the defendant's claims. Kim Mu-hyuk falls into ruin due to a shocking statement made by the defendant in court. What is the truth behind this murder case?

fields.title: Mr. Baek
fields.description: A fantasy comedy romance drama about a 70-year-old chaebol chairman who becomes young again after an accidental accident and experiences the feeling of love for the first time.

fields.title: Mr. Sunshine
fields.description: A drama that began airing on tvN in July 2018. Eugene (Lee Byung-hun) is a boy of slave origin who lost his parents during the Sinmiyangyo Incident (1871), boarded the U.S. Navy warship USS Colorado, and ended up in America. After overcoming various forms of discrimination in the U.S. to become a soldier, he returns to Joseon, the homeland that abandoned him, and is stationed there. To him, Joseon was merely the country that beat his parents to death, the country he had fled from, and a barbaric nation where the nobility vied with one another to commit treason under the guise of modernization. Amidst this, he meets Ae-shin (Kim Tae-ri), the daughter of Joseon's most prestigious family, who is secretly fighting for Joseon's independence...

fields.title: Misty
fields.description: She rose to the position of top anchor driven solely by ambition. She believed that nothing could stop her. However, a massive incident involving intertwined past connections and present crises begins to tear her life apart. A colossal rift has formed in the facts she believed to be the truth. Pandora's box has been opened. South Korea's top anchor named as a suspect in a murder case. Her husband, who has become her defense attorney. A passionate mystery melodrama revealing the raw truth of the love they believed in.

fields.title: Missing: They Were There
fields.description: Kim Wook, a righteous con artist living by scamming villains alongside Jong-ah and Nam-guk. One day, after witnessing a woman being kidnapped, he is chased by mysterious men and faces the risk of losing his life... Barely surviving, he opens his eyes in 'Duon Village,' at the home of a suspicious resident named Jang Pan-seok. In this place, a child who was said to be missing is alive, and people who were perfectly fine right in front of him suddenly vanish. The mystery of the village and the true identity of resident Jang Pan-seok are unveiled.

fields.title: I'm sorry, I love you
fields.description: Eun-chae, a coordinator for singer Yoon, accidentally runs into Moo-hyuk while filming overseas. Moo-hyuk, who suffered from loneliness after being adopted to Australia as a child, becomes Yoon's manager to take revenge on the mother who abandoned him and reunites with Eun-chae in Korea.

fields.title: I love you even if I hate you
fields.description: A human family drama that follows the life of a woman who, after living a turbulent life since childhood and eventually losing everything, ironically blossoms during a time of fresh start, conveying the message that the greatest value sustaining us is not blood ties or laws, but the human affection and love found between people.

fields.title: I'm going crazy because of you!
fields.description: A drama that captures the moment when an 8-year bond transforms into love, through the story of Raewan, an artist troubled after spending a night with a long-time friend, and Eunseong, an interpreter conflicted between love and friendship.

fields.title: Miryang
fields.description: Shin-ae moves with her son, Jun, to Miryang, the hometown of her husband who died in a traffic accident. The three of them enter Miryang in a tow truck driven by Jong-chan, the owner of a car repair shop who stopped by to fix their car on the way. Shin-ae tries hard to act brave towards those who look at the mother and son, who have settled alone in her husband's hometown, with pity. From that day on, Jong-chan follows this enigmatic woman around. His daily routine begins with finding them a place to live, looking after their piano lessons, and accompanying them to look at land. Always four or five steps behind, he approaches when called and steps back when pushed away.

fields.title: Secret Love Affair
fields.description: A melodrama depicting the musical connection and poignant love between Oh Hye-won (Kim Hee-ae), the planning director of an arts foundation who has run forward with her eyes fixed solely on success, and Lee Sun-jae (Yoo Ah-in), a genius pianist who has lived unaware of his own talent.

fields.title: Wind, clouds, and rain
fields.description: A drama depicting the beautiful challenge and poignant love of the protagonist, Joseon's greatest fortune teller who reads destiny and wields geomancy as a weapon, as well as the struggle for the throne against the kingmakers who threaten him and his love.

fields.title: The Garden of the Wind
fields.description: Kim Hong-do and Shin Yun-bok, the most famous genre painters of the Joseon Dynasty! Kim Hong-do is the most famous painter of the Joseon Dynasty in history, having left behind a diverse body of work ranging from vibrant genre paintings such as "Seodang" (Village School) and "Ssireum" (Korean wrestling), to massive Uigwe (records of court ceremonies), ink paintings, and even self-portraits that realistically depict his later years. Shin Yun-bok, famous for his paintings depicting affection between men and women with refined brushstrokes, is recognized for his value even in modern times—or rather, has gained even greater recognition in the modern era—to the extent that there is likely no one who has not seen a picture postcard or calendar featuring his work, even if they are not familiar with him. These are the known facts about the two artists. However, there are a few unknown facts regarding them. First, they were contemporaries who served together as court painters at the Royal Painting Bureau; second, multiple paintings by both of them depicting the same subject have been discovered; and third, while abundant materials have been found regarding Kim Hong-do, almost no materials remain for Shin Yun-bok. Kim Hong-do enjoyed power for a long time, receiving the favor of three kings: Yeongjo, Jeongjo, and Sunjo. In contrast, Shin Yun-bok vanished forever from history, leaving behind only rumors that he was expelled from the Royal Painting Bureau for painting vulgar pictures. The 18th century, when these two were active, was a period in our history where culture flourished brilliantly, grounded in a society more stable than ever before. It was during this time, filled with positive energy as the nation transitioned from the pre-modern era to the modern one—driven by the active literary renaissance and reforms of King Jeongjo, who was himself a brilliant painter—that Kim Hong-do and Shin Yun-bok stood as "the recorded and the unrecorded." What on earth happened to these two men? Why did all records regarding Shin Yun-bok disappear? Fortunately, however, his records are gone, but his paintings remain intact. Now, let us look closely at his paintings. Quietly... a voice begins to be heard from within the paintings. This drama is precisely that story: the love story of Kim Hong-do and Shin Yun-bok, secretly hidden within the artworks.

fields.title: The wind blows
fields.description: The days when just seeing each other's faces brought happiness are gone, and the couple has now grown prickly toward one another. Diagnosed with Alzheimer's, the husband decides to let his wife go, without revealing the reason. A few years later, the two meet by chance and begin a love story of a different nature.

fields.title: If you cheat, you will die.
fields.description: A comic mystery thriller about a crime novelist wife who thinks only about ways to kill people and a divorce lawyer husband who signed a contract stating "If you cheat, you die."

fields.title: Half of half
fields.description: A story of unrequited love free in its beginning, growth, and end, unfolded by the meeting of AI programmer Ha-won and classical recording engineer Seo-woo. Ha-won, the CEO of AH and an AI programmer, is testing a conversational device infused with his own personality. Following a song that holds memories of Ji-soo, Ha-won accidentally enters a recording studio where he meets classical recording engineer Han Seo-woo. Following this encounter, the device is activated with Ha-won's personality... Meanwhile, Seo-woo receives a strange request from the new recording studio manager, Moon Sun-ho, to buy a bowl for Kim Ji-soo.

fields.title: Band-Aid
fields.description: Kang-il is a firefighter who risks his life every day rushing into crime scenes, yet carries the scar of failing to save his own wife. Mi-su is a doctor who speaks and acts as she pleases, pretending to be free from pain and love, but finds herself in crisis due to a single mistake. By chance, Mi-su begins working as a volunteer for the 119 rescue team and opens her heart to Kang-il for the first time, actively pursuing him. Mi-su employs every means possible to shower him with affection. And Kang-il, who had consistently been aloof toward her, also begins to open his heart little by little. Will they be able to put a bandage on each other's wounds?

fields.title: What Happened in Bali
fields.description: Soo-jung, the embodiment of tenacious desire; In-wook, a wounded man; Jae-min, a woman with a fragile soul; and Young-ju, a woman unable to forget the shadow of a past love. Through the lives of these four young people, we examine what true values we should seek in a world where money remains the only value.

fields.title: Cheeky Go Go
fields.description: A drama depicting the landscape within a school filled with hypocrisy and absurdity, emphasizing only competition for survival, through the incident of the merger of two high school clubs.

fields.title: The Scholar Who Walks the Night
fields.description: A showdown between a vampire trying to kill humans and a guardian spirit trying to stop them! A drama about the secret and perilous love story of these two, transcending social status and risking their lives.

fields.title: Every night
fields.description:
It is not a cultural property, but a cultural heritage. On February 10, 2008, National Treasure No. 1, Sungnyemun, burned down. Is Sungnyemun the only cultural property that has vanished in this way? National Treasure No. 238, the Sowonhwagaechop; Treasure No. 7, the Hyejin Pagoda of Great Master Wonjong; Treasure No. 994, the Iron Seated Amitabha Buddha... Even at this very moment, somewhere, our cultural properties are burning, being damaged, stolen, and looting, disappearing away. Amidst our indifference, cultural properties are not mere antiques, but cultural heritage. They are the history and pride that we must pass down to our children. Through this, we aim to provide an opportunity to remind ourselves of their precious value and significance. The world of true masters unfolding around cultural properties.

Many characters surrounding cultural properties appear in this drama. From a legendary grave robber who claims to know whether Goryeo celadon or Joseon white porcelain is buried just by smelling the soil, to traders on the cultural heritage black market who rival experts, a veteran crime chief who can roughly identify perpetrators just by looking at the looting site, and law-abiding enforcement officers, to appraisers and restorers who determine the authenticity of cultural artifacts based on cutting-edge science and years of experience—their joys and sorrows will unfold in an exciting manner. Naturally, a love affair between a man and a woman cannot be left out amidst all this, and that is none other than our protagonist, Kim

fields.title: Pretty Noona Who Buys Me Food
fields.description: A drama that began airing on JTBC in March 2018. Many people date, but true love is truly rare. A relationship that feels like it shakes your soul, a relationship where the other person's cold hurts more than your own incurable disease—have we ever truly experienced that? Can I, who am always selfish and think only of myself, broaden my horizons of perception regarding others and relationships to achieve genuine connection? Can we feel another person's joy and sorrow, ecstasy and pain—their textures—without any embellishment? It is possible. In that moment when you are deeply immersed in a true relationship. Looking into the other person with ceaseless interest, and meticulously recording and remembering every scene of their life—that is love.

fields.title: Bride of the Hundred Years
fields.description: A drama depicting the schemes and conspiracies surrounding the curse of a chaebol family, and the true love that blossoms amidst it all.

fields.title: 100 Days My Prince
fields.description: A drama that began airing on tvN in September 2018. It depicts the unprecedented 100-day romance between Won-deuk (Do Kyung-soo), who suddenly falls from being a flawless Crown Prince to a useless man, and Hong-sim (Nam Ji-hyun), the oldest unmarried woman in Joseon. Crown Prince Lee Yul, the ultimate "gold spoon" heir and the epitome of perfection, becomes an utterly incompetent man once he mingles with the common people. He is oblivious to what the people know, and consequently, he suffers all kinds of persecution. Hong-sim, a low-born old maid, becomes the superior, while Crown Prince Yul, who was of the utmost reverence, becomes the subordinate.

fields.title: Vampire Idol
fields.description: The chaotic adaptation story of handsome vampires from an unknown planet and the fresh, bubbly, strongest idol group on Earth, Girls Girls!

fields.title: Burning
fields.description: Jong-su, a part-time worker at a distribution company, runs into Haemi, a childhood friend from the same neighborhood, while on a delivery. Haemi asks Jong-su to look after her cat while she travels to Africa. Upon her return, Haemi introduces Jong-su to a mysterious man named Ben whom she met in Africa. One day, Ben visits Jong-su's house with Haemi and confesses his secret hobby. From that moment on, Jong-su becomes consumed by a terrifying premonition...

fields.title: Extraordinary investigation
fields.description: A crime action investigation series in which a homicide detective nicknamed the "Outsider Bulldog," an investigative reporting team PD with low ratings but overflowing passion, a detective turned professional seller from a former profiler, a legendary "Iron Fist" boss, and a funeral director formerly an ace forensic pathologist from the National Forensic Service solve cold cases.

fields.title: Love according to the law
fields.description: A "heart-fluttering, ultimate rule of law romance" revolving around the law office and café "Law Café" between Kim Jeong-ho, a building owner and former prosecutor dubbed a "monster genius," and Kim Yu-ri, a quirky lawyer. A live-action adaptation of Noh Seung-ah's webtoon of the same name.

fields.title: Veteran
fields.description: Seo Do-cheol is a man of action who sees things through to the end once he sets his mind on something. He is a fearless member of the Special Violent Crimes Unit, capable of catching anyone and showing no mercy. Just as he is about to catch his breath after solving a major crime he had been chasing for a long time, Seo Do-cheol encounters Jo Tae-oh, a third-generation chaebol heir. Jo Tae-oh is an arrogant man who fears nothing in the world, while Director Choi is his right-hand man who always stands by his side. While investigating a mysterious case, Seo Do-cheol instinctively senses that they are behind it. Despite warnings that he will get hurt if he messes with them, Seo Do-cheol refuses to give up, and the stakes spiral out of control due to his tenacity; meanwhile, as if mocking him, Jo Tae-oh nonchalantly slips through the cordon...

fields.title: Love of Transformation
fields.description: A comedic rebellion drama about three young people changing the world: Byun Hyuk, a third-generation chaebol heir with zero life skills who has fallen to the status of an unemployed bum; Baek Jun, a highly educated and qualified freelancer struggling to make ends meet; and Je Hoon, an elite dreaming of becoming a "gold spoon." While returning home after being stood up by Chae-ri (Seo Yi-an), Hyuk (Choi Si-won) gets drunk and unintentionally becomes the main culprit behind an in-flight disturbance. Staying at a hotel to escape his enraged father, Byun Kang-soo (Choi Jae-sung), Hyuk hears Chae-ri's voice and follows her, only to come face-to-face with the woman of his destiny, Baek Jun (Kang So-ra)...

fields.title: pleader
fields.description: Busan, early 1980s. Song Woo-seok is a tax lawyer with no connections, no money, and little formal education. From real estate registration to tax consulting, he rises through the ranks thanks to his exceptional business acumen, regardless of what others say, and makes a name for himself as the most successful and highest-earning lawyer in Busan. With a recruitment offer from one of the top 10 construction companies, Attorney Song is on the verge of making his debut as a nationally recognized lawyer. However, he unexpectedly hears that Jin-woo, the son of a soup restaurant owner with whom he formed a bond seven years ago after being indebted for a meal, has become entangled in an unforeseen incident and is facing trial. Shocked by the unbelievable sight of Jin-woo he encounters there, Attorney Song decides to take on the defense of the case that everyone else was eager to avoid...

fields.title: shooting star
fields.description: A romantic comedy depicting the realistic behind-the-scenes stories of the people who shed blood, sweat, and tears to make stars shine from behind the scenes.

fields.title: Various Daughters-in-Law
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of sworn enemies becoming daughters-in-law of rival families, as well as revenge and retribution.

fields.title: My Love from the Star
fields.description: An alien who has been posing as a human man for over 400 years since landing on Joseon soil. Now working as a university lecturer, he is finally able to return home, but falls in love with a Hallyu star living next door. A sweet and lively romance between a man and a woman of completely different species and personalities.

fields.title: hospital ship
fields.description: A drama depicting a generational story of empathy, in which doctors with diverse backgrounds travel by boat to provide medical services on islands lacking infrastructure, connecting with the villagers on a human level and growing into true doctors capable of prescribing sincerity.

fields.title: School Nurse Ahn Eun-young
fields.description: At first glance, it is a happy high school. If only it weren't for the sticky jelly and demons visible only to her. School nurse Ahn Eun-young, wielding a plastic knife to protect the students. Finish them off again today!

fields.title: Protect the Boss
fields.description: It is a sweet yet fierce romantic comedy drama about a rookie secretary who meets a super-powerful, delinquent second-generation chaebol as her boss.

fields.title: Bossam - Stealing Fate
fields.description: A tumultuous life reversal drama unfolds as a struggling kidnapper accidentally kidnaps a princess.

fields.title: Voice
fields.description: The '3 minutes' we risk our lives to protect are someone's life. Although they are called "counselors" and treated as the most marginalized group, the '112 Call Center' is actually where the most critical moments separating life and death converge. This drama vividly captures the fierce records of 112 call center agents safeguarding the golden time at crime scenes within the urgent time limit of "3 minutes to arrive, 5 minutes to verify the scene, and 10 minutes to apprehend." It speaks to the golden time of our own lives and the courage required for those moments that must never be given up. A drama depicting the intense records of 112 call center agents protecting the golden time at crime scenes.

fields.title: Revenge is back
fields.description: Kang Bok-su, who was unfairly expelled after being falsely accused of school violence, returns to school as an adult to plan his revenge, but far from getting avenged, he gets entangled in another incident and finds love again—a quirky yet heartwarming sentimental romance.

fields.title: Take revenge.
fields.description: A thrilling mystery revenge drama about Kang Hae-ra, who receives a request for revenge by chance, solves the case, and stands up against power.

fields.title: Born Again
fields.description: A reincarnation mystery melodrama depicting the fate and resurrection of three men and women intertwined across two lives. The 1980s. Hyung-bin, a homicide detective investigating the ‘Yellow Umbrella Serial Murder Case,’ is constantly worried that his girlfriend, Ha-eun, who runs a used bookstore, might become the next victim. He begins to find himself bothered by Ji-cheol, a suspicious man who hovers around her...

fields.title: Spring Days Are Gone
fields.description: Sang-woo, a sound engineer, lives with his grandmother, who suffers from dementia, his father, who lost his wife in his youth, and his aunt. One winter, he meets Eun-soo, a radio producer at a local station. Eun-soo, who is preparing a radio program that plays collected sounds of nature, goes on a recording trip with Sang-woo. As the two naturally grow closer, they spend the night at Eun-soo's apartment one day. Falling in love too easily, Sang-woo is uncontrollably drawn to her. However, the relationship between the two, who met in winter, begins to falter as they pass through spring and welcome summer.

fields.title: Spring night
fields.description: Spring returns after a long winter, and unexpected love awakens a languid daily life. An inexplicable attraction and a strange tremor. Is it all because of the spring breeze? Jeong-in and Ji-ho cross paths, and their peaceful routines are shaken. The time to realize true love—the spring night has arrived.

fields.title: Spring Waltz
fields.description:
“No matter how much the world changes, somewhere, there are still people who share such pure and beautiful love.” While planning the Seasons series, the consistent theme Director Yoon Suk-ho seeks to portray is pure love. The final installment, <Spring>, is also an extension of this theme. Like a sprout breaking through the ice after a long winter, or like dew on a blade of grass receiving the first clear sunlight of the morning after a long night, we aim to portray once again a beautiful love story that will deeply resonate with people's hearts and purify the world. A man turned into an island by fate... and a woman like the sea who embraces him.

There is a man who is always lonely amidst people. The me of today, the me of the past, the me I want to be, the me that is seen... Among them, who is the real me? With everything tangled up and not knowing where to begin unraveling the mystery, communication becomes increasingly impossible, and he now tries to live in the world using only his head, abandoning his emotions. As he becomes an increasingly isolated island within the world, a woman appears before him. And through her, who calls herself a 'guardian angel,' spring begins to seep into his desolate island, little by little.

Human A Medicine Named Love That Heals Inherent Wounds and Embraces Weak Souls

Everyone lives carrying their own wounds of despair. The drama *Spring Waltz* is a healing drama that will awaken the power of pure and beautiful love in the desolate hearts of modern people. The all-encompassing Mother Nature, the unchanging beauty of the seasons, and the pure, devoted love between a man and a woman unfolding within them. Through the unique delicacy and lyrical visual beauty characteristic of Director Yoon Suk-ho, *Spring Waltz* will once again awaken the faint nostalgia for innocence that we have buried deep within our hearts.

fields.title: Spring is coming
fields.description: A comedic farce about protagonists trying to maintain their respective positions after switching bodies, yet also a human story that deeply resonates with modern people who cannot live their own lives and instead desire the lives of others. Kim Bo-mi, a young anchor who considers everything a tool in the face of desire and prioritizes herself above all else. Lee Bom, a former actress who was once a top star but now places her family first. One day, standing at the peak of their happiness, the two women switch bodies. And not just frequently, but constantly. Having lived their lives according to their own plans, the two women suddenly find themselves living unpredictable lives. The imbalance of having to live another's life and their own simultaneously. And that imbalance brings cracks to their lives...

fields.title: Unfair trade
fields.description: A serial murder case that plunged the entire nation into shock. With repeated failures to apprehend the culprit, the President personally intervenes, and when a suspect dies during the investigation, the National Police Agency plays its final card: fabricating a fake killer to close the case. Choi Cheol-gi of the Regional Investigation Unit, the officer in charge of the case, accepts his superiors' offer of a guaranteed promotion and dives into the investigation. He uses his sponsor, Jang Seok-gu of Haedong, to set up a fake culprit and perfectly executes a public staged event. Meanwhile, Prosecutor Ju Yang, who is sponsored by Chairman Kim of Taekyung, a major figure in the real estate industry, is enraged by the fact that Choi Cheol-gi arrested Chairman Kim for bidding corruption and begins to investigate him...

fields.title: The World of the Married
fields.description: A story of a couple plunging into a vortex of revenge as the bond they believed to be love is severed by betrayal. The name given to two people, unrelated by blood, who form the fence of family to intertwine and share their lives: husband and wife. The fact that such a noble bond originates from the fragile link of "love" sends chills down one's spine the more one contemplates it. This is because love is neither infinite nor immutable. When we entered into marriage, we promised one thing: that we would love only you. However, the promise was abandoned, and love was betrayed. Hatred sparked by betrayal, followed by mutual revenge. Revenge inevitably comes with a price. We had to realize that revenge destroys not only the other person but oneself as well. I could have willingly endured my own shattering. Yet, I never imagined I would lose what was most precious to me. To hate someone enough to destroy them is another form of love. This is a story about a fierce love that strangles each other with all its might.

fields.title: Buam-dong Avengers
fields.description: A realistic revenge drama where a chaebol heiress, a traditional market fish vendor, and a university professor's wife—people who would never cross paths in real life—transcend social classes to exact cost-effective revenge.

fields.title: rich kid
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of Lee Kwang-jae, a wealthy son who struggles to repay a massive debt inherited to restore his father's honor, and Kim Young-ha, a spirited woman who actively supports him by his side.

fields.title: Bulgasal
fields.description: A sad yet beautiful story about a man who becomes an immortal being—one who can neither kill nor die—and chases a woman who has been reincarnating for 600 years.

fields.title: white way
fields.description: Lee Kyung, the ruthless heiress; Gunwoo, who loves her; and Sejin, who wants to become Lee Kyung. The story of three men and women who throw themselves into the furnace of power and wealth like moths to a flame.

fields.title: Red heart
fields.description: A bloody political romance unfolds as King Lee Tae, who must cast aside the woman he loves to survive, and Yoo Jung, who must become the Queen to survive, point their swords at each other's throats as political enemies.

fields.title: Beauty Inside
fields.description: We live bound by too many things. The many things that define us: our name, gender, age, and occupation. What would happen if we lost just one of those things? For instance, something like our "face." Would that make this life unhappy or happy? This drama begins from there. The truly important things are invisible. Perhaps, things like "love." There is a woman who lives to be seen. Han Se-gye. One day, she contracted a disease that causes her to become a different person for about a week, once a month. While such a bizarre condition would be difficult for any profession, Se-gye's case is particularly unique. Se-gye is an actress who must show her "face" on TV and on the big screen. And a very famous, great actress at that. There is a man who believes only in what is visible. Seo Do-jae. One day, he contracted a disease that prevents him from recognizing the face of anyone in this world. To think such a severe blemish on a life that is perfect in every way—looks, wealth, and ability. For a third-generation chaebol executive at an airline company who must inherit the group, a blemish means absolute ruin. The genre of this drama is truly an unpredictable, chaotic, healing romance! It follows the journey of Han Se-gye, who lives in fear that no one will recognize her, and Seo Do-jae, who believed he would never be able to recognize or love anyone in his life. As they meet and transform into Han Se-gye—a woman who can be recognized no matter what—and Seo Do-jae—a man who recognizes her no matter what. What is beauty? Se-gye, for whom outward appearance was more important than anything, and Do-jae, for whom outward appearance held no meaning. These two meet and embark on a journey to discover true beauty. Is it outward appearance or inner self that defines me? This drama seeks to pose this question lightly, yet deeply.

fields.title: Beautiful Mind
fields.description: A medical drama depicting the story of Lee Young-oh, a cold-blooded neurosurgeon with exceptional medical skills who rarely shows his emotions, who becomes entangled in the mysterious deaths of his patients one day, meets a woman, opens his eyes to love, and gradually changes while regaining his humanity.

fields.title: Do you like Brahms?
fields.description: A story about the precarious, wavering dreams and love of classical music students standing on the cusp of turning twenty-nine.

fields.title: black
fields.description: Song Seung-heon, the Grim Reaper who guards death, meets Go Ara, the woman who predicts death! A life-and-death prediction mystery unfolds as 'Black,' a Grim Reaper who collects the souls of those destined to die, and 'Haram,' a busybody human woman who tries to save people with her ability to predict death, defy the will of God and interfere with human life and death!

fields.title: Blood
fields.description: A hero story of a vampire surgeon who treats terminally ill patients and struggles for the sanctity of life and justice.

fields.title: Secret Door
fields.description: A story that uncovers the secrets surrounding the death of Crown Prince Sado

fields.title: Secret Forest
fields.description: An internal secrets pursuit drama in which Hwang Si-mok, an emotionless, solitary prosecutor, teams up with Han Yeo-jin, a righteous and warm-hearted detective, to uncover the truth behind a murder case involving a prosecution sponsor and the hidden secrets behind it. What initially appeared to be triggered by corruption within the prosecution organization falls into a labyrinth where the culprit's motives and future direction remain unknown...

fields.title: Big
fields.description: A romantic fantasy drama about what happens when an 18-year-old boy suddenly becomes a 30-year-old adult one day.

fields.title: Big Mouth
fields.description: This is the story of a struggling lawyer with a 10% win rate who gets entangled in a murder case he takes on by chance, becoming the legendary con artist 'Big Mouse' overnight, and uncovering the true face of the privileged class stained with a massive conspiracy to survive and protect his family.

fields.title: Big Issue
fields.description: Celebrities. Someone's first love, someone's role model, someone's star, and someone's family, someone's sore spot. A story about paparazzi uncovering uncomfortable truths in a field of villains, bloomed from souls tortured by hope and held hostage by the devil.

fields.title: Vincenzo
fields.description: The story of an Italian Mafia lawyer who comes to Korea due to his organization's betrayal, and teams up with a ruthless veteran lawyer to wipe out villains using villains' own methods.

fields.title: Shining Romance
fields.description: This is the story of Sun-ok, a mother who raises her two daughters with a heart more profound than that of her own flesh and blood, even though they are not related by blood; Bit-na, Sun-ok's eldest daughter, who is living a desperate struggle to find her daughter after being absurdly divorced due to a parents' sham divorce and having her daughter taken away from her; and Yun-na, Bit-na's younger sister, who became part of the family through Sun-ok's remarriage. It is a story about these three women, a non-blood-related family bound by the heart, who bravely navigate this cutthroat world without succumbing to despair, as they find their dreams and love.

fields.title: Padam padam… The sound of his and her heartbeats
fields.description: This work portrays the breathtaking love between a man who has lived a carefree life, through the miraculous story of meeting the woman he should not love. 'Padam Padam,' which means 'heartbeat' in French, is a heart-pounding melodrama.

fields.title: basketball
fields.description: Set against the backdrop of the turbulent Korean Peninsula in 1940 (1939–1948), this is the story of Gangsan and his friends who seek to overcome the impending tragedy of division through basketball, just as they crossed the dark era of Japanese colonial rule using basketball as a beacon of hope.

fields.title: red shoes
fields.description: The story of a heartless mother who turned her back on familial bonds to pursue love and desire for her own success, and her daughter who fell into an unstoppable cycle of desire driven by a thirst for revenge against her.

fields.title: Deep-rooted tree
fields.description: A drama about a series of murders of scholars at the Hall of Worthies that took place at Gyeongbokgung Palace during the seven days leading up to the promulgation of Hunminjeongeum during the reign of King Sejong of Joseon.

fields.title: office matchmaking
fields.description: Hari goes on a blind date in place of a friend, intending to scare the man away and reject him. However, her plan goes awry when the man turns out to be the CEO of the company she works for. To make matters worse, he actually proposes. A thrilling "quit prevention" office romance between a handsome, capable CEO and a female employee hiding her true identity.

fields.title: Season 3: Further than Sadang, Closer than Uijeongbu
Love and Ambition
fields.description:
Love and Ambition is an SBS special drama that aired from February 4, 2006, to November 12, 2006.

It is a remake of Love and Ambition, which aired on MBC in 1987.

fields.title: Love Rain
fields.description: This is a drama that tells the story of the timeless essence of love by simultaneously unfolding the pure sentiments of love from the 70s and the trendy ways of loving of the present era.

fields.title: Going Crazy in Love
fields.description: A drama depicting the events that unfold when Jin-young, an aerospace engineer who lost her beloved, coincidentally meets the man who caused his lover's death years later and falls in love with him.

fields.title: Love is Beautiful, Life is Wonderful
fields.description: A drama depicting a Dutch-pay romance between a mean-spirited man who refuses to marry and a reckless, five-abandonment-generation civil service exam candidate. It tells the story of protagonist Kim Cheong-ah's brutal youthful rehabilitation through perseverance after numerous setbacks, the turbulent love challenge of the non-marriage advocate Gu Jun-hwi, and the rollercoaster-like divorce story of Kim Seol-ah, a "show window Cinderella" who fell from a multi-billionaire heiress to a penniless divorcee.

fields.title: I believe in love
fields.description: The story of the kind-hearted Vice Principal Kim's family as they overcome their own trials and tribulations to build a warm and happy family.

fields.title: Crash Landing on Love
fields.description: Is an unexpected storm a stroke of luck or misfortune? A chaebol heiress crash-lands in North Korea after a paragliding accident. There, she meets a strict North Korean military officer. What are these unfamiliar feelings blossoming amidst all this?

fields.title: Temperature of Love
fields.description: A drama depicting the love and relationships of young people accustomed to superficial connections, featuring Jane, an aspiring drama writer who meets in real life after starting a relationship through online chat, Good Soup, who dreams of becoming a French chef, and various other characters around them.

fields.title: Love is coming
fields.description:
The biological father of my child is the brother-in-law of the person I love.

Can I, him, and our families handle this truth?

Must I keep this fact hidden until the very end?

We married out of love, but twisted human relationships drive everyone into confusion and conflict.

Can we truly become a new family?

There is a woman who became a single mother due to a man's betrayal and lived a life like a weed.

There is also a woman like a princess who married that man and lives happily.

These two women were once like friends.

The moment their pasts are revealed, the lives of the two women and those around them begin to spiral into a whirlwind.

The weed-like woman meets a new love and moves toward marriage, but the shadow of the past hinders them.

She wanted to be truthful, but she fears the storm that will engulf her and those around her the moment the truth is revealed.

So she tried to keep that box tightly closed, but the truth eventually finds its own way.

Is it acceptable to hide the truth from loved ones in order to be happy...?

Is it acceptable to pretend not to know the past?

A truth game played by a weed-like woman conflicted in the face of new love.

A princess-like woman realizes, in the face of a devastating truth, that everything she has enjoyed was ultimately not hers.

Wealth inherited from her parents, and a husband who, it turns out, loved her shell rather than her.

A life spent giving everything to her husband, firmly believing that this was love.

The disaster faced by the princess-like woman when the world she lived in through illusion appears clothed in truth. The growing pains of overcoming that disaster.

Through the fateful encounter of two women, this work aims to show that what truly matters is the deep-seated truth within a human being, and that the past is not something to be erased or forgotten, but something to be overcome.

fields.title: I love you, don't cry
fields.description: A drama depicting the love between two men and women with different wounds and the story of their families

fields.title: private life
fields.description: Cha Ju-eun is a born con artist who grew up committing fraud as easily as breathing under parents who called themselves documentary actors. Unlike her parents, she dreamed of an ordinary life, but her life is turned upside down by the appearance of Jung Bok-gi. Ju-eun comes face-to-face with Bok-gi at a completely unexpected moment. When Ju-eun asks for help, Han-son hesitates, saying it is a fight on a completely different level. But there is no giving up. There is only one chance. Ju-eun unleashes her honed con artistry skills to plan a documentary herself...

fields.title: Soundtrack #1
fields.description: A romantic music drama about a man and a woman who have been best friends for 20 years and get to know each other's feelings while staying in the same house for two weeks.

fields.title: Psychometric Guy
fields.description: A drama depicting a supernatural romance thriller featuring Yoon Jae-in, who hides a secret in her heart, and Lee An, who possesses the 'psychometry' ability to read others' secrets. A boy who can read the secrets hidden by others the moment their skin touches, and a girl with an inner wound she wants to conceal at all costs. A romantic comedy drama disguised as an investigation begins, in which these two encounter cases, big and small, solve them together, heal, grow, and fall in love.

fields.title: It's Okay to Be Psycho
fields.description: A psychiatric ward caregiver with no money, no parents, and not even a shred of hope. All he has is an older brother with autism spectrum disorder. To this man, who is content simply to feed his brother well and sleep soundly with his legs stretched out on his monthly salary, a strange woman resembling a witch from a fairy tale suddenly appears. She is the queen of children's literature, wielding a pen instead of a sword to dominate and manipulate the innocence of childhood. Moreover, she, who is incapable of knowing the emotion of love due to a congenital deficiency, fatefully falls for the very man who rejects love. Thus begins a war-like push-and-pull filled with blood and flesh. Will this brutal yet beautiful cruel fairy tale be able to reach a happy ending?

fields.title: Saimdang, Diary of Light
fields.description: A drama that reinterprets the life of Lady Shin Saimdang of the Joseon Dynasty, depicting her artistic spirit and immortal love. Seo Ji-yoon, a part-time lecturer specializing in Korean art history, becomes embroiled in a controversy regarding the authenticity of An Gyeon's painting "Geumgangsan," which her advisor, Professor Min, is pushing for. Having angered Professor Min, Ji-yoon is dropped off at an academic conference in Bologna, Italy, and while wandering the streets, she fatefully discovers an ancient book...

fields.title: Puberty Medley
fields.description: A drama set in a rural high school that depicts the innocent puberty of high school students.

fields.title: postpartum care center
fields.description: A passionate childbirth noir about Hyun-jin, the youngest executive at her company and the oldest expectant mother at the hospital, who grows alongside her fellow mothers as she navigates a disastrous childbirth and a crisis-level adaptation to the postpartum care center.

fields.title: The three siblings bravely
fields.description: The story of the eldest daughter, who had to make sacrifices and mature for the family, and the eldest son, a top star in the entertainment industry who had to support his family, as they meet and set out to find happiness.

fields.title: Sang-doo, let's go to school!
fields.description: Sang-doo, the new-generation handsome playboy! Just as he is busy trying to hook up a wealthy madam following the coaching of the washed-up playboy Man-do, his first love, Eun-hwan, suddenly appears out of the blue wearing a school uniform! Things only get more complicated, and Eun-hwan even gets into an accident. On top of that, Min-seok, the doctor treating Bo-ri—Se-ra's daughter—is Eun-hwan's fiancé! His first love, whom he met again after 10 years, shakes his heart, and Sang-doo heads straight to the high school where Eun-hwan works as a math teacher!

fields.title: The heirs
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of teenage high school students raised in chaebol families belonging to the top 1% of South Korea.

fields.title: shark
fields.description: A tragic drama about a man who loses his father and faces a life-threatening situation at the hands of the woman he loves' family, changes his face, hides his identity, and returns to wield the sword of revenge against them, yet is conflicted between revenge and love.

fields.title: Father on paper
fields.description: I Gained a Stepfather 5 Years My Senior!? A Chaotic Contract-Cohabitation Romance Between a Third-Generation Chaebol Saving a Daughter and Sisters Saving a Dad

fields.title: Thirty-nine
fields.description: A realistic human romance drama that tells a profound story about the friendship, love, and life of three friends on the verge of turning forty.

fields.title: I'm Thirty, But Seventeen
fields.description: A woman with a "mental-physical mismatch" who fell into a coma at seventeen and woke up at thirty, and a man who has lived cut off from the world. Their poignant yet comical romantic comedy about two men who are thirty but feel like seventeen.

fields.title: Queen Seondeok
fields.description: A drama depicting the life of Queen Seondeok of Silla, the first female ruler of the Korean people.

fields.title: Senior, don't wear that lipstick.
fields.description: A new employee at a cosmetics company fell in love at first sight with a senior colleague. She was just waiting for the right moment to confess, but lo and behold, her senior is secretly dating someone else at work! The other person is an unrivaled powerhouse who is skyrocketing in the corporate world. Should she give up on this hopeless unrequited love at this point?

fields.title: Heart-fluttering alert
fields.description: An unpredictable romance unfolds as a star doctor, a staunch bachelor, and a top actress, a love supremacist, create a fake scandal due to their own unspoken secrets.

fields.title: The kindest man in the world
fields.description: A classic melodrama in which conflict and love escalate as a man betrayed by the woman he loves uses another woman who has lost her memory to seek revenge.

fields.title: Ms. Ji-eun, Living Well in the World 2
The most beautiful farewell in the world
fields.description: One of writer Noh Hee-kyung's representative works being remade for the first time in 21 years, this drama tells the story of a middle-aged housewife who has sacrificed her entire life for her family and prepares to say goodbye to them after being diagnosed with terminal cancer.

fields.title: My prettiest daughter in the world
fields.description: Why do I get annoyed with my mom at the slightest provocation? Why do I take out all my anger on her at the slightest thing? Is it her fault that Dabin refuses to eat and whines when I'm dying of a rush in the morning? Is it her fault that I feel like I'm going to die squeezed into the subway on my way to work? Sigh... When will my daughter and I ever be able to break free from this hamster wheel of love and hate? Will Dabin and I ever be able to avoid living like the mother and me we are now? This drama is the story of a mother and daughter living in South Korea. I want to let go of my weary mother now—the one who has always been on my side, my helper with childcare and housework, and who, despite all this, calls this naughty daughter of hers "my prettiest daughter in the world."

fields.title: Juvenile court
