fields.description: A prickly judge who despises juvenile offenders is appointed to the Juvenile Division of a district court. Handling complex cases, he strikes a balance between his animosity toward juvenile offenders and his unwavering conviction in justice and punishment. Given that this is the court with the highest juvenile crime rate, is the harsh winds of the court now a foregone conclusion?

fields.title: Let's hold hands tightly and watch the setting sun.
fields.description: A drama depicting the love for each other and the preciousness of family as a couple faces the crisis of death, reflecting on their lives and revisiting the things they had forgotten one by one.

fields.title: Son: The Guest
fields.description: A mystery drama that began airing on OCN in September 2018. There is a legend passed down in a small village on the East Sea. It tells of "Hand," a powerful spirit said to come from the depths of the eastern ocean and possess people. Twenty years ago, a brutal murder occurred in the small village. Then, twenty years later, a series of bizarre murders takes place. Crimes committed by a strange, inexplicable force. Hand dwells in the twisted minds of humans, and cruel murders are committed by those possessed by it. A medium, a priest, and a detective begin searching for Hand for their own different reasons. What is the true identity of the Hand they are pursuing?

fields.title: Shopping King Louis
fields.description: A man who could buy anything with money. This is the story of Shopping King Louie, who meets Go Bok-shil, an angel without wings, and comes to cherish the sentiment of love that cannot be bought with money.

fields.title: Suspicious Partner
fields.description: A heart-pounding romance drama depicting the story of two main characters fighting against and reconciling with a prejudiced world, growing through sacrifice.

fields.title: Falling for Pure Love
fields.description: A romantic healing drama about a cold-blooded man with no compassion who undergoes a 180-degree transformation into a sentimental, pure-hearted romantic with a passionate heart for only one woman after receiving a new heart.

fields.title: Drunkard City Women
fields.description: A full-fledged drama centered on alcohol, depicting the daily lives of three women whose life motto is a drink at the end of the day. From Jigu, an origami YouTuber who constantly offers soju, to Jiyeon, an overly high-energy yoga instructor, and Sohee, a broadcast writer who works even on a blind date... all of these women are uncontrollable heavy drinkers.

fields.title: Hide and Seek
fields.description: A melodramatic soap opera said to depict the fate given to the heiress of a leading South Korean cosmetics company and another woman who had to live her life in her place, as well as the desires and secrets surrounding them.

fields.title: Suits
fields.description:
A drama depicting the bromance between Choi Kang-seok (Jang Dong-gun), a legendary lawyer at Korea's top law firm, and Go Yeon-woo (Park Hyung-sik), a fake rookie lawyer equipped with a monstrous memory.

'Suits' portrays the exploits of lawyers struggling to turn the scales of the law, set against the backdrop of Korea's top law firm where different desires and values clash.

fields.title: Super Daddy Ten
fields.description: Han-yeol, an outsider bachelor who once dreamed of a happy family but now aims to live alone for the rest of his life after being dumped by Mi-rae, is suddenly confronted by Dr. Cha Mi-rae, a single mom who appears after 10 years to propose marriage, and the forced family bonding between him and Sarang, a naughty nine-year-old who simply wants a dad.

fields.title: Smile Again
fields.description: A love story with intertwined destinies, depicting the friendship between two men as they fall in love with the same woman.

fields.title: Twenty-five twenty-one
fields.description: Back in the days when it seemed dreams would remain just dreams. A high school fencer racing toward an ambitious goal meets a young man struggling to rebuild his shattered life.

fields.title: Swedish Laundry
fields.description: A comedic fantasy drama that portrays slices of everyday life and the psychology of characters in detail and humorously through an ordinary female protagonist with the supernatural ability to see the worries of others, such as love, friendship, and employment.

fields.title: Sweet Home
fields.description: A world where humans turn into terrifying monsters. Fear has engulfed everything. Now, a small number of survivors wage a life-or-death struggle to hold onto their humanity to the very end.

fields.title: sketch
fields.description: A crime action drama capturing the fate and love of those struggling to change a predetermined future. Conflict and confrontation over beliefs and values. The answer to the question of why they fight. Justice is relative. What is justice on one side may be injustice on the other. The sacrifice of a hundred to save one, the sacrifice of one to save a hundred. If you were in their shoes, what choice would you make?

fields.title: Star's Lover
fields.description:
This is the most realistic love story unfolded by the stars Lee Mari and Kim Cheol-soo. Breaking away from the conventional "Cinderella stories" seen in previous dramas, it utilizes the fantasy-like theme of "love with a star"—which feels like a modern-day retelling of the story of Marilyn Monroe and Arthur Miller—to depict the process of achieving a love and romance that awakens to reality and truth, starting from the meeting of two polar opposites.

In the drama, Yoo Ji-tae plays "Kim Cheol-soo," a graduate student, part-time lecturer, and aspiring novelist who possesses a brilliant mind, overflowing culture, and extensive knowledge, yet is unable to escape reality due to his naturally prickly personality and the ideals he dreamed of. The story follows his journey to find true love within the reality he had settled into through his encounter with the star Mari.

fields.title: style
fields.description: It is a drama based on the novel 'Style' by author Baek Young-ok, which depicts the work and love of young people in their 20s and 30s in a trendy way against the backdrop of the fashion industry.

fields.title: startups
fields.description: Turning dreams into reality, the impossible into the possible! With ideas and technology, there is nothing they cannot achieve. Young founders dive into the cutthroat world of startups. They are determined to conquer both success and love. Seo Dal-mi, a humble contract worker, must find Nam Do-san, her first love from a letter 15 years ago. All because of the bravado she displayed in front of her older sister, Won In-jae, who has become a successful CEO! And there was Han Ji-pyeong, a man whose life was worn out by that very bravado...

fields.title: Stove League
fields.description: A passionate winter story about a newly appointed general manager preparing for an extraordinary season with a last-place team whose fans have even run dry. It is a story that perfectly captures the tastes of professional baseball fans who are enthusiastic about the sport's 2 trillion won economic impact, the era of 8 million spectators, dynamic fields, and the scent of sweat. It is a story about the front office, including the general manager, rather than the players. Following the front office—the supporting actors of professional sports—this drama will show that they are not merely shadows, but another protagonist of the winter season.

fields.title: Spy Myungwol
fields.description: A chaotic romance drama that unfolds when a beautiful North Korean spy meets South Korea's top Hallyu star

fields.title: spotlight
fields.description:
Are human rights more important? Or is the viewer's right to know more important?

The drama Spotlight seeks to approach the serious question of what constitutes a true journalist desired by this era and what true journalism is, through the portrayal of reporters who constantly ask themselves and answer these questions.

fields.title: sponsor
fields.description: A full-scale passionate romance drama about four men and women racing like a runaway train toward their respective desires: success, revenge, children, and love.

fields.title: Prison Playbook
fields.description: A superstar who went straight to jail instead of the Major Leagues. A dead end where the game has changed and the rules have changed; there is only one way to survive in prison. Just learn! From A to Z.

fields.title: Hospital Playlist
fields.description: A drama capturing the chemistry between people living seemingly ordinary yet special days in a hospital—called a microcosm of life where birth and death coexist, and 20-year-old friends who understand each other with just a glance.

fields.title: I Love You When I'm Sad
fields.description:
"The woman being chased, the man chasing, and the man who hid her." An era where love is common but true love is hard to find! A passionate melodrama about three men and women searching for true love.

A remake of the Japanese drama *Beautiful Person* by writer Shinji Nojima.

fields.title: hour
fields.description: It tells the story of four men and women whose lives become intertwined in the past, as they each make different choices at every crucial moment within the finite time available to everyone.

fields.title: Signal
fields.description: Detectives from the present and the past communicate via an old radio to reopen a long-unsolved cold case. Haeyoung, who unintentionally ends up being questioned by the police on suspicion of stalking a celebrity, discovers an old radio in a corner of the police station that night. A detective named Lee Jaehan speaks to Haeyoung through the radio. Surprisingly, he provides a clue regarding the Kim Yoon-jung kidnapping case, which has remained unsolved for 15 years...

fields.title: To You Who Have Forgotten Poetry
fields.description:
A hospital drama where the doctor isn't the main character. An emotional comedy depicting the daily lives of physical therapists, radiographers, and interns alongside poetry.

Woo Bo-young, a physical therapist with no money or connections, but whose sensibility is on par with a billionaire!!

Ye Jae-wook, the AlphaGo of the physical therapy world, born with nothing but skill and leaving his sensibility behind in his mother's womb!!

Shin Min-ho, a physical therapy intern whose sensibility seems to have been stored separately on an external hard drive, formatted only with his playfulness!

A full-blown heart-fluttering comedic story unfolds as these vastly different individuals find their emotional temperature, harmonizing with exquisite famous poems.

A story of 100% relatability that will sometimes make you laugh like a witty poem, and sometimes make you cry like a heart-wrenching one.

A full-fledged emotional comedy that will moisten your dry sensibilities, which have forgotten poetry, is coming to you.

fields.title: Semantic error
fields.description: A Watcha original drama depicting the campus romance of polar opposite youths: Chu Sang-woo, an outcast in the Computer Science department, and Jang Jae-young, an arrogant insider in the Design department who appears like an error in his perfectly structured life.

fields.title: Sisyphus: the myth
fields.description: A fantasy mystery drama depicting the journey of Han Tae-sul, a genius engineer seeking to uncover the identity of a being living in our world, and Kang Seo-hae, a savior who has traversed a long and dangerous path for him.

fields.title: Chicago Typewriter
fields.description: Seju, a bestselling author in a slump; Jin-o, the ghostwriter hiding behind his name; Jeon-seol, a literary geek who turned from a die-hard fan of Seju into an anti-fan; and the meeting of romantic mystery and antique romance involving these three individuals entangled with a mysterious old 'typewriter'.

fields.title: Secret Garden
fields.description: A romantic fantasy drama about what happens when the souls of Gil Ra-im, a stuntwoman who dreams of becoming a martial arts director, and Kim Joo-won, a 'prickly' millionaire department store president, are swapped.

fields.title: Secret Boutique
fields.description: This is the story of Jenny Jang, who rose from a bathhouse attendant in Gangnam to a maid for the chaebol Deo family, and then again to an unofficial power broker in the political and business world, as she aims for the position of Empress of the Deo family with the golden egg of international city development in her hands.

fields.title: City Hunter
fields.description: A drama about a city hunter who takes the lead in eliminating social evils.

fields.title: City Hall
fields.description: Set in 'Inju City,' a fictional small provincial city modeled after Incheon Metropolitan City, the story follows Shin Mi-rae (Kim Sun-ah), an ordinary Grade 10 civil servant, who meets Jo Guk (Cha Seung-won), a genius bureaucrat appointed as the Vice Mayor of Inju City; after many twists and turns, she is elected Mayor of Inju City, grows into a respected mayor, and wins the love of Jo Guk.

fields.title: scrounger
fields.description: Based on the comic of the same name by artist Heo Young-man, this drama depicts the story of the protagonists vying for the position of successor to the head chef.

fields.title: New Gisaeng Story
fields.description: A story of life and love unfolding at Buyonggak, based on the premise that the gisaeng culture, which has vanished into the annals of history, still exists.

fields.title: Cinderella and the Four Knights
fields.description: This drama depicts the adventures of twenty-year-old youths, focusing on the events that unfold when a spirited high school girl dreaming of becoming a veterinarian moves into the grand mansion "Sky House" through a connection with the chairman of the Gamsung Group, and begins living with three stubborn and free-spirited young masters and one bodyguard. Ha-won (Park So-dam), a hard-carrying Cinderella, finds herself in a situation where she must give up her tuition money, though the joy of her college acceptance is short-lived. However, she receives a part-time job offer from Hyun-min (Ahn Jae-hyun), the eldest son of the Sky Group, who appears like fate! Dragged by Hyun-min without knowing why, she encounters Ji-woon (Jung Il-woo), the second son of the Sky Group, with whom she has had a bitter rivalry since their first meeting, and finds herself in a difficult predicament...

fields.title: The Feast of the Gods
fields.description: It is a drama that tells the story of two female chefs whose fates become intertwined, using Korean food as its theme.

fields.title: Bridal Training
fields.description: Once summer passes, his priestly training will be complete!... But!! The training of Kyu-sik (Kwon Sang-woo), a top-tier seminarian, has been proceeding smoothly, like a ship sailing with the wind at its back. In just one month, he will be ordained as a priest—a long-awaited ceremony. "Mother Mary, there really isn't much time left..." His joy is short-lived, however, as Kyu-sik causes a major accident by smashing the precious 'chalice' consecrated by the Pope. He finds himself in the center of a humiliating 'Spiritual Enhancement Training' alongside Seon-dal, a rebellious seminarian! To think he had his first kiss stolen by a woman who is like a ticking time bomb! The place assigned for the 'Spiritual Enhancement Training' is a small church on the outskirts. However, with a strange male priest (Kim In-moon) who keeps tools closer than a Bible, a misery-like Sister Kim (Kim Seon-hwa), and troublesome neighborhood kids, things are looking ominous... The next morning, as Kyu-sik offers his early morning prayers with a devout heart, an unimaginable incident unfolds before him. While trying to chase away a woman who had fallen asleep drunk, he ends up... having his first kiss stolen!

fields.title: A Gentleman and a Lady
fields.description: A turbulent story that unfolds when a 'lady' and a 'gentleman' meet, both taking responsibility for their choices and seeking happiness.

fields.title: Gentlemen's Dignity
fields.description: It is a chaotic romantic comedy drama about four handsome middle-aged men and four women longing for a heart-fluttering romance.

fields.title: divine
fields.description: A drama depicting the timeless love between a warrior from the Goryeo Dynasty and a modern-day female doctor, and the process of creating a true king.

fields.title: Rookie Historian Goo Hae-ryung
fields.description: Based on the story of women treated as outcasts who confront the age-old truths that men and women are distinct and that social status dictates nobility and lower status, planting the precious seed of 'change,' this is a romance chronicle full of 'feeling' between Goo Hae-ryeong, Joseon's first problematic female historian, and Prince Yi Rim, a surprising lifelong bachelor.

fields.title: Let's Fight Ghost
fields.description: This drama depicts the episodes experienced by a protagonist who can see ghosts and a ghost he meets while they live together. It tells the story of Park Bong-pal (Ok Taec-yeon), a clumsy exorcist who beats up ghosts to earn money to get rid of his ability to see them, and Kim Hyun-ji (Kim So-hyun), a high school girl who became a ghost due to her regret over failing the college entrance exam, as they live together and chase ghosts together.

fields.title: Psychopath Diary
fields.description: The story unfolds as Yuk Dong-sik, a pushover who loses his memory in an accident while fleeing a murder scene he witnessed by chance, mistakenly believes himself to be a psychopathic serial killer after finding a diary detailing the murder process.

fields.title: Fight for My Way
fields.description: A drama capturing the hilarious coming-of-age romance of minor league youths who are determined to go their own way, regardless of what others say, even in a reality where their seemingly inadequate qualifications force them into a "minor league" life.

fields.title: Ssang Gap Pocha
fields.description: A mysterious street food stall appearing in an unfamiliar place late at night, and the stories that unfold there. A mysterious food stall that appears whenever someone, somewhere, faces a hardship late at night. A place where drinking the mystical liquor served by Aunt Wol-ju is said to reveal a way out of one's suffocating reality. Kang-bae, who has a unique constitution that allows him to hear others' inner thoughts with just a touch, finds himself seeking out Ssang-gap Pocha...

fields.title: Sunny
fields.description: Nami, a transfer student from Beolgyo, Jeolla Province, becomes the target of bullies from her very first day because her dialect bursts out whenever she gets nervous. Just then, a group of friends with an extraordinary aura come to the aid of the clueless girl… They are Chun-hwa, the leader of loyalty at Jindeok Girls' High School; Jang-mi, the plain-looking girl obsessed with double eyelids; Jin-hee, the champion of swearing battles; Geum-ok, the literary girl with superhuman strength; Bok-hee, the quirky girl dreaming of becoming Miss Korea; and Su-ji, the haughty ice princess. Nami becomes a new member of this group and plays a major role in a showdown against the rival group "Girls' Generation," using the dialect swearing skills she learned from her grandmother to escape a crisis. The seven best friends form the "Seven Princesses" group "Sunny" with a vow to stay together forever and ambitiously prepare a performance for the school festival, but on the day of the festival, an unexpected accident occurs, causing them to scatter in all directions.

fields.title: Circle: Two Connected Worlds
fields.description: As society becomes increasingly complex and competition intensifies, conflicts and crimes among people unable to control their emotions are on the rise. Consequently, we are hurt, lamenting our unhappiness, and growing increasingly exhausted day by day. This raises a question: If there were a society where human emotions were perfectly regulated and controlled... would we be happy? By introducing an extraterrestrial character who has already experienced a society like ours, this work seeks to take a step closer to the essence of happiness that makes us truly human.

fields.title: Summer Guys
fields.description:
“Summer Guys,” a dilapidated cocktail bar located next to a super-luxury resort on Jeju Island.

Oh Jin-dalrae, the owner and sole bartender, is barely keeping the business running, but she is on the verge of bankruptcy.

One scorching summer day, three suspicious men visit her.

Sunwoo Chan, a narcissistic, cold city guy; Park Gwang-bok, a pure-hearted, six-pack-pack heartthrob; and Matteo, a Casanova con artist.

To save Summer Guys, they join forces to form a squad of handsome bartenders called the “Summer Guys.”

Three men and one woman. And cocktails.

Where there is alcohol and youth, surely there will be romantic entanglements?

Surrounded by three potential romantic partners, Jin-dalrae finds herself in a happy dilemma...

However, each of those guys has their own ulterior motive!

What is the real reason they came to Summer Guys? Why are they helping Jin-dalrae?

And who is the man of her destiny!?

fields.title: miss
fields.description: A new maid recommended by the Count arrives at the home of a young noblewoman who lost her parents at a young age and lives under the protection of her guardian uncle. The young lady, whose daily life consists entirely of reading in her uncle's study, begins to gradually rely on the seemingly innocent maid. However, the maid's true identity is Sook-hee, an orphaned pickpocket and the daughter of a notorious female thief. She became a maid after accepting a proposal from the swindler Count to seduce the young lady, who is set to inherit a vast fortune, and steal her money, with the goal of making her fall in love with the Count. Finally, the Count appears, and he and Sook-hee begin to sway the young lady's heart in their own ways...

fields.title: Wife of the Knowing
fields.description: A drama that began airing on tvN in August 2018. A man and a woman bombard each other with pheromones and soon fall in love. They get married and have a child. The man has no energy left surviving the jungle of the salaryman world, while the woman is falling apart under the weight of being a working mom and a stay-at-home mom. The man wonders if this is the same woman who once made his heart flutter just by looking at her, and the woman finds this marriage utterly miserable. To that extent, the reality of marriage forces responsibility and sacrifice upon both men and women, placing shackles on them and subjecting them to oppression. At this point, the two begin to think: Did we... choose the wrong match?

fields.title: Arang and the Magistrate
fields.description: A drama based on a folk tale depicting the events surrounding Arang, a mischievous ghost, and Eun-oh, a prickly, handsome magistrate.

fields.title: To My Beautiful You
fields.description: A drama depicting the chaotic survival story of a beautiful girl disguised as a boy who transfers to an all-boys high school.

fields.title: Beautiful days
fields.description: Set against the backdrop of a record company in Seoul, a love triangle and family conflict begin as two half-brothers and two women from the same orphanage become entangled.

fields.title: To us who were beautiful
fields.description: A first-love-evoking romance story featuring the cheerful and lively high school girl Shin Sol-yi, her childhood friend and next-door neighbor Cha Heon whom she has had a crush on for 17 years, and the friends who shared their youth with them.

fields.title: Father, I will take care of you.
fields.description: A cheerful yet somewhat upsetting(?) story unfolds as four children, whom the parents worked so hard to marry off, return to their parents' embrace! Hyung-seop and Jung-ae, a married couple who had toiled tirelessly to finally marry off all four of their children and were planning to spend the rest of their lives with a light heart. Jung-ae was humming a tune at the thought of learning ballroom dancing and going on a cruise together. Then, one day... a situation more serious than a bolt from the blue occurs. Their four children have returned home at the same time...!!

fields.title: My father is strange
fields.description: A comedic and heartwarming family drama about the lives of Han-soo, a diligent father who has lived his entire life devoted to his family, his reliable wife Young-sil, and their four unique children, all of whom are suddenly taken in by an arrogant former idol-turned-actor. In addition, it explores stories of love and marriage, including the "marriage internship" of the younger generation and "divorce by mutual consent" of the older generation.

fields.title: Arthdal Chronicles
fields.description: That is where everything began. The ancient land of As. There were people who lived fiercely for the lust for power, the yearning for a new society, and heart-pounding love. Standing at the center are two figures: Eunseom and Tagon. What kind of nation do they each intend to build? And ultimately, who will claim that place?

fields.title: five children
fields.description: A heartwarming, comedic family drama about a single mom and a single dad who find true happiness through love, conflicts, and reconciliation with their families as they meet the second love of their lives.

fields.title: I do I do
fields.description: A romantic comedy drama depicting the events that unfold when a top shoe designer, a single woman, gets pregnant with a new employee's child after a one-night stand.

fields.title: Iris
fields.description: A drama about intelligence agents who risk their lives to prevent a second Korean War between the Republic of Korea and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

fields.title: Iris 2
fields.description:
A story revealing the identity of 'Mr. Black,' the mastermind behind Baek San, the former NSS director arrested for his activities related to Iris.

A sequel to the popular drama Iris, starring Lee Byung-hun, Kim Tae-hee, and Jung Joon-ho, which achieved a phenomenal 35% viewership rating in October 2009. This sequel aired four years after the conclusion of the first season of Iris.

fields.title: Iron Man
fields.description: The love story of a man whose body sprouts knives due to a heart full of pain, and a nosy woman who helps him grow into a true human being.

fields.title: Item
fields.description: A mystery-chase fantasy drama centering on a prosecutor who uncovers conspiracies and secrets surrounding objects with special supernatural powers to desperately protect a loved one, and a police profiler with cool-headed judgment.

fields.title: mister
fields.description: Tae-sik, a former special agent who turned his back on the world after losing his wife in a tragic incident, lives a lonely life running a pawn shop. The only visitors are those pawning items and Somi, the girl next door. As he spends more time with Somi, who has been abandoned by the world, Tae-sik and Somi open their hearts to each other and become friends. Then, one day, Somi's mother becomes involved with a criminal organization, and Somi is kidnapped right before Tae-sik's eyes...

fields.title: A woman who still wants to marry
fields.description: A drama that humorously depicts the dating lives of women in their thirties who desire love.

fields.title: Athena: Goddess of War
fields.description: A confrontation between international terrorists and NTS agents over a new type of nuclear reactor developed in Korea as an alternative energy source to oil.

fields.title: Nine-Year-Old Boy
fields.description: A drama depicting the unlucky romances of four men living under one roof who are stuck in the 'curse of the number nine': ages 9, 19, 29, and 39.

fields.title: When the Devil Calls Your Name
fields.description: A comedic fantasy drama about Ha-rip, a star composer who sold his soul to the devil, playing the game of a lifetime with his life on the line as his contract nears its end. Every song he writes is a hit! Every release tops the music charts! Ha-rip, a star composer who sweeps every music award of the year regardless of genre, receives a mysterious bill. It is a bill from the devil stating that he will reclaim his soul on the day his 10-year contract expires! What is Ha-rip's true identity? Strange things begin to unfold for him from the day he receives the bill...

fields.title: Devil Judge
fields.description: In a fictional dystopian South Korea, 'Devil Judge' Kang Yo-han appears alongside a live courtroom show in which the entire nation participates. Is he the hero everyone desires, or a devil wearing the mask of a judge?

fields.title: Flowers of Evil
fields.description: What if the husband you have loved for 14 years is suspected of being a cold-blooded serial killer? Hee-sung, a man who even faked his love, and his wife Ji-won, who begins to suspect his true nature. A high-intensity emotional thriller about two people standing face-to-face with a truth they would rather ignore. Hee-sung is fine just the way he is. A lovely wife. An affectionate daughter. A respectable workshop displaying his handmade metalwork. His entire daily life was perfectly ordinary. Until an unexpected visitor arrived at his workshop. Ji-won, a homicide detective, is called in urgently on the day of Hee-sung's birthday party to investigate an attempted child murder case, and Mu-jin, a reporter pursuing the same case, visits Hee-sung's workshop through Ji-won's introduction...

fields.title: Those who read the minds of evil
fields.description: During a time when motiveless murders were surging and plunging South Korea into terror, the first profiler begins dangerous conversations with serial killers. This is the story of a profiler who had to fiercely peer into the minds of those standing at the pinnacle of evil.

fields.title: Annarasumanara
fields.description: A magician living in an abandoned amusement park offers magical comfort to a high school student who grew up too quickly amidst a harsh reality. A special magic begins where despair vanishes and hope springs forth again.

fields.title: Hi, it's me!
fields.description: A fantasy coming-of-age romantic comedy drama about a 37-year-old protagonist whose love life, work, and dreams have all become lukewarm, who meets her 17-year-old self—who was fearless and passionate about everything—and finds comfort in her.

fields.title: Entourage
fields.description: A special chemistry story capturing the daily lives of the entertainment industry featuring Youngbin, who has emerged as a next-generation star; Eungap, the management CEO who has gone all-in to make him a top star; and the friends who have staked their lives on Youngbin.

fields.title: I know, but
fields.description: She has lost faith in love. But does that mean she must give up on dating altogether? A fellow student from the same department with fatal charm appears before this art student and makes a seductive gesture. A partnership-like relationship begins between them.

fields.title: Memories of the Alhambra
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of Yoo Jin-woo, the CEO of an investment company, who visits Granada, Spain, stays at an old hostel run by the female protagonist, Jung Hee-joo, and becomes entangled in strange events. Jin-woo is an impulsive investment firm CEO who travels all the way to Granada in search of an anonymous AR game developer. There, he meets Hee-joo, who runs a hostel. The moment the two meet, a magical story begins. Was it magic, or fate, that called him?

fields.title: assassination
fields.description: In 1933, during the Japanese colonial period when the homeland had vanished, the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea designates three individuals, who remain undisclosed to the Japanese, for an assassination mission. These are An Ok-yun, a sniper of the Korean Independence Army; Soksaepo, a graduate of the Shinheung Military Academy; and Hwang Deok-sam, a bomb expert. Yeom Seok-jin, the head of the Provisional Government's Police Bureau and a man of deep trust placed in him by Kim Gu, begins his search for them. The assassination squad's targets are Kawaguchi Mamoru, the commander of the Japanese forces stationed in Korea, and Kang In-guk, a pro-Japanese collaborator. Meanwhile, Hawaii Pistol, a contract killer hired for a large sum of money by a mysterious figure, pursues the assassination squad...

fields.title: Apgujeong White Night
fields.description: This is a drama about a woman who marries her biological mother's adopted son to take revenge on her for abandoning her in childhood.

fields.title: Cunning Single Lady
fields.description: A comedic melodrama depicting the cunning and desperate pursuit of Na Ae-ra, a divorcee who dreams of a romance with a handsome man but repeatedly fails, as she attempts to rekindle love with her ex-husband who has returned as a chaebol.

fields.title: heartache
fields.description: Kang Shin-woo (Lee Jung-shin) is a 28-year-old "born-to-be single" who has never had a proper relationship, yet is on the verge of turning thirty. After a sudden accident, Shin-woo finds himself back in the past without knowing why, where he reunites with his first love after 10 years! A chance to undo the failed past with his first love! Will Shin-woo succeed in restoring his relationship with his first love?

fields.title: Heart-wrenching romance
fields.description: A romantic comedy drama depicting the story that unfolds when a man and woman who met via a one-night stand coincidentally reunite three years later as a workaholic, prickly department head and a rookie nutritionist at his company cafeteria. Cha Jin-wook, the heir to Daebok Group, lives a dissolute, Casanova-like life! Unable to tolerate it any longer, his father, Chairman Cha Dae-bok, banishes Jin-wook to Daebok Resort as a bellboy. Meanwhile, Lee Yu-mi is a lifelong single woman with an impenetrable wall who dreams of becoming a nutritionist. She heads to Daebok Resort to attend her mother Mi-hee's second wedding, and thus begins their ill-fated entanglement...

fields.title: Alice
fields.description: The story that unfolds when a man and a woman, separated forever by death, magically reunite beyond the limits of time and dimension.

fields.title: Late-night snack men and women
fields.description: Chef Park Jin-seong faces the risk of losing his restaurant due to his father's sudden accident and his business partner, his older brother, unexpectedly disappearing. Variety PD Kim Ah-jin receives an absurd mission: if she fails to find a guest for her program within a day, she will lose her desk, let alone make her debut. What will be the choice of these two young people driven to the brink of despair?

fields.title: Again My Life
fields.description: Prosecutor Kim Hee-woo is murdered while investigating Assemblyman Cho Tae-sup, the absolute power behind South Korean politics. Seizing a chance given by a Grim Reaper he met at the brink of death, he gains a new life... The story of a hot-blooded prosecutor on his second life, with maxed-out abilities, punishing absolute evil.

fields.title: One day, destruction entered through the front door of our house.
fields.description: A precarious life-or-death fantasy romance about Dong-kyung, a human who made a life-or-death pact to avoid extinction and the being that is the reason for everything that disappears.

fields.title: Abyss
fields.description: A man and a woman die at a young age due to different accidents. However, they are resurrected with completely different appearances. A new goal confronts them: they must find the murderer who killed them. Cha Min, who is perfect in every way—from character to wealth—but lacking only in looks, attempts suicide out of despair over his appearance. Facing the Abyss at the threshold of death, Cha Min is reborn with a completely different form... Meanwhile, Go Se-yeon, the ace prosecutor at the Seoul District Prosecutors' Office, is renowned as a stunning beauty. She searches for a clue to the Eomsan-dong serial murder case...

fields.title: Welcome
fields.description: A fantasy romantic comedy drama depicting the subtle heart-fluttering romance between Hongjo, a cat who transforms into a human man, and Sol-a, a dog-like human woman. Sol-a ends up taking care of Jae-seon's ex-girlfriend's cat. Meanwhile, the cat Hongjo actually turns into a human the moment he decides he wants to... He has no idea why or how he becomes human. However, he continues to become human by Sol-a's side, realizing that this very person is what makes him human.

fields.title: A Day Found by Chance
fields.description: A full-fledged school romance drama where high school girl Dan-oh defies her predetermined fate to find love. High school student Dan-oh (Kim Hye-yoon)'s daily life is turned upside down! She accidentally discovers that this world is a romance comic book! Then, who is the male lead who will share a fated love with me, the female protagonist?! Dan-oh (Kim Hye-yoon) is an extra who is only used for the flirting of the romance comic book characters. She only gets hurt by her fiancé, Baek-kyung (Lee Jae-wook), but then a male student appears to save her... with a broad back?

fields.title: Undercover
fields.description: The story of a man who has lived hiding his identity, getting entangled in a series of incidents and struggling to protect his family.

fields.title: Always Spring Day
fields.description: A drama that realistically sheds light on the perceptions and trends of today's young generation regarding love and marriage through the contrast between conditional love and pure love, and explores the true meaning of love and marriage.

fields.title: Freeze to death dating
fields.description: A realistic survival romance about 20-year best friends Yeoreum (Lee Da-hee) and Jaehoon (Choi Si-won) who unexpectedly meet as a PD and a cast member of a soap opera dating reality show and begin to feel unexpected romantic feelings.

fields.title: Please, Summer
fields.description: A heartwarming and cheerful healing family drama that captures the lives of families bound together by adoption.

fields.title: Summer scent
fields.description: What is love? It is said that love is a mental state formed by chemical substances such as oxytocin in the brain. It is said that love lasts for at most 30 months. This is because antibodies form over time, causing the effects to fade. Scientifically explained, love is merely a hormone! It can be the action of a single drop, and it is truly dry and emotionless. However, the power of love that suddenly enters the heart one day can become a fated force that sustains one through a lifetime. In an era where love is becoming infinitely superficial, I want to speak about "the power of fated love felt from the heart." Therefore, I hope this drama will encourage young people to reflect on the "software" of love—the pounding of the heart and the excitement it brings—rather than the "hardware" of conditional love, which involves checking keys. I planned this drama with the hope that for those living worn out by daily life, as if love were already someone else's business, it could serve as an opportunity to realize that love is a valuable intangible asset that gives us the strength to overcome the daily despair, sorrow, and the weight of a weary life while living in this era, and to reflect once in a moment on whether I, too, have ever had such love.

fields.title: true beauty
fields.description: A romantic comedy about self-esteem recovery where Ju-kyung, who has an appearance complex but transforms into a goddess through makeup, and Su-ho, who harbors a hidden wound, meet, share their secrets, and grow together.

fields.title: The Fox's Bride
fields.description: A human melodrama about a mysterious newcomer with a secret and a troublemaker first-year employee with a poignant backstory who heal each other's shortcomings and wounds as they clash with the people at Incheon Airport.

fields.title: What are you doing, fox?
fields.description: A drama depicting the romance between an older single woman dreaming of a fantastical love and her friend's younger sister, who is nine years her junior.

fields.title: Scent of a Woman
fields.description: It is a journey in which a woman diagnosed with a terminal illness and a man who falls in love with her search for the answers to a happy death and a happy life.

fields.title: Women's World
fields.description: A drama depicting the turbulent life of Jeong Nan-jeong, who lived a desperate life defying her fate.

fields.title: traveler
fields.description: After spending a happy date with her father, Jin-hee's heart flutters at the thought of going on a trip with him tomorrow. The next morning, her father leaves her at an orphanage, leaving only a message to get along well with her friends. Unable to believe that her father has abandoned her, Jin-hee refuses to speak or eat, and tries to resist by attempting to escape the orphanage. However, she realizes that no one understands her feelings and that she has nowhere to go. And so, Jin-hee gradually begins to prepare for her farewell to her father…

fields.title: Weightlifting Fairy Kim Bok-joo
fields.description: An emotional youth drama depicting the stormy first love that befalls Kim Bok-joo, a 21-year-old weightlifter who had done nothing but lift barbells. A stormy first love strikes Kim Bok-joo, a 20-year-old weightlifter who had done nothing but lift barbells. For the first time, she feels ashamed of her calloused hands. For the first time, she wants to be a woman in the face of love. An essay on the clumsy love of angels, and the fierce coming-of-age story of physical education students racing toward their dreams and goals. We have all passed that point. We cheer for youth.

fields.title: love
fields.description: A twin sister living as the Crown Prince, disguised as a man, in place of her deceased older brother. She is trying to focus on both military and scholarly pursuits while keeping a tight seal against court ladies, but what to do? She keeps finding herself drawn to the man in charge of her education. Could this be... love?

fields.title: Marriage, not dating
fields.description: A drama depicting the events that unfold when a male protagonist, forced into marriage, introduces a luxury goods store employee from a provincial university as his girlfriend—someone his family would never approve of—in an attempt to make his family give up on the idea.

fields.title: Dating is a hassle, but I hate being lonely!
fields.description: A romance drama depicting the stories that unfold as young people who want to date but find serious commitments burdensome, and who want to enjoy freedom but dislike being lonely, gather and live together in a co-living house.

fields.title: Attempted romance
fields.description: I just want to try dating once in my life, so why is it always me who can't? So, I’m going to throw out a confession that feels like a gamble on my 18-year life. A youth comedy drama—not a romance—about "dating failures" brimming with reasons why they can't date.

fields.title: Love Era
fields.description: A drama about a divorced couple in their 20s who actually fall in love and start dating after their divorce.

fields.title: Discovery of Romance
fields.description: A drama depicting the love story of three people: a woman who ends her relationship with her ex-boyfriend and starts a new love, and her ex-boyfriend who returns after reflecting on his mistakes.

fields.title: The Temperature of Love
fields.description: "Let's break up," they said, and everything got hotter. Co-workers Dong-hee and Young-eun were a secret couple in their third year. They loved each other thrillingly, hiding from the eyes of others, but today, they broke up. The next morning, the two met again as colleagues. They smashed each other's belongings and sent them via cash-on-delivery, and threw a massive bill from online shopping before canceling their couple's phone plan. They even went so far as to scoured each other's social media and stalk each other upon hearing that the other had found a new lover! Everything started anew after they said, "Let's break up." With the push-and-pull dynamics of playing hard to get and pulling that began again after the breakup, Dong-hee and Young are now hotter than when they were in love. Is this what dating is supposed to be like?

fields.title: Dating Agency: Cyrano
fields.description: A drama depicting sweet stories about love and romance, centering on a 'dating agency' that helps people who are clumsy at dating find love.

fields.title: Love Revolution
fields.description: A new kind of comedic romance capturing the unique ups and downs of teenagers' love, friendship, and dreams, centering on the couple of the affectionate and lovable Gong Ju-young, who falls in love at first sight with the sassy Info High School goddess Wang Ja-rim.

fields.title: Twelve nights
fields.description: A drama depicting the travel romance of a man and a woman who spend twelve nights together during three trips.

fields.title: The Moment of Eighteen
fields.description: An emotional youth drama that looks directly into the precarious and immature world of 'pre-youth.' School life twisted in an instant by school violence. And the various societal prejudices and stereotypes that cling to him like a label even after he left. The ill-fated and destined encounters he faces in the place he ran away to once again. And first love. It is the story of Jun-woo's friends who endure together the will to live that keeps creeping back in, even though he thought his life didn't matter.

fields.title: The Fiery Priest
fields.description: The story of a Catholic priest with anger management issues and a representative detective from Gudam Police Station who meet over the murder of an old priest, haphazardly join forces for an investigation, and ultimately take down a criminal organization after being battered and bruised.

fields.title: My Sassy Girl
fields.description: An unpredictable romance drama featuring Gyeonu, the epitome of a prickly city man, and the problematic woman of Joseon. Their love story unfolds from a new perspective in a new setting! A historical drama version of *My Sassy Girl* that no one could have imagined is about to unfold. By shifting the setting to the Joseon era to introduce new storylines and conflicts, and reconstructing iconic scenes from the original—such as the subway vomiting scene—we aim to create a drama that is exciting for both those who have read the original and those who haven't. From the sweet romance between the flower-like youth of Joseon, Gyeonu, and her, to the thrilling love stories of the youths of Hanyang! An upgraded youth historical drama that brightens both the eyes and the heart!

fields.title: Glory of Jaein
fields.description: The happy journey of pure narcissist Kim Young-kwang and absolute positivity Yoon Jae-in

fields.title: Soul Repairman
fields.description: A drama about mental prescriptions featuring the stories of psychiatrists who believe in ‘healing’ rather than ‘treating’ those with emotional pain. Lee Si-joon (Shin Ha-kyun), a psychiatrist at Eun-gang General Hospital, lives by the nickname "eccentric." He attempts to amputate a patient's leg and even hangs out with a patient pretending to be a police officer. Then, one day, a patient who wants to become a police officer escapes and arrests musical actress Han Woo-joo (Jung So-min) at an awards ceremony...

fields.title: Pretty Man
fields.description: A drama based on the comic of the same name, telling the story of a man with perfect looks searching for love.

fields.title: Oh My Ghost
fields.description: An occult romantic comedy drama featuring Na Bong-sun, a timid woman with zero confidence possessed by a virgin ghost, and Kang Sun-woo, a narcissistic chef who doesn't believe in ghosts.

fields.title: Oh My Geum-bi
fields.description: The story of Geum-bi, a daughter suffering from childhood dementia, and Hwi-cheol, the father who cares for her.

fields.title: Oh My Lady
fields.description: It is a romantic comedy drama about an ordinary housewife who becomes the manager of a top star.

fields.title: Oh My Baby
fields.description: Jang Ha-ri, a 39-year-old parenting magazine reporter, adores children but has been single for 10 years. Worried more about pregnancy than marriage, Ha-ri visits an OB/GYN to freeze her eggs, while her mother, Ok-ran, secretly brings in Jae-young, a divorced single mother raising a child alone, without Ha-ri's knowledge. Lee Sang, a once-successful photographer, has become a YOLO enthusiast and has been on voluntary leave for three years. Su-cheol tries to lure Lee Sang into his studio, but Lee refuses the offer due to a bitter past history with Ha-ri. Meanwhile, Ha-ri visits the OB/GYN to hear her test results and receives a shocking diagnosis...

fields.title: Oh My Venus
fields.description: A health-healing romantic comedy depicting the journey of a female lawyer, who transforms from a 21st-century Venus into having the body of an ancient Venus(?), and a world-renowned male fitness trainer—two polar opposites—as they meet and embark on a secret diet challenge while healing their inner wounds.

fields.title: Oh! Master
fields.description: A heart-pounding, twist-filled romance between a man who 'doesn't' date and a woman who 'can't' date.

fields.title: May today be just like this.
fields.description: Centered around Chun-bok, Sang-yeop, and Jun-tae, who are long-time friends from the same hometown, this is the story of three fathers with different backgrounds and personalities, along with their wives and children. Although each has their own problems and pain, it warmly portrays the process of overcoming crises and difficulties through family love.

fields.title: Today's Webtoon
fields.description: The dynamic office life of the webtoon industry striving to upload [Today's Webtoon] every day, and the growth story of On Ma-eum, a rookie webtoon editor and former judo athlete who steps into that world.

fields.title: Orange Marmalade
fields.description: An emotional fantasy romance drama set in a world where vampires and humans coexist.

fields.title: Princess Aurora
fields.description: A bold yet pure love story that unfolds when Aurora, the pampered only daughter of a large conglomerate family, meets Hwang Ma-ma, a perfect but prickly novelist who lives with his three older sisters.

fields.title: Over the Rainbow
fields.description: A drama depicting the desires and race of aspiring singers toward the stage

fields.title: May's Youth
fields.description: A retro human melodrama capturing the poignant, spring-like love story of Heetae and Myeonghui, who fell for each other like fate amidst the vortex of history in May 1980.

fields.title: Squid Game
fields.description: Hundreds of people hounded by debt jump into a survival game to start a new life with a huge prize. However, not everyone can be a winner. Those eliminated must be prepared for fatal consequences.

fields.title: Okay, Gwang sisters
fields.description: A mystery thriller, melodrama, comedy, and home drama that begins with the entire family being named as murder suspects in the mother's killing that occurred during the parents' divorce proceedings.

fields.title: Rooftop Prince
fields.description: The Crown Princess of Joseon has passed away. The Crown Prince, who loved her deeply, vows to uncover the secrets hidden behind her death. Perhaps even the heavens were moved by his desperation. He has traveled 300 years into the future to the modern era. And here stands a woman who looks exactly like the Crown Princess!

fields.title: On Air
fields.description: An actress, her manager, a drama PD, and a writer. Four men and women who become entangled through the filming of a drama navigate the harsh reality of broadcast production.

fields.title: Oldboy
fields.description: One day, while returning home heavily intoxicated, Oh Dae-su is kidnapped by someone and confined in a private detention room. Eating only Chinese restaurant dumplings and confined to a limited space of eight pyeong, all he can do is watch television. About a year later, news of his wife's murder comes to light. Furthermore, upon learning that he is being framed as her murderer, Oh Dae-su begins digging a corner of the room with metal chopsticks in search of revenge and escape. In the year marking his fifteenth year of confinement, just as an escape route large enough for a person to squeeze through finally appears, he absurdly finds himself released back into the very place where he was kidnapped 15 years ago.

fields.title: All in
fields.description: A drama about two male protagonists born in different environments who finally stake their entire lives on a final showdown.

fields.title: red cuffs on the sleeves
fields.description: A poignant record of a palace romance between a court lady who sought to protect the life she chose and a king who prioritized his country over love.

fields.title: Wan-deuk
fields.description: Wan-deuk is a high school student living with his father—shorter than others but a bigger presence to him than anyone else—and his uncle, who has become family at some point. Despite coming from a poor and underprivileged family and being a troublemaker who can't study well, he is unbeatable in a fight. Having nothing, no dreams, and no hope, Wan-deuk has only one desperate wish: for his homeroom teacher, "Dong-ju," to disappear! Dong-ju interferes in his affairs at every turn and, to top it all off, lives in the rooftop room next door, calling out to him day and night. Today, Wan-deuk visits the church and prays earnestly. "Please, just kill Dong-ju."

fields.title: Perfect Wife
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of a protagonist, a tough middle-aged woman worn down by the hardships of life, who gets entangled in an unexpected incident, recovers her forgotten femininity, and finds new hope and vibrant love in life.

fields.title: Here it is! Jang Bo-ri
fields.description: This is the story of two daughters and two mothers who find themselves in a situation of extreme conflict due to the reversal of their identities as biological and adopted daughters. It aims to portray the process of mothers and daughters reconciling and becoming a true family through the lives of the protagonist, Jang Bo-ri, and three other women.

fields.title: The King loves
fields.description: A story history could not portray. King Chungseon, Korea's first mixed-race emperor. History records only him, his father King Chungnyeol, and his mother Princess Wonseong of the Yuan Dynasty. According to dry records, they were a family deeply conflicted due to their different homelands and found it difficult to love each other freely as they were swayed by history. The story begins with the premise that King Chungseon—Wang Won—who was born and raised in such circumstances, had a truly beautiful and poignant connection that was never recorded in history. It is a story about what it means to love someone—a love story between two men and one woman. What constitutes successful love? Is it when a man possesses a woman, or a woman possesses a man, by defeating competitors? I intend to portray a story about love that transcends possession. One person learns how to truly love another. Love that is not for oneself, but for you, will therefore be all the more painful and profound.

fields.title: The Man Who Became King
fields.description: A drama depicting the story that unfolds during the mid-Joseon Dynasty, a time of extreme chaos due to frequent rebellions and power struggles over the throne, when King Yi Heon brings a clown named Ha Seon—who resembles him more than a twin—into the palace to escape those plotting against his life.

fields.title: Why O Su-jae?
fields.description: The painful yet heart-fluttering story of Oh Su-jae, a cold lawyer left hollow inside after chasing only success ‘to survive, at the very top, more ruthlessly,’ and Gong Chan, a law school student who fears nothing to protect her.

fields.title: What's wrong, Mr. Pungsang?
fields.description: A drama that explores the meaning of family through the adrenaline-pumping daily lives, incidents, and accidents of Mr. Poong-sang, a middle-aged man who has lived his life doting on his younger siblings, and his back-breaking younger brothers.

fields.title: Flames of Desire
fields.description: A drama depicting human desire and destruction, and the greed for wealth and power, through the story of a chaebol family.

fields.title: There is no forgiveness
fields.description: Professor Kang Min-ho, the most skilled forensic pathologist in the Criminal Investigation Unit, was winding down his career to spend more time with his only family member, his daughter, when he was assigned one final case: a dismemberment murder discovered in the Geum River. It is an unprecedented case involving the body of a beautiful woman cut into six pieces, with even one arm missing. Through the deductions of Min Seo-young, a passionate female detective with exceptional deductive skills and drive, the suspects are narrowed down to Lee Seong-ho. Lee Seong-ho is an environmental activist living a frugal life while promoting eco-friendly agriculture, and he is a figure highly respected by the local residents. After being brought to the police station without resistance by the detectives, Lee Seong-ho boldly confesses that he committed the murder as a performance to oppose the Saemangeum reclamation project. Although the investigation seems to gain momentum with Lee Seong-ho's confession, the investigation team struggles to solve the case due to evidence that repeatedly defies expectations. While Min Seo-young and the homicide detectives are scrambling to find crucial evidence, Kang Min-ho's daughter goes missing. Upon discovering that Lee Seong-ho is involved in his daughter's disappearance, Kang Min-ho seeks him out. Lee Seong-ho proposes a dangerous deal, offering to save his daughter if he uncovers the clues and secrets he left on the corpse. An inevitable showdown begins between a forensic pathologist who must track down the clues left on the body to save his daughter's life, and a serial killer harboring a secret that foreshadows future murders.

fields.title: Yongpal
fields.description: A spectacular melodrama depicting the story of 'Yong-pal,' a highly skilled but unscrupulous surgeon who will treat anyone—regardless of place or patient—as long as he pays a high price, and his encounter with a chaebol heiress, the 'Sleeping Beauty,' who is in a coma in the hospital.

fields.title: Did We Love?
fields.description: A reboot romance unfolds as a "Four Men" (4-Man Cho) appears before a 14-year veteran single mom struggling to make ends meet: a bad boy she's drawn to, a pitiful but successful man, a scary but sexy man, and a young man who makes her heart flutter. Ae-jeong is a PD at Umji Film and a "14-year single mom." One day, she falls victim to a guarantee scam by the CEO she trusted, leaving her burdened with a debt of 1 billion won! All that remains at the company is a copyright contract for an unknown novelist. However, this work turns out to be the debut novel of Cheon Eok-man, a winner of the world's three major literary awards? Pa-do, the president of a loan company, promises Ae-jeong that he will clear her debt and invest 10 billion won in a film on the condition that she brings in Cheon Eok-man and top star Ryu Jin...

fields.title: We broke up
fields.description: Based on the webtoon of the same name, No Woo-ri (Sandara Park), a job seeker who never loses her bright spirit despite difficult circumstances, and Ji Won-young (Kang Seung-yoon), an indie band vocalist struggling to make ends meet even while working overnight part-time jobs, broke up after living together for five years but are forced to continue living in the same house due to a security deposit issue...

fields.title: Can We Get Married?
fields.description: A drama that offers insights into marriage through the stories of an engaged couple 100 days away from their wedding, their families, and the various couples surrounding them.

fields.title: The Miracle We Met
fields.description: A fantasy human melodrama depicting the process of an ordinary South Korean family man taking over the life of a man who shares the same name and age but has lived a completely opposite life, and transforming his surroundings into a heartwarming place in his own unique way.

fields.title: From today, we
fields.description: A romantic comedy farce that unfolds when Oh-ri, who cherished her pre-marital virginity like her life, becomes pregnant with a man's child due to a medical accident during a check-up.

fields.title: Our Blues
fields.description: A drama that began airing on tvN in April 2022. Love is sweet yet bitter, and life is bound to have its ups and downs. It unfolds the stories of people living day by day on the bustling island of Jeju. This drama is a cheer for all lives standing at the end, the peak, or the beginning of their journey. Set against the backdrop of warm Jeju, the vibrant Jeju Five-Day Market, and the cold, rough sea, it conveys the bittersweet, sour, and astringent life stories of 14 individuals within the compressed format of an omnibus—poetic and poignant, and at times exciting, refreshing, and sophisticated.

fields.title: The man living in my house
fields.description: This work tells the story of Hong Na-ri, a flight attendant, who meets Go Nan-gil, who claims to be her new stepfather, at her hometown house she has visited for the first time in a long while.

fields.title: Elegant
fields.description:
Owner risk refers to the damage caused by the misconduct of the owner's family. MC Group's TOP Team is the premier team for owner risk management.

The TOP Team is comprised of law graduates from the National Intelligence Service, the Prosecutor's Office, media outlets, and the military! They are industry legends who say that if they cannot solve a problem, it was never meant to be solved in the first place!

Mo Seok-hee, the daughter of MC Group, was born the pampered only daughter of a chaebol family but has lived for 15 years wearing a mask of malice after losing her mother to a murder case.

She has teamed up with Heo Yun-do, a lawyer from a third-rate university who has lived like a weed after his mother was unjustly framed and imprisoned.

Will they be able to find the real murderer and fight against TOP, a team filled with greed, hypocrisy, and illegality, to win?

fields.title: Fate and Fury
fields.description: A realistic and passionate melodrama capturing the intertwined love and anger of four men and women: a woman who loves a man to change her fate, a man who loves her believing it is his destiny, a woman who tries to win the man over for her own purposes, and a man filled with revenge who seeks to win her back.

fields.title: I love you like fate
fields.description: A romantic comedy drama about a "flawed woman" whose only distinguishing feature is her kindness and a "surreal perfect man" whose position as heir is threatened because he cannot produce an heir, who experience a rollercoaster of life through an unwanted marriage and come to realize their fated love.

fields.title: Lucky Romance
fields.description: A romantic comedy featuring Shim Bo-nui, who believes in fate and blindly trusts superstitions, and Je Su-ho, a game company CEO with an engineering background who is obsessed with math and science. A reinterpretation of the webtoon of the same name that captures its wit and strengths while adapting it into a drama.

fields.title: Wonder Woman
fields.description: From corrupt prosecutor to chaebol heiress overnight—a life-change! The ‘Double Life’ comic blockbuster of a female prosecutor with a 100% delinquency score who enters a villainous chaebol family.

fields.title: Wanted
fields.description: A reality thriller drama depicting the struggle of Korea's top actress as she performs missions according to the kidnapper's demands on a live reality show to find her abducted son.

fields.title: Monthly House
fields.description: A drama depicting the home-buying romance between a woman who lives in a house and a man who buys a house.

fields.title: The Gentlemen of the Laurel Tree Tailor Shop
fields.description: A drama set against the backdrop of 'The Laurel Tree Tailor Shop,' a custom suit shop boasting history and tradition, depicting the tears, friendship, success, and love of four men with many stories to tell.

fields.title: Mon-Wed-Fri-Tue-Thu-Sat
fields.description: A romantic comedy in which Choi Sang-eun, who has made marriage her profession, gets entangled with Jung Ji-ho, who is on a long-term exclusive contract for Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, and Kang Hae-jin, who has a new contract for Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays.

fields.title: The Great Show
fields.description: Daehan, a first-term lawmaker, fails to be re-elected just a week before the general election due to a scandal involving a parricide. From a successful congressman, Daehan falls overnight into unemployment. While barely making ends meet as a designated driver, he refuses to let go of his dream of returning to politics... He unexpectedly runs into Suhyun, a girl he had a crush on back in college, at the market. Unlike Daehan, who is delighted to see her, Suhyun seems inexplicably displeased... Then, a mysterious high school girl appears before them, sobbing uncontrollably and begging them to find her lost younger sibling. Daehan, needing to restore his image, considers helping the high school girl to shed the label of a parricide...

fields.title: The Great Seducer
fields.description: Kwon Si-hyun, the heir to the JK Group, hears the news that his friend Choi Su-ji's mother is remarrying the father he hates. He suggests to Choi Su-ji that they get married first, but Choi Su-ji sets one condition for the marriage.

fields.title: Yuna's Street
fields.description: It is a story about Chang-man, a kind man unlike any other, who moves into a multi-family housing complex inhabited by people of diverse personalities and Yuna, a former pickpocket, and how they heal their wounds and pain as they live together and interact.

fields.title: Catch the Ghost
fields.description: Chief Go Ji-seok of the Investigation Unit 1 of the Wangsuri Subway Police is an elite who graduated at the top of his class from the Police Academy. Then, one day, the case of a lifetime breaks out, threatening to end Ji-seok's stable career as a police officer. A serial killer known as the "Subway Ghost"—who has kidnapped, murdered, and abandoned victims in subway stations bustling with people for the past two years yet remained unnoticed—turns the Subway Police Unit's 30th anniversary celebration upside down...

fields.title: Yumi's Cells
fields.description: A cell-stimulating, relatable romance depicting the story of ordinary Yumi, who eats, loves, and grows.

fields.title: Unusual! Chef Moon
fields.description: A healing romantic comedy drama set in the star-filled, moonlit Seoha Village, where world-renowned fashion designer Yu Bella, who has lost her memory and turned into a wild, trouble-making troublemaker, meets star chef Moon Seung-mo and creates growth, love, and success.

fields.title: temptation
fields.description: A melodrama about a man who receives a seductive offer and searches for the true meaning of love amidst the relationships that follow.

fields.title: Hurray for My Life
fields.description:
This is a heartwarming story of comfort and healing, in which viewers can find themselves strengthening their will to live through the struggles of a young single mother whom they would want to cheer on and treat to a meal if they were her neighbors—a story of a resilient woman who rises again even after falling like Candy.

Unlike lives where one merely colors in a pre-determined blueprint, Dong-hee’s story—where she draws her own blueprint and fills it in—will offer much more colorful, exciting entertainment and touching emotions.

I hope this story prompts us to contemplate together what growth and success are required by the times, and what constitutes good and evil.

It aims to capture values that transcend generations by resonating with those living in the present while speaking of love, an eternal truth.

fields.title: Eulachacha Waikiki
fields.description: Three young men dreaming of becoming a film director, an actor, and a writer. They opened a guesthouse to earn money for their own movie, but reality is practically a failure; everything they do reeks of utter disaster. What are they going to do? Armed with an epic laugh riot, the story of these youths begins! A comedic drama depicting the dreams, friendship, and love of young people living in this era.

fields.title: Secretly Greatly
fields.description: North Korea's Special Operations Unit 5446. Won Ryu-hwan, the top elite agent who beat a 20,000:1 competition ratio; Lee Hae-rang, the son of a high-ranking Republic official and a man of skills comparable to Ryu-hwan's; and Lee Hae-jin, the youngest spy ever dispatched to the South in the Republic's history. These three are legendary figures within Unit 5446. However, despite being dispatched with the grand mission of national reunification, their assigned tasks are absurdly to become a slum idiot, an aspiring singer, and a high school student. Time passes without any orders being delivered, and they grow accustomed to a daily life rubbing shoulders with the lowest class of people in the South Korean slums. Then, one day, a completely unexpected, secret, and great mission is bestowed upon them.

fields.title: Eunju's Room
fields.description: A drama depicting the single life and interior design of a woman on leave who restores her own life and the lives of others through DIY interior design.

fields.title: Emergency Couple
fields.description: A romantic comedy drama about Oh Jin-hee and Oh Chang-min, a couple who divorced six years ago and are sworn enemies, reuniting as late-blooming interns in a hospital emergency room.

fields.title: Reply 1988
fields.description: There is a woman who is neither part of the 386 generation nor the "880,000 Won Generation," yet still does not want to be called part of the established generation. She is Sung Deok-sun, born in 1971, the year said to be the most common in South Korea. At forty-five, she is a woman of this age. In 1988, when Deok-sun was eighteen, the Seoul Olympics—the greatest event since the nation's founding—took place; in 1989, when she took the college entrance exam, the Berlin Wall fell. In 1990, when she entered university, MBC Radio's "Bae Cheol-soo's Music Camp" began. Because the era in which one lives is special to everyone, she remembers those days vividly. The yellow bag of fried chicken her father used to bring home on payday. Her mother, who would tuck her father's rice bowl deep under the blankets. "Three Families Under One Roof," which the whole family watched together, sitting close by. She remembers the neighbors in the alley—front, next door, and behind her—who shared everything with one another. These past memories linger faintly, causing her to toss and turn at night, yet serving as a stepping stone for living today. <Reply 1988> is a story about the time we have spent, and a message of comfort and encouragement to those who spent their youth in those days, and to the youth of today. It is a love song dedicated to everyone living, enduring, and doing well in the present; it will take us on a journey to those days that were as short as the spring season and passed by in a fleeting moment like youth.

fields.title: Reply 1994
fields.description: We return to 1994, the most eventful year of the 20th century—a time when Generation X and the New Generation were the symbols of youth, and even for that audacious new breed, analog communication was more familiar than digital. It was a time when Kim Gun-mo's songs blared from the Billboard charts and basketball courts were filled with the cheers of his "Oppa" fan club. It was 1994, a time when students tossed and turned all night due to pager messages, and on campus, romance took precedence over TOEIC scores, and dreams over grades. Reply once again.

fields.title: Reply 1997
fields.description: During the teenage years of the 2030 generation, who were enthusiastic about Seo Taiji and obsessed with H.O.T and Sechs Kies, fathers faced the IMF crisis, brothers swept the streets in hip-hop pants, and mothers lived immersed in dramas. Now, as time passes and people in their 20s and 30s lead busy lives, half of the conversations they have over a glass of soju after work revolve around their own pasts—stories of those days. Stories of the 90s that we enjoyed and savored. Although we are now worn down by money and the world, their 90s were incomparably brilliant. Through Sung Shi-won, an ordinary office worker born in 1980, we return to our own glamorous 90s.

fields.title: Doctor John
fields.description: This is the story of doctors who do their utmost to ensure that patients are not in pain, even if they cannot be saved or cured; it is the story of pain specialists who track down the causes of the pain plaguing our bodies, much like detectives catching a criminal. Set against the backdrop of a pain clinic, the stories of patients suffering from acute and chronic pain of unknown origin portray the process of uncovering the mysterious causes of their pain in an exciting, investigative style, much like a crime thriller.

fields.title: Come here and give me a hug
fields.description: A drama depicting the tragic fate of a man and a woman whose lives are intertwined due to a murder case.

fields.title: Lee Mong
fields.description: A spy action drama set in Joseon during the Japanese colonial period, featuring Lee Young-jin, a Korean doctor raised by Japanese hands, and Kim Won-bong, the leader of the armed secret society Uiyeoldan. It is a journey to trace the footsteps of those who lived in the shadows for the independence of their country and people.

fields.title: imitation
fields.description: A program that will serve as a tribute to idols, supporting all stars dreaming of becoming the real deal, in line with the era of the "1 Million Idol Entertainment Exam."

fields.title: Because This Is My First Life
fields.description: A pragmatic romance drama unfolds as Yoon Ji-ho, a 'homeless' woman who envies shell-bearing snails more than anything in the world, and Nam Se-hee, a 'house-poor' landlord whose only home is the front door, live together. Ji-ho (Jung So-min), born in '88 and celebrating her 30th birthday, faces the greatest ordeal of her life. She becomes homeless overnight due to her younger brother, her long-time roommate, getting pregnant before marriage! Meanwhile, Se-hee (Lee Min-ki), a 'house-poor' man born in '81, faces the crisis of failing to pay next month's rent after his housemate moves out... Amidst this predicament, Ji-ho moves into a townhouse as a housemate through an introduction from her friend Ho-rang (Kim Ga-eun). She firmly believes the landlord is an 'older sister' named Nam Se-hee, born in '80...

fields.title: Check out the event
fields.description: An emotional trip melodrama that unfolds as ex-lovers participate in a couples' trip they won in an event.

fields.title: The farewell has left.
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of two vastly different women—one in her 50s and the other in her 20s, one married and the other single—living together, exploring conflicts with a husband's mistress and the reality of having to set aside one's own identity due to marriage and pregnancy.

fields.title: eve
fields.description: 13 years of planning, a life-risking revenge. The most intense and deadly high-class passionate melodrama and revenge drama to bring down South Korea's top 0.1%.

fields.title: The strange lawyer Woo Young-woo
fields.description: A drama that began airing on ENA in June 2022. Young-woo, who possesses a genius mind while simultaneously having autism spectrum disorder, embodies both strengths and weaknesses. While Young-woo’s strengths are so exceptional that most of us cannot even approach them, her weaknesses are so vulnerable that most of us would be shocked. Woo Young-woo, who graduated at the top of her class from Seoul National University Law School and passed the bar exam, becomes a lawyer at the large law firm, Hanbada. As a rookie lawyer and a woman with autism spectrum disorder, she navigates various challenges both inside and outside the courtroom.

fields.title: Flower Boy Next Door
fields.description: A romantic drama that unfolds when Go Dok-mi, an urban Rapunzel character who has locked herself away in a castle while harboring her wounds, is caught secretly watching the man next door by the younger, handsome Enrique Geum.

fields.title: Itaewon Class
fields.description: Amidst an unreasonable world, a ‘hip’ rebellion begins among youths united by stubbornness and audacity. Itaewon, a place that seems to encapsulate the entire world. On this small street, the entrepreneurial legends of those pursuing freedom based on their own values unfold. Park Sae-ro-yi dropped out of high school and became a convicted criminal because he could not bring himself to kneel even once. Having lost his dreams and family due to the abuse of power by a chaebol, he stumbled upon the streets of Itaewon while in the depths of endless abyss. Diverse races, stylish exotic architecture, free-spirited people, and delicious cuisine from various nations. Feeling a sense of freedom in Itaewon—a place that felt like a microcosm of the world—he harbored hope once again and begins a business with like-minded colleagues in the Itaewon alley he had fallen in love with.

fields.title: all or nothing
fields.description: A desperate project to find justice by Lee Jung-joo, the court's self-proclaimed "troublemaker judge" determined to uncover her brother's secret, and Sa Ui-hyun, a sophisticated elite judge who gets entangled with her.

fields.title: Extracurricular
fields.description: A model student at school, a clever criminal outside of it. His secret double life was perfect. Until a classmate took an interest in his dangerous business.

fields.title: No Longer Human
fields.description: A woman and a man who had been wandering the maze of life without a goal. Meeting at a crossroads of life, the two now seek to harbor a new hope. A desperate hope that they can find their true selves.

fields.title: Queen Inhyeon's Man
fields.description: A time-slip romance drama depicting the love that transcends time and space between Kim Bung-do, a handsome scholar from the Joseon Dynasty who travels back 300 years to restore Queen Inhyeon to the throne, and Choi Hee-jin, an unknown actress who played the role of Queen Inhyeon in the 2012 drama *New Jang Hee-bin*.

fields.title: Clean it hot first.
fields.description: A male CEO of a cleaning company who lives and dies by cleanliness. A female job seeker who doesn't care whether cleanliness is something you eat or wear. These two, like oil and water, met and bickered, but wait, is there a sweet vibe? Will the man get rid of his germophobia, or will the woman shed her filth? I'm so curious!

fields.title: Reasonable love
fields.description: First love arrived after marriage. The wife fell in love. A cheerful and refreshing story about a lovely couple destined for each other.

fields.title: The joys and sorrows of work
Iljimae
