fields.description: The story takes place during the Joseon Dynasty. A man who has become a hero of the people steals from corrupt officials and distributes the wealth to the poor, dreaming of revenge for the unjust suffering his family endured.

fields.title: Giant
fields.description: Three siblings, scattered by the betrayal of a close acquaintance, reunite after several years. Risking everything to avenge their father's death, they stand against a powerful figure at the center of a massive conspiracy.

fields.title: Self-luminous office
fields.description: Howon, a job seeker who jumped into the Han River, is barely rescued and taken to the emergency room where he learns that he might be terminally ill. After this, he is reborn as a 'super underdog' contract employee who speaks his mind.

fields.title: Little Women
fields.description: A drama that passionately and thrillingly portrays the journey of three sisters, raised in poverty but with deep affection, as they get swept up in a massive incident and stand against the wealthiest and most influential family in South Korea to solve the mystery of life known as 'money'.

fields.title: I want to do well
fields.description: A sex-themed romance story about three female students taking a summer sex and love class who clash over their differing views on sex, but gradually accept each other and reach a turning point in their respective romantic relationships.

fields.title: Playful kiss
fields.description: This is the Korean drama adaptation of the Japanese manga *Itazura na Kiss*. It is a coming-of-age story about two people united by a playful kiss who influence each other as they discover their self-identities.

fields.title: Rosy Lovers
fields.description: A drama that portrays hope through the protagonist and their family, who, despite suffering a major setback at a young age, do not give up but rise again to find answers and happiness in life.

fields.title: Jang Ok-jeong, Living for Love
fields.description: A drama that reexamines the story of Jang Ok-jeong—a woman who sought to transcend the shackles of her social status as a professional courtier—and highlights King Sukjong Yi Sun's political charisma and absolute love, rather than the clichéd tales of court intrigue.

fields.title: Jang Hee-bin
fields.description: A drama about the story of Lady Jang Hee-bin, who lived a turbulent life with her wit and beauty.

fields.title: Jugglers
fields.description: An office drama unfolding as a secretary and a boss, featuring a passive woman who has lived by a spirit of devotion and obedience as a supporter and a man who completely rejects the attention and relationships of others.

fields.title: Would you like to have dinner together?
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of a man and a woman whose romantic feelings have atrophied due to the scars of a breakup and a culture of solitude, as they recover their emotions and rediscover love through the medium of dinner. Do-hee flies to Jeju Island to celebrate Young-dong's birthday, but is left in shock after witnessing him cheating there. Hae-kyung mistakes Do-hee, who has climbed onto the rocks by the seashore, for attempting suicide and jumps in to save her, only to fall into the sea himself...

fields.title: Justice
fields.description: A social thriller about Lee Tae-kyung, a corrupt lawyer who made a deal with the devil for revenge, and Song Woo-yong, a man who became evil himself for the sake of his family, clashing in the midst of a serial disappearance of actresses to uncover the hidden dark side of South Korea's VVIPs.

fields.title: Hometown of Legends
fields.description: A special horror drama based on legends and folk tales passed down across the Korean Peninsula

fields.title: The legendary witch
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of four inmates incarcerated in cell number 10 on the second floor of Cheongju Women's Prison

fields.title: Jeon Woo-chi
fields.description: A fusion martial arts historical drama based on the classic novel *Jeon Woo-chi-jeon*, telling the story of Jeon Woo-chi, a Taoist from Yuldo Kingdom who dreams of revenge after losing Hong Gil-dong, whom he regarded as a father, and Hong Mu-yeon, the woman he loved, due to a friend's betrayal.

fields.title: Absolutely him
fields.description: A steamy, soft, sweet, and thrilling romance unfolds between Dada, a special effects makeup artist with a heart of cold steel from a past heartbreak, and Zero Nine, a lover-type figure with a passionately burning pink heart.

fields.title: The Third Charm
fields.description: In a particularly exhausting, cold winter, a romance can begin simply by warmly holding hands and tucking them into a pocket... yet in the summer, a trivial argument born of temperature, humidity, and discomfort can cause you to let go and break up. In this way, romance approaches us with a different face with every season. This drama tells the story of a man and a woman passing through the spring of their twenties, the summer of their twenty-sevens, and the autumn and winter of their thirty-twos together. It is a romantic fantasy where their connection, forged with different faces in each season, becomes a small, ordinary destiny. Whether successful or not, old or young, while walking the enchanting thorny path of romance, nothing goes according to plan, and nothing is ever easy. Indeed, romance is difficult. This drama will highlight the reality of love, a world where we laugh happily, shed tears, and get hurt. We will talk about the raw truth of our relationships, where we hurt each other and were hurt. Rather than the completion of a fated romance that we would risk our lives to protect overcoming hardships and adversity, it will likely be a dating documentary that shows the unfortunate reality of that precious romance wavering, cracking, and breaking apart.

fields.title: The 5th Republic
fields.description: A full-fledged political drama that vividly portrays the rise and fall of the Fifth Republic. It covers events ranging from the October 26 Incident in 1979 to the December 12 Coup, the May 17 Coup, the Gwangju Democratization Movement of 1980, the Fifth Republic, the June Struggle of 1987, the June 29 Declaration, the establishment of the Sixth Republic, the imprisonment of Chun Doo-hwan and Roh Tae-woo during the Kim Young-sam administration, and the special pardons of Chun Doo-hwan and Roh Tae-woo during the 15th presidential election of the Republic of Korea.

fields.title: Please don't meet that man
fields.description: A romantic comedy drama that unfolds as Seo Ji-sung, who wants to fall in love but avoid making mistakes, creates an AI refrigerator named 'Ancestral God'.

fields.title: King of Baking, Kim Tak-gu
fields.description: Kim Tak-gu is the eldest son of Gu Il-joong of Geoseong Foods; he is rustic and has a simple personality. Once he decides something is right, he never changes it. He possesses a kind charm that moves people with his honesty and sincerity. Anyone who has tasted Kim Tak-gu's sincerity even once eventually becomes his fan. The power to win people over with such a heart—that is the destiny Kim Tak-gu was born with. After many twists and turns, he enters the Geoseong family as the eldest son, but is eventually driven out due to a conspiracy. Starting from the bottom, he overcomes all kinds of adversity and trials, eventually inheriting baking skills from Master Palbong, a descendant of Gaeseong merchants and the hidden godfather of the baking industry. Possessing a natural talent for baking and a keen sense of smell, and grounded in his kind heart, he is reborn as a true baker.

fields.title: The Emperor's Daughter, Soo Baek-hyang
fields.description: A historical drama depicting the life of Soo Baek-hyang, the daughter of King Muryeong of Baekje, capturing the turbulent family history of the Baekje Kingdom and their tragic love story.

fields.title: Joseon psychiatrist Yu Se-pung
fields.description: Yoo Se-pung, a genius physician who cannot administer acupuncture, meets Seo Eun-woo, a widow with a twist, and his eccentric mentor Gye Ji-han at the strange and beautiful Gyesu Clinic, and is reborn as a spiritual doctor. A prescription for happiness from Joseon Dynasty psychiatrists who offer warm remedies to the sick and deliver a satisfying blow to the villains!

fields.title: Joseon Romantic Comedy: The Tale of Nokdu
fields.description: A cheeky and delightful Joseon-era romantic comedy about Jeon Nok-du, who infiltrates a mysterious village of widows disguised as a woman, and Dong Dong-ju, a woman with a twist who doesn't want to become a gisaeng. Nok-du, who lived on a remote island, is attacked one day by unidentified warriors and chases after them to the mainland. Amidst the chaos, he meets a mysterious 'handsome' man and ends up imprisoned with him...

fields.title: operation
fields.description: A controversial reporter from a tabloid, a journalist from a major media outlet, and a prosecutor from the violent crimes division join forces to uncover the truth behind an incident that shook their lives five years ago.

fields.title: Zombie Detective
fields.description: A zombie-human comic drama about a zombie in his second year of resurrection who becomes a detective and struggles to find his past.

fields.title: palm tree forest
fields.description: Kim In-seo (played by Kim Min-jong), a young and capable lawyer, boards a bus bound for Gangneung for a special lecture at a university, only to suddenly spot Choi Seong-ju (played by Lee Ah-hyun), a woman who has been following him. She is a confident and attractive career woman with whom he had a blind date the previous evening. However, despite Seong-ju's aggressive advances, In-seo remains surprisingly composed... instead, with a face as melancholic as the winter landscape, he recounts his buried love story. Two years ago, In-seo arrived at a shipyard on Geoje Island for patent matters. On the day of his arrival, while building rapport with the workers through foot volleyball, he met Hwa-yeon (played by Kim Yu-mi), a field worker and transporter. In-seo feels an intense desire for her unspoiled innocence and charm hidden within her rough wilderness, and approaches her as if it were a joke. In-seo's seemingly playful proposal to date for just one year hurts Hwa-yeon's feelings, and at a company dinner, she becomes unable to control her emotions and gets completely drunk. In-seo ends up escorting the intoxicated woman home. Carrying Hwa-yeon on his back, he struggles up the hill of Gonggoji where her house is located. It is a lonely, isolated house by the sea, where exotic palm trees cover the mountain. Three women live there in solitude: Hwa-yeon, her grandmother, and Hwa-yeon's mother, who has suffered a stroke. The grandmother welcomes In-seo warmly, and In-seo asks about the palm forest that fills the hill. Palm trees that have become a forest of endless longing while waiting for a love that never returned. As In-seo listens to the secret and heartbreaking stories of the three women intertwined with the palm forest, he suddenly feels a lump in his throat from his love for Hwa-yeon. However, Hwa-yeon's heart, filled with hatred and vowing to burn down the palm forest rather than live waiting for a futile love like her mother or grandmother, refuses to accept In-seo. Ultimately, In-seo leaves Hwa-yeon behind on the island and heads to Seoul as if fleeing. Will In-seo ever be able to forget Hwa-yeon? Will the 'Palm Tree Forest' really be able to help them achieve true love?

fields.title: Love Alarm
fields.description: Someone likes me. An alarm rings when the person who likes you approaches within a 10-meter radius. In the era of "Love Alarm," an app that reveals feelings, a miraculous, innocent love finds its way to Jojo, a girl for whom making a living is the hardest part of life. When Sun-oh, a popular former model, transfers to the school, Jojo and Sun-oh confirm their feelings for each other. Hye-young, who started liking Jojo first, takes a step back, but she cannot give up on her feelings for her...

fields.title: Master's Sun
fields.description: A romantic comedy horror drama about a stingy, greedy, and self-centered boss and a gloomy, tearful, and spiritually gifted female employee who appease souls with scary yet sad stories.

fields.title: I'd rather die
fields.description: A drama depicting the chaotic office battle between the arrogant Team Leader Baek Jin-sang and Assistant Manager Lee Ru-da, who tries to turn him around.

fields.title: I can't stand losing
fields.description: A romantic comedy drama depicting the story of a lawyer couple facing divorce.

fields.title: Our school right now is
fields.description: The high school that became the starting point of the zombie virus outbreak. The students trapped here must desperately find a way out. Otherwise, they will simply become infected and turn into zombies.

fields.title: We are breaking up right now.
fields.description: A sweet, salty, spicy, sour, and bitter breakup actually written as ‘farewell’ but read as ‘love’

fields.title: hell
fields.description: One day, people are sentenced to hell by a strange entity. In the heart of Seoul, in full view of everyone, those who receive this notification from hell are invariably dragged away by its messengers at the scheduled time. Amidst the arrival of an era of great chaos in a city engulfed in shock and fear, Jung Jin-soo, the chairman of the emerging religious group New Truth Society, preaches to the people that this is truly God's execution taking place in the real world. Meanwhile, some fight against the New Truth Society to uncover the truth behind the events.

fields.title: A real showdown
fields.description: An action-packed investigative drama about a rogue prosecutor who satisfyingly shatters the sanctuary created by wealth and power, as well as the forces of evil living within it. Jin Jeong is a maverick, a rogue prosecutor unlike any other in the history of the prosecution. One day, while handling only trivial cases day after day, a murder case in Seocho-dong is assigned to him. The suspect is Kim Hyo-jun, a delivery driver in his 20s. However, Jeong instinctively senses that he is not the culprit, and while the entire prosecution is urging him to indict Kim Hyo-jun, he begins to investigate the case alone...

fields.title: truth
fields.description: A story about the love and friendship between high school classmates Jayoung and Shinhee.

fields.title: To reach your heart
fields.description: A "Space Goddess" fake-employment romance begins when Oh Yoon-seo, Korea's top actress who suddenly appeared at a law firm like something out of a drama, meets the perfectionist lawyer Kwon Jung-rok. Oh Jin-shim (stage name Oh Yoon-seo), the "Space Goddess," declared a temporary retirement due to a scandal. Desperate for a comeback, Jin-shim visits star writer Lee Se-jin to appear in her drama. After much deliberation, the writer presents a "condition." Kwon Jung-rok, the ace lawyer at Always Law Firm, hears the news that Oh Yoon-seo is coming to work as his secretary. Jung-rok is dumbfounded by Jin-shim's first-day outfit, which resembles a runway show, while Jin-shim is also displeased that Jung-rok treats "Space Goddess Oh Yoon-seo" as nothing more than a parachute hire...

fields.title: Jealousy Incarnate
fields.description: A love triangle romance where a macho journalist who knew nothing of jealousy and a chaebol meet a struggling weathercaster and beg for affection while their styles are ruined by jealousy.

fields.title: Jinx's Lover
fields.description: A fantasy romance drama about a human man who accepts his unfortunate life as fate and lives in resignation, and a goddess who leaps into an unknown world to break a curse, as they overcome a cruel destiny.

fields.title: The Good Witch
fields.description: A hilarious double life drama about an 'angelic housewife' teetering precariously between being a 'witch' and a 'pushover'

fields.title: Brilliant Legacy
fields.description: A drama about the inheritance of a food conglomerate family and the reclaiming of family love.

fields.title: Stairway to Heaven
fields.description: Cha Song-ju returns from overseas dreaming of reuniting with her longtime love. However, their fate goes awry when Han Jeong-seo loses her memory in an accident.

fields.title: Tears of Heaven
fields.description: "Tears of Heaven" is an MBN special drama that aired from October 11, 2014, to January 3, 2015.

fields.title: 1,000 Won Lawyer
fields.description: A courtroom action drama about a '1,000-won lawyer' with the best skills but a 1,000-won fee fighting against wealthy 'legal trickster' lawyers.

fields.title: A Thousand Days' Promise
fields.description: This is a drama depicting the pure and devoted love story of a man who protects his love for a woman who is losing her memory.

fields.title: Queen Cheorin
fields.description: A soul-swapping scandal unfolds between Queen Kim So-yong, who gains 'out-of-this-world energy' after an unexpected accident takes over her body from the soul of Korea's quintessential show-off, and King Cheoljong, a king with two faces.

fields.title: First love
fields.description: Aired in 1996, this KBS2 weekend drama gained immense popularity with average viewership ratings exceeding 40% and a single episode surpassing 60% during its run. Set from the 1980s to the present day, it depicts the first love and strong brotherhood of young people transcending social class barriers.

fields.title: First love is because it is the first time
fields.description: Twenty-year-old independence, ready to get wild. Tae-o dreams of a passionate romance. However, when his friends barge into his house for their own reasons, an unexpected, chaotic cohabitation begins. Just where does friendship end and fling begin? Complete novices—struggling because it’s their first time in life and their first love—have gathered in one house.

fields.title: Alice in Cheongdam-dong
fields.description: A drama that reflects on the wealth that dominates South Korea and the true meaning of marriage through a protagonist who starts as a hardworking "Candy" but becomes a hardworking "Cinderella" after declaring that she will no longer live as one.

fields.title: Youth Record
fields.description: A drama chronicling the growth of young people striving to achieve their dreams and love on their own, without despairing in the face of the harsh realities of life. Hye-jun is working hard toward his dream of becoming an actor after working as a model. However, the path ahead is nothing but arduous. He is betrayed by Tae-su, the agency CEO he trusted, and is constantly compared to his friend Hae-hyo, who shares the same dream. Just then, a conscription notice arrives for Hye-jun...

fields.title: Age of Youth
fields.description: A cheerful and lively youth drama about five charming female college students, all different in appearance, personality, major, taste in men, and dating style, who live together in the share house Belle Époque. It depicts the continuing shared joys and sorrows of the Belle Époque friends, who thought their 20s would only shine brightly. It is the story of these women for whom making money and dating are not easy.

fields.title: I Love You at First Sight
fields.description: A drama depicting the self-discovery of a cold-blooded boss who only truly sees people after losing his sight, and the romance of a secretary who falls in love with him after deceiving him.

fields.title: chocolate
fields.description: A heartwarming human drama about love, in which a chef from the World Culinary Competition in Italy and a neurosurgeon comfort each other and offer meals to hospice patients. Spring 1992. Young Kang serves a heartfelt meal to young Cha-young, who visits the Sea Restaurant. A warm-hearted boy dreaming of becoming a chef and a pure girl who cries with happiness. The two promise to meet again, but tragically, they miss each other. Time passes, and Cha-young, who coincidentally runs into Kang now a successful neurosurgeon, recognizes him as her childhood first love and cannot hide her fluttering heart.

fields.title: Bachelor's Vegetable Shop
fields.description: A TV drama about the work, dreams, and love of healthy young people who do their best in their jobs

fields.title: The Prime Minister and I
fields.description: A drama depicting a love story that unfolds when a mother arrives like a Christmas gift to the Prime Minister's family, who are '100 points at work, 0 points at childcare.'

fields.title: The Strongest Deliveryman
fields.description: A fast-paced, accurate, and passionate youth delivery drama depicting a thrilling turnaround for lives that have nothing but a delivery box.

fields.title: You're the Best, Lee Soon-shin
fields.description: It is the story of a mother and her youngest daughter's search for happiness and love, after they are swept into an unexpected whirlwind of fate triggered by the father's death.

fields.title: The Best Marriage
fields.description: A drama depicting the love and marriage stories of four different couples, centering on a woman who voluntarily became a single mother.

fields.title: The Greatest Love
fields.description: A drama depicting the romance between a washed-up female celebrity, a former girl group member who has fallen out of favor and is barely making a living in the entertainment industry, and a male actor at the peak of his popularity. It is a drama written by Hong Jung-eun and Hong Mi-ran, known for works such as 'You're Beautiful' and 'Fantasy Couple'.

fields.title: The Best Divorce
fields.description: Starting with the question, "Is marriage really the culmination of love?", this romantic comedy drama humorously and honestly portrays the differences in men's and women's perspectives on love, marriage, and family.

fields.title: The best herbal medicine
fields.description: A chaotic drama about the youth of this era in their 20s, fiercely contemplating love, relationships, and making a living. Yoo Hyun-jae (Yoon Shi-yoon), the most popular star of the 90s, is transported to 2017 in 1993 along with a typhoon named 'Kaola'. Best friends Woo-seung (Lee Se-young) and Ji-hoon (Kim Min-jae) meet at a police station due to their respective misunderstandings. As Woo-seung and Ji-hoon leave the station and head home in their car, they accidentally hit Hyun-jae, who suddenly runs out into the road...

fields.title: Chuno
fields.description: A fierce story revolving around slave hunters chasing runaway slaves, the intertwined destinies and emotions of those surrounding them, and the struggle for status and freedom.

fields.title: Queen of Mystery
fields.description: A slice-of-life mystery drama in which Seol-ok, who has thrown away her basket, and Wan-seung, who has returned leading a formidable team of detectives, solve cases big and small and uncover hidden truths.

fields.title: Declaration of Candidacy
fields.description: A lighthearted, comedic political office drama featuring the stories of young people who chose to run for office over employment, and "political masters" in their respective legislators. Sera, nicknamed "The Moth," known as the neighborhood's "Complaint Queen," gets caught up in an accidental incident while filing complaints and even wins the Brave Citizen Award, but is unfairly fired from her company on the same day and applies for a part-time administrative assistant job at the district office's civil affairs department. Gong Myung, an elite official demoted to the civil affairs department who is exhausted from handling Sera's complaints, recognizes her during the interview and hires her on the spot...

fields.title: Cheer up
fields.description: A hot and chilling campus mystery romantic comedy about the youths gathered in a failing university cheerleading squad, leaving a glorious history behind.

fields.title: Dear Judge
fields.description: The delightful end of those who coveted the lives of others! Extraordinary intellect, striking good looks. There are brothers who share every gene but live completely different lives: Suho and Gangho. Han Suho, the "Computer Judge" who never once deviated from sentencing guidelines, has disappeared. His younger brother, Han Gangho, has quietly taken his place; drawing on the "practical legal knowledge" he acquired while serving five previous convictions, he begins delivering unprecedentedly bold rulings. Rehabilitation. The slogan he shouted morning and evening in prison! Literally, his life has begun anew. From a scorned ex-convict to a beloved judge, from human trash to the number one choice for marriage, from the family's scoundrel to the family's treasure. But can the old me really change completely into the current me? If I suddenly become "something" one day, will all my desires be fulfilled? If those desires are fully satisfied, will there no longer be any lack? This story is the journey of those who coveted the lives of others as they find their own lives.

fields.title: Kind Geum-ja
fields.description: Geum-ja, possessing beauty striking enough to instantly captivate people's attention, commits a crime at the age of 20 and ends up in prison. Due to her young age and stunning looks, she gains notoriety in the media even at the moment of her arrest. Geum-ja leads a more diligent and exemplary life in prison than anyone else. "Kind Geum-ja" is a nickname given to her by the people, reflecting the fame she enjoyed even within the prison. The moment she is released after safely completing her 13-year sentence, Geum-ja begins the revenge she has been meticulously planning. The person she seeks revenge against is Mr. Baek, the man who made her a criminal. The fellow inmates she helped with kindness now assist her in her vengeance in various ways.

fields.title: Kairos
fields.description: 10:33. Just one minute to change destiny. When the phone rings, a one-minute collaboration that transcends time begins! A time-crossing thriller in which Seo-jin, a man from the future who must find his kidnapped young daughter, and Ae-ri, a woman from the past who must save her lost mother, struggle to “cross time” for their loved ones.

fields.title: Woman with a Suitcase
fields.description: Geum-ju (Choi Ji-woo), a successful office manager at the Yale Law Firm in Seocho-dong, carries around a large travel suitcase named 'Juju' filled with court documents and handles cases at all hours. Geum-ju accidentally takes on a case involving the attempted murder of an unidentified homeless girl, and as a result, she falls from grace overnight...

fields.title: Shall we have a cup of coffee?
fields.description: An emotional human drama depicting the journey of rookie barista Kang Go-bi, who jumped into the world of coffee with nothing but pure passion, as she learns about coffee and people while becoming the apprentice of coffee master Park Seok.

fields.title: Coffee Prince
fields.description: As you ride the bus, the people passing in front of tall buildings look very small and insignificant. However, aren't it people who built those buildings and who realize their dreams and hopes within them? A city can easily appear bleak. What enriches and warms that city is likely the sweat and laughter of those striving toward their dreams and hopes. Just as cross-stitch creates a grand masterpiece from individual stitches, the vibrant lives of people fill every corner of the city. Our lives, full of twists and turns, are far from ordinary and cannot be taken lightly by anyone. Among them, this is a hopeful story depicting the love and dreams of verdant youth.

fields.title: Color Rush
fields.description: To his eyes, the world is gray. Mono Yeon-woo, who suffers from neuro-colorblindness, transfers to a new school carrying painful memories of his missing mother. Upon seeing the face of Yuhan, whom he meets there, all the colors of the world suddenly pour out. Has Mono met his fated counterpart, Probe?

fields.title: The Heroine Chunhyang
fields.description: Chunhyang has returned. She has cast off the stifling hanbok and headscarf and returned as a quirky, lively, and spirited Chunhyang, dressed in a crop top and jeans.

fields.title: Crazy Love
fields.description: A sweet, bloody, chaotic, crazy romance drama about a scumbag top instructor threatened with murder and a terminally ill secretary.

fields.title: Cross
fields.description: The story of Kang In-gyu, a genius doctor harboring a thirst for revenge while moving between a hospital and a prison, and Go Jeong-hoon, a humanist doctor who embraces even his anger, as they meet and a series of unpredictable events unfold that completely shake their lives.

fields.title: Criminal Minds
fields.description: The Korean version of 'Criminal Minds' is a drama about the exploits of agents from the National Crime Information Agency (NCI) Behavioral Analysis Team who investigate brutal criminals, including the mentally ill, sociopaths, and terrorists, using profiling techniques. It deeply portrays the daily lives of the agents and their investigative work as profilers who view cases from the criminal's perspective and predict their movements by deciphering the behavior, cognition, and thoughts of unidentified offenders through thorough profiling rather than simple evidence collection. By dramatizing the cases to suit the Korean context and enhancing the characters' backstories and drama, it is reborn as a Korean-style psychological crime investigation drama that offers thrills, drama, and action—all of which domestic viewers accustomed to genre dramas will rave about.

fields.title: Classic
fields.description: Ji-hye and Su-kyung, who attend the same university, both like Sang-min, a senior in the drama club. However, the overly enthusiastic Su-kyung asks Ji-hye to ghostwrite a letter for him, and Ji-hye confesses her own feelings for Sang-min under Su-kyung's name. As Su-kyung and Sang-min grow closer after being brought together by Ji-hye's letter, Ji-hye tries to distance herself from him due to a baseless sense of guilt, yet they keep running into each other by chance. Meanwhile, Ji-hye, who lost her father at an early age, lives alone with her mother, Ju-hee, who is currently traveling abroad. While cleaning the attic to fill the void left by her mother, Ji-hye accidentally discovers her mother's secret box and gradually comes to understand her mother's classic love story.

fields.title: Shall we kiss first?
fields.description: A clumsy melodrama for mature people: "A single kiss revives dead romance cells. And... true love..."

fields.title: Kiss Six Sense
fields.description: Hong Ye-sul, the ace AE of Planning Team 1 at Jeu Planning, has a secret. It is the ability to see the future when her lips touch another person's body. One day, Ye-sul accidentally touches the lips of Min-hoo, her boss whom she detested, and sees a risqué future with him. On top of that, her ex-boyfriend Pil-si returns and asks Ye-sul for another chance.

fields.title: Kill Me, Heal Me
fields.description: A healing romance drama about a third-generation chaebol heir with seven personalities and a first-year female resident who becomes his secret physician.

fields.title: killer heels
fields.description: A war drama about the endless desires and desperate struggles of three women in a home shopping industry, featuring three women blinded by success and jealousy who wage a weaponless war.

fields.title: Kingdom
fields.description: A zombie series that began airing on Netflix in January 2019. Ominous rumors circulate surrounding the ailing King. Crown Prince Lee Chang, realizing that strange things are happening to the King, sets out to find the physician who treated him. Joseon is shrouded in darkness, and the land groans under a bizarre plague. Arriving in Jihyul-hyeon in Dongnae, he witnesses the true nature of the plague and fights alongside his bodyguard, Moo-young, to prevent the disease from spreading nationwide. The only hope to save the people against this unknown evil lies with the Crown Prince...

fields.title: Others Are Hell
fields.description: A thriller drama set in a strange boarding house that tells the story of suspicious people. One day, Yoon Jong-woo receives a phone call. It is Jae-ho, a college senior who has started a business in Seoul and needs help. Deeply bored with his aimless life back home, Jong-woo readily decides to move to the capital and settles into a dilapidated boarding house on the outskirts... The bizarre antics of the residents begin that very night! People disappear one by one, followed by a series of chilling situations. Jong-woo begins to feel increasingly confused, wondering if they are strange or if he is the strange one. And before he knows it, Jong-woo realizes that he is in the middle of hell...

fields.title: Times
fields.description: A massive upheaval strikes the once-uneventful life of reporter Seo Jeong-in. She wakes up to find the past reversed, and her father, who was clearly the President until yesterday, is dead. As she tracks down her father's suspicious death, a year passes, and upon arriving in 2020, another unbelievable event unfolds for Jeong-in. She manages to connect by phone with Lee Jin-woo from 2015, when her father was still alive...

fields.title: table tennis ball
fields.description: A unique buddy drama depicting the confusion and search for truth experienced by a young college student who meets a mysterious homeless person and feels a sense of kinship regarding an unfulfilled past love and undergoes emotional transference.

fields.title: Waving the Taegeukgi
fields.description: June 1950. Jin-tae, who works hard in Jongno, Seoul to support his family, maintains a lively and cheerful life despite the hardships, always striving for his marriage to his fiancée, Young-shin, and his younger brother Jin-seok's college admission—whom he cherishes more than anything in the world. One day in June, as an extra edition announcing the outbreak of war on the Korean Peninsula is distributed, the once peaceful city of Seoul is instantly filled with the sounds of sirens, explosions, and people's screams. Deciding to flee south, Jin-tae takes Young-shin and his family and joins the massive exodus, but upon arriving at Daegu Station to board the evacuation train, he is swept into a massive vortex of fate.

fields.title: Descendants of the Sun
fields.description: A blockbuster human melodrama that captures the value of life through young soldiers and doctors dreaming of love and success in the extreme environment of a foreign land. Set in Uruk, a fictional nation located on the Balkan Peninsula in Europe, the work portrays the camaraderie and fellowship of people who love and fall in love even in extreme situations, through the stories of soldiers and doctors dispatched to a strange land marred by war, disease, and extreme weather anomalies.

fields.title: Taejo Wang Geon
fields.description: A drama about the story of Wang Geon, who founded the Goryeo Dynasty

fields.title: Taxi driver
fields.description: Man-seop, a taxi driver, is a struggling family man raising an 11-year-old daughter after the death of his wife. Enticed by a promise of a substantial sum of 100,000 won—enough to pay off his overdue rent—if he takes a foreign passenger to Gwangju and returns before the curfew, he picks up German journalist Peter and sets off without knowing the full story. Peter, a reporter for a German public broadcaster, heads to Gwangju after hearing in Japan that "something unusual is happening in Gwangju." Thanks to Man-seop's quick thinking to collect the fare at all costs, they manage to bypass checkpoints and barely make it into Gwangju. Despite Man-seop's pleas to return to Seoul due to the danger, Peter begins filming with the help of college student Jae-sik and Driver Hwang...

fields.title: tunnel
fields.description: A crime investigation series in which the protagonist, searching for the killer of a series of female murders in 1986, time-slips to 2016, discovers a link between the past and the present, and solves the serial murder case from 30 years ago that has restarted.

fields.title: touch
fields.description:
Makeup is like our lives. Just as we apply makeup to cover up flaws and hide weaknesses, we strive to present a better version of ourselves to others.

However, this drama aims to convey the message that we shouldn't worry too much about showing our true selves through makeup,

and that we should become people who are confident in ourselves and cherish ourselves.

fields.title: Top Star Yoo Baek-i
fields.description: Top star Yoo Baek, a narcissistic city man brimming with self-esteem and self-love, is banished to Yeojukdo, a mysterious island that perfectly preserves pristine nature and the aesthetics of slow living, after causing a major scandal. This is a romance of civilization clash that unfolds as top star Yoo Baek begins living under the same roof with Oh Gang-soon, a rustic island girl packed with the guts to take down a wild boar with a headbutt.

fields.title: Two Cops
fields.description:
A slick con artist's soul invades the body of a homicide detective with an insatiable sense of justice?!

In an era where small fantasies offer comfort and hope, a "possession collaboration" between a homicide detective and a con artist united in one body for the sake of justice!

A fantasy investigative romance unfolds as a quirky detective and a sassy, audacious female reporter suddenly find themselves conducting a joint investigation with "two souls in one body"!

Those who were lacking individually become one and "us," giving birth to a truly crazy hero unlike anything seen before—something we have always wanted to see.

Through this hero, we aim to portray "humanity," the very foundation of any drama.

Now, let us laugh, be moved, and race together amidst the epic exploits of a lifetime they embark on.

fields.title: To Jenny
fields.description: A drama depicting the poignant story of a loser who is single his whole life and knows how to sing, creating music to win the heart of his crush from 10 years ago, whom he has never even made eye contact with.

fields.title: tracer
fields.description: A thrilling chase action film depicting the no-holds-barred exploits of a ruthless guy who landed in Tax Bureau 5, nicknamed the "garbage dump," a place scarier than judges and prosecutors for some.

fields.title: train
fields.description: Two worlds split by a split-second choice on the night of a murder! A parallel-world mystery drama about a detective who intervenes in a serial killing to protect his loved ones. Twelve years ago, Seo Do-won and Han Seo-kyung lost their fathers on the same day. In the present day of 2020, abandoned skeletal remains are discovered at the closed Mugeong Station, and Detective Do-won, who was chasing a prime suspect, heads to the station with clues to the case...

fields.title: Trot Lovers
fields.description: A comedic melodrama depicting the story of a woman in her 20s with a talent for trot who meets a genius composer and grows into a trot singer.

fields.title: Lovers in Paris
fields.description: A drama depicting the love between a prickly second-generation chaebol and an ordinary woman.

fields.title: warden
fields.description: A drama about people who form a group after losing loved ones to crime and having their ordinary lives shattered overnight, depicting the reality of our society where even the obvious principle that "bad deeds are punished" is difficult to uphold, and portraying the human spirit of overcoming pain and striving to realize justice.

fields.title: Fantastic
fields.description: Lee So-hye, a successful drama writer. Diagnosed with a terminal illness, she decides to spend time selfishly for the first time in her life, solely for herself, and fully enjoys the love of two men. This is an unpredictable romantic comedy depicting the thrilling, time-limited romance between Lee So-hye, a mentally strong drama writer who lives life to the fullest, and Ryu Hae-sung, a top star and master of bad acting full of eccentricity.

fields.title: Fashion King
fields.description: It is a drama that tells the story of people who start from Dongdaemun Market and succeed as world-class designers.

fields.title: Perfume
fields.description: In a world where being a full-time housewife isn't even recognized as a profession despite dedicating one's entire life to building a family—the foundation of the community—there is a woman who has fallen into despair after having her family taken away in her middle age. There is a man who stumbled and fell apart because he hesitated, lacking even the courage to try love. And there is a man who lost the meaning of life and became physically and mentally ill because he loved only one woman, yet was unable to love her. A once-in-a-lifetime miracle arrives in their lives, which were hurtling toward catastrophe! Will they truly be able to achieve their dreams and love this time? Dreaming of a world where everyone has a chance to try again, we invite you to the world of transformation fantasy, a second chance at life.

fields.title: Page Turner
fields.description: A coming-of-age drama about young people whose lives take a 180-degree turn after an unexpected accident involving a piano prodigy with genius sensibilities and an athlete with a bulldozer-like personality.

fields.title: Penthouse
fields.description: This is the story of a real estate success myth involving the distorted desires and motherhood of a woman who risks everything racing toward entering the top-floor penthouse, the symbol of Gangnam, only to gradually transform into a monster. It tells the story of a protagonist who obtains top-tier real estate information in exchange for remaining silent about a murder she witnessed by chance, seizes the last ticket to Gangnam, and chooses a completely different life to infiltrate high society and succeed in both real estate and education, as well as money and knowledge.

fields.title: Convenience Store Saetbyeol
fields.description: A 24-hour unpredictable comic romance unfolding at a convenience store between a quirky, four-dimensional part-timer and a charming, clumsy store manager. Choi Dae-hyun is a tall, handsome man with a warm heart. Jung Saet-byul possesses refreshing beauty and a quirky, four-dimensional personality. The two met three years ago when Dae-hyun was running errands for cigarettes. Choi Dae-hyun told her, “You should quit if you can; it rots your bones. Don't do that; try betting your youth on something cool!” That day, Dae-hyun became an unforgettable figure in Saet-byul's mind...

fields.title: Lovers at 3 PM on a Weekday
fields.description: The woman who loathed adultery falls into the very terrible affair she so despised, while the woman who enjoyed adultery like a sport falls into an unexpected, intense love. A coming-of-age drama about adults suffering a severe ordeal due to forbidden love.

fields.title: Forest
fields.description: A drama depicting characters driven by realistic desires gathering in a forest to heal the emotional wounds inflicted by unhappy memories and realize the true essence of happiness. Kang San-hyuk (Park Hae-jin), a cold-hearted M&A expert, misses out on a major deal due to phantom pain, and meets the passionate doctor Jung Young-jae (Jo Bo-ah) at Seoul Myeongseong Hospital, where he visits for treatment. San-hyuk and Young-jae, who thought they would never see each other again after growing tired of each other's arrogance, meet again in Mireung Forest due to a fateful event...

fields.title: Splash Splash LOVE
fields.description: This is a fantasy coming-of-age romance about Jang Dan-bi, a student who gave up on math, falling into a puddle in the Joseon Dynasty on the day of the college entrance exam, and the relationship she shares with King Yi Do. While it makes no sense when compared to actual history, it is a lighthearted fantasy drama that can be enjoyed without worrying about historical accuracy if watched casually.

fields.title: Legend of the Blue Sea
fields.description: A fantasy romance drama inspired by the mermaid story found in Eouyadam, Korea's first collection of folk tales. In August 1598 in Heupgok-hyeon, Gangwon-do, Dam-ryeong, who was serving in the military, stays overnight at Lady Yang's inn and meets the eyes of a beautiful mermaid trapped in a small pond in the inn's inner garden. Feeling pity for the mermaid, Dam-ryeong uses Lady Yang's crime as an excuse to release her back to the sea... and thus begins a long relationship....

fields.title: A woman of dignity
fields.description: Here lies a world where a multitude of desires reveal their bare faces and clamor. This is the story told by the intertwined lives of two women who face each other amidst this chaos, and the choices they make. The main setting and characters of this drama are the wealthy upper class located in the heart of Gangnam and the lower class striving to enter that society. Rather than the typical chaebols often portrayed in dramas, these are the quasi-chaebol wealthy class who have relatively easy access to the common people. Their raw struggles, power struggles, and the arrogant, hypocritical lives of the upper-class rich reveal their illusions and show cracks forming. There are no themes in dramas that have been overused as much as peeking into the upper class and adultery. However, a unique variation on these common themes will demonstrate how this drama differentiates itself from existing shows and just how special it is.

fields.title: I heard it through the grapevine
fields.description: A black comedy drama that uses scathing satire to criticize the snobbery of South Korea's ultra-elite upper class, who enjoy imperial power and dream of inheriting wealth and lineage.

fields.title: bubble gum
fields.description:
The drama *Bubble Gum* is not a story about people with deficiencies finally filling those gaps to become complete.

It will be a fairy tale for adults about how they became a little happier by being together while still harboring their own gaps.

fields.title: Lovers in Prague
fields.description: Sang-hyun, a low-ranking detective, heads to Prague after his girlfriend Hye-ju disappears and breaks up with him. In Prague, where English is not widely spoken, Sang-hyun gets pickpocketed and asks for help from Jae-hee, the President's daughter and a diplomat who happens to be passing by.

fields.title: Producer
fields.description: This is the story of the Entertainment Bureau on the 6th floor of KBS, the Korean Broadcasting System located in the heart of Yeouido, which never turns off its lights 24 hours a day, 365 days a year and is operated by the public's license fees.

fields.title: player
fields.description: South Korea, a country where people are arrested but money is not. A world where only the wealthy multiply their fortunes. From con artists and drivers to hackers and fighters, the best players in their respective fields team up to hunt down and steal the dirty money illegally amassed by the rich—a thrilling and exhilarating money-stealing action drama.

fields.title: defendant
fields.description: A chronicle of the struggle by prosecutor Park Jung-woo, a death row inmate falsely accused of murdering his daughter and wife, to recall the four months he lost, and a revenge story against the villain Cha Min-ho.

fields.title: Pinocchio
fields.description: A fresh youth drama depicting the lives and loves of social affairs reporters at a broadcasting station

fields.title: My One and Only
fields.description: A drama depicting the journey of a woman whose life is turned upside down by the appearance of her biological father after 28 years, and her father, who had to hide his identity, as they regain hope in life by meeting ‘the one and only person on their side.’

fields.title: One Hundred Million Stars Falling from the Sky
fields.description: A mystery melodrama about the shocking fate that befalls Moo-young, a dangerous man called a monster, Jin-kang, a woman with the same wounds, and her brother Jin-guk, who stands against him.

fields.title: Hyde, Jekyll, Me
fields.description: A romantic comedy about a love triangle involving a woman who falls in love with a man with two completely different personalities.

fields.title: Hi Bye, Mama!
fields.description: This drama depicts a ghost mom's 49-day real-life reincarnation project, unfolding as the protagonist, who left her family's side due to a sudden accident, reappears before her husband and daughter, who have overcome the pain of bereavement and started a new life. It features a cheerful and lively ghost wife (Cha Yu-ri) whose five years as a ghost seem insignificant, and a man (Jo Kang-hwa) who started a new life after living in agony while missing his deceased wife. Through this couple, the drama seeks to reflect on the messages conveyed by the inevitable order of life and death, as well as loss, and to tell the story of the time and wounds they have endured.

fields.title: High School: Love On
fields.description: A fantasy romance drama featuring the chaotic love and growth story of an angel who becomes human after trying to save a male student in crisis, and pure, passionate youths.

fields.title: hyena
fields.description: A drama depicting the hyena-like survival story of "dirty" lawyers—who harbor the law in their heads and money in their hearts—as they bite, tear, and rip each other apart. Hyenas. What comes to mind? Pitch-black creatures with lusterless fur that steal the prey of other beasts, cunning and vile beings. Our protagonists are called that, too. The elites of South Korea who clean up after the top class of capital and power that move the nation, serving as their closest confidants. They are called hyenas no different from scavengers. There is Jung Geum-ja, a weed-like mutant of the legal world who is incredibly wicked, incredibly sexy, and stops at nothing to make money. And there is Yoon Hee-jae, an elite among legal elites, arrogant, a "gold spoon" of the legal world built on conceit and pride, and a delicate flower. These two, who are completely different from one another, become hyenas acting as proxies for the high class. This drama is a desperate survival game and a blood-splattering human drama unfolded by them and the various human figures surrounding them. Now, the show has begun. Let's place our own pieces on the chessboard of survival. Let's open our own guild in the game of human desire.

fields.title: High Class
fields.description: A dangerous and secretive mystery suspense drama about the lies and hypocrisy hidden behind the perfect lives of the top 0.1% of women in South Korea.

fields.title: Flawed humans
fields.description: A romantic comedy drama depicting the journey of a woman with a phobia of handsome men and a man obsessed with his looks as they overcome their flawed prejudices. Seo-yeon, who hates good-looking men more than anything, accidentally runs into Kang-woo, a "handsome third-generation chaebol." But do these two have a shady, ill-fated history together?

fields.title: Heart to Heart
fields.description: This romantic comedy tells the story of Cha Hong-do (Choi Kang-hee), a woman suffering from social phobia and facial flushing who feels like she would die if she were the center of attention, and Go Yi-seok (Chun Jung-myung), a psychiatrist who lives by being the center of attention. Through encounters disguised as treatment, they overcome their respective traumas. Cha Hong-do, who struggles with social life due to her condition, devises a plan to get a job as a housekeeper while disguised as an old woman—her only means of socialization. Go Yi-seok (Chun Jung-myung), the "National Psychiatrist" who lacks nothing in terms of looks, education, and ability, faces the greatest crisis of his life due to the unexpected behavior of a patient he was counseling...

fields.title: School 2013
fields.description: A youth drama depicting various problems occurring centered around a school

fields.title: School 2017
fields.description: Here is a high school where strange things happen. Incidents explode one after another: sprinklers are set off during suffocating exams to ruin them, the principal's car is smeared with corn syrup, all the food in the wretched cafeteria is thrown around, and mock exam papers are torn up in the middle of the night—causing the school to be terrified while the students cheer and go wild with excitement. But! There was one female student who fearlessly and openly set out to find the culprit whom everyone was tacitly rooting for and keeping quiet about. Her reason was none other than her desperate struggle to get into college through early admission. After hearing from her first love, an older boy attending a prestigious university, that he would date her if she attended the same school, she was searching for 100 ways to get into a top university despite being ranked 280th with a 6th-grade GPA. She discovered that winning a webtoon contest could guarantee early admission to her desired university, and she resolved to write a "High Teen Hero Romance" based on the actual events occurring at her school! The story follows the search for the mysterious school hero chosen as the subject of the webtoon. Eun-ho, a female student who becomes entangled in various incidents inside and outside the school alongside the hero, delivers a satisfying blow to a school filled with hypocrisy and falsehood, ultimately confronting her true self—one that had been tightly guarded by cynicism and feigned malice. Witnessing the school of 1994, which cried out, "Enough with that teaching," and the school of 2017, which remains largely unchanged, the series aims to deliver a cathartic blow to the stifling reality that persists. The cheerful, brilliant, and vibrant coming-of-age drama of eighteen-year-old youths, *School 2017*, begins.

fields.title: School 2021
fields.description: A story about the raw school life and youthful anxieties of eighteen-year-old vocational high school students, as well as their desperate struggle for survival that adults were unaware of.

fields.title: I've been there once.
fields.description: This work tells the turbulent story of the Song family, who never have a moment's peace. It depicts the lives of the family members, who start with divorce but eventually unite through love and family affection, as well as the stories of the market people exuding the warmth of real life. Ok-bun, who runs a chicken shop in Yongju Market, is currently swaggering to the sky because of her youngest daughter Da-hee, who is set to marry Young-hoon, a Grade 5 civil servant who passed the Higher Civil Service Exam. However, Da-hee, the actual bride-to-be, is so overwhelmed by her internship that she is overwhelmed with menial tasks and has no time to sleep, let alone prepare for the wedding. Meanwhile, the second daughter, Na-hee, an internal medicine doctor at a pediatric hospital, is growing increasingly exhausted due to her marriage with her husband, Kyu-jin, who works at the same hospital, as it spirals towards disaster. Finally, after a chaotic wedding ceremony, the youngest daughter Da-hee witnesses a scene beyond imagination...

fields.title: Only one person
fields.description: A human melodrama about three women who meet in a hospice and fight to take only ‘one’ bad guy with them before they die, only to end up facing the ‘one’ person who is truly precious in their lives.

fields.title: One More Happy Ending
fields.description: The members of the disbanded first-generation fairy girl group, Angels, are now well over thirty. And the men who somehow got entangled with them. They take on the challenge of love to find happiness once again.

fields.title: Uncontrollably Fond
fields.description: A prickly yet poignant love story about a man and a woman who were separated by a heartbreaking ill-fated encounter in their childhood, only to meet again as an arrogant, top-tier superstar and a subservient, materialistic documentary PD.

fields.title: The Moon Embracing the Sun
fields.description: A royal romance drama depicting the poignant love story between the fictional King Lee Hwon of the Joseon Dynasty and Wol, a mysterious shaman.

fields.title: hatch
fields.description: A drama depicting the process of Prince Yeoninggun Lee Geum, born to a lowly palace maid, joining forces with the passionate aspiring scholar Park Mun-su, the zealous female investigator Yeo-ji of the Office of the Inspector General, and Dal-mun, a rising street thug, to seize supreme power.

fields.title: Happiness
fields.description: An urban thriller set in the near future depicting the survival story of those isolated in an apartment, a microcosm of a class-based society.

fields.title: Hershey
fields.description: A drama depicting the mutual growth of a veteran reporter who spends most of his time playing billiards and a survival-oriented intern who believes that food is mightier than the pen, as well as the daily lives of salaried reporters.

fields.title: The day after we broke up
fields.description: Yutan, the leader of an indie band, must save his girlfriend from an unfortunate fate through unexpected, repeating time travel. A fantasy romance centered on the theme of time slip.

fields.title: The present is beautiful
fields.description: In an era where dating and marriage are avoided, this is a marriage project depicting the journey of the three mature Lee brothers as they search for partners to claim the apartment offered by their family elders.

fields.title: My sister-in-law is nineteen
fields.description: This book is a story of the struggles of young people who are trying to become members of society after graduating from university. It aims to present thrilling hope to the 400,000 unemployed young people of this land through the success story of a young man who takes on the challenge of becoming a ‘hungry mathematician’—a job that is neither lucrative nor glamorous—and finally succeeds, transforming from a burden of family troubles into a capable young man.

fields.title: Hotel Del Luna
fields.description: 2019, right in the heart of Seoul's busiest downtown area. An old, dilapidated building situated on the most prime real estate. At first glance, it looks like an empty building preparing for reconstruction, but upon closer inspection, it is a hotel in operation. Millions of people pass by in passing, yet hardly any guests actually enter the hotel. During the day. When night falls, the streets are deserted, and the city falls asleep, the sign lights up... Hotel Del Luna. This is the story of the ultra-elite hotelier Gu Chan-seong, who works as the manager at Hotel Del Luna—a hotel exclusively for spirits—and the events that unfold as he provides top-notch service to special soul guests alongside the eccentric and ill-tempered owner, Jang Man-wol.

fields.title: Hotel King
fields.description: A drama depicting the story of destiny and love between an heiress struggling to protect 'Ciel Hotel,' the only 7-star hotel in the country, and a general manager who has become a sworn enemy of the father who abandoned her, as well as the mysteries surrounding the hotel.

fields.title: Drinking Alone
fields.description:
Jin Jung-seok, the ultimate selfish star instructor who enjoys luxurious solo drinking as a healing time solely for himself!

Park Ha-na, the rookie instructor known as the "Jang Geu-rae of Noryangjin," who drinks alone with a single can of beer in her semi-basement studio apartment like a destitute soul!

A sweet and romantic story about a man and a woman, whose ways of drinking and life are so different, discovering the true taste of alcohol when shared!

fields.title: Hong Cheon-gi
fields.description: A fantasy romance unfolded by Hong Cheon-gi, a female painter with divine powers, and Ha Ram, a red-eyed man who reads the constellations in the sky.

fields.title: picture gallery
fields.description: A youth historical drama depicting the burning passion, love, and dazzling growth of the Hwarang, the 'flower-like men' who roamed Seorabeol, the capital of Silla, 1,500 years ago.

fields.title: Hwayugi
fields.description: Inspired by the ancient novel Journey to the West, this is an absolute romantic exorcism drama depicting the journey of the decadent, mischievous demon Sun Wukong and the elegant, gentle demon Bull King as they search for light in a dark world. To enhance accessibility to this unfamiliar genre, we aim to utilize characters from Journey to the West that are familiar from movies, novels, animations, and variety shows. It is a journey to find light in a dark world overrun by evil spirits—known as *Hwa-yugi*—and also a journey where a painfully intense love blossoms between the two—known as *Hwa-yugi*. Combining the visual entertainment of fantasy, the tension of a horror exorcism, the laughter of character comedy, and the excitement of romance, we hope this becomes a heart-fluttering journey—*Hwa-yugi*—that everyone walks together.

fields.title: Reincarnation
fields.description: Set against the backdrop of the Great Kingdom, which does not exist in history or on maps, this is a fantasy romance action drama about protagonists whose destinies are twisted by the soul-swapping art of 'Hwanhonsul' as they overcome their challenges and grow.

fields.title: My Golden Life
fields.description: A family drama that resonates with all generations, depicting the golden life experience of a woman with nothing who wants to escape her impoverished background, provided she receives a life cheat code in the form of a fake social climb.

fields.title: Golden Bride
fields.description: A drama featuring the story surrounding Nguyen Anh Du, who married into a family from Vietnam, and her family.

fields.title: The Empress's Dignity
fields.description: This is the story of a cheerful and lively musical actress who suddenly becomes a Cinderella and marries the Emperor, fights against the absolute power of the palace, brings down the imperial family following the murder of the Grand Empress Dowager, and finds true love and happiness.

fields.title: The best moment to quit your job
fields.description: A drama depicting a heartbreaking youth story in which the protagonist, Yeon-ji, a novice designer working at a wet wipes factory, shares the frustrating reality of her work life with friends who are also newcomers to the workforce in similar situations.

fields.title: Who Are You: School 2015
fields.description: A youth school drama featuring an eighteen-year-old high school girl whose life changes 180 degrees overnight, capturing the honest and diverse emotions experienced by students.

fields.title: Hunnamjeongeum
fields.description: A comedic romance about 'Hoon-nam,' a non-romantic who rejects love, and 'Jung-eum,' who dreams of love but has given up on dating due to the harsh reality, falling in love while helping members unable to date escape their single status.

fields.title: Thoracic Surgery: Doctors Who Stole Hearts
fields.description: 'Two Lives, One Heart': The story of desperate cardiothoracic surgeons caught in a dilemma where their mission as doctors clashes with their personal lives.

fields.title: Black Knight
fields.description: A fantasy romance drama depicting the love story of one man and two women spanning over 200 years

fields.title: Healer
fields.description: Young people who lived their lives indifferent to politics or social justice... A refreshing and audacious passionate romance about them taking on the world handed down by their parents' generation, healing themselves and the world.

fields.title: Strong Woman Do Bong-soon
fields.description: The world inhabited by humans is no different from a jungle. While the ability to restore order amidst chaos and human conscience distinguish us from jungles ruled by animals, it is a fact that we operate under the brutal logic of survival of the fittest and power. The social status and existential authority of women are growing day by day. However, beneath this, regressive crimes and psychological tendencies attempting to suppress the declining authority of men through physical force are also invisibly on the rise. The female team leader who once exclaimed, "What else is better about men than women besides having a lot of hair and muscle?" finds herself in the irony of being escorted home by a male subordinate after a late-night company dinner. This is because the physical strength of those hairy, muscular men is being misused by bad men. That is why women are endlessly attracted to hairy, muscular, yet good men. It is because they possess what the women lack. What would the world be like if women were stronger than men? I planned this drama with the absolute conviction, without the slightest hesitation, that a story stemming from this audacious imagination would provide the world with a refreshing and poignant dose of endorphins.

fields.title: Hip Hop King - Nasunagil
fields.description: A work depicting the hip-hop cultural phenomenon, authentic hip-hop music, and the stories of youth growing up within it.
Catch the deserters. A new mission assigned to Private Junho. As he tracks down deserters, he confronts a brutally painful reality. He also realizes that no matter how hard he runs, he cannot escape.
A crossover work of film and drama set in the near future, depicting the story of humans dreaming of a perfect society through technological advancement.

fields.title: SKY Castle
fields.description: Junam University, South Korea's premier private institution. In a European-style four-story stone mansion complex built by the university in the forests near Seoul—where university hospital doctors and law school professors who are former judges and prosecutors reside—how do the wives from prestigious families prepare for their children's college entrance exams? They aspire to raise their children into the finest princes and princesses, living alongside husbands who belong to the top 0.1% of the nation and hold both honor and power. This is their fierce, thorough, and desperate struggle to establish a third generation of doctors and legal professionals. It is a realistic comedic satire that thoroughly delves into the intimate depths where their desperate desires simmer.

A secretive private office melodrama about the dedicated team managing the top 1% VIP customers of a department store. Is there anyone who doesn't have at least one secret they want to hide? Everyone dislikes having their vulnerabilities exposed to others. The instinct to conceal wounds—that is one of the mechanisms by which secrets are created. Consequently, many secrets are accompanied by pain. The characters in this drama are no exception. On the surface, they appear to be living perfectly fine lives. However, deep within each of them lies an unspeakable secret. And ironically, when the secrets they wanted to keep hidden are finally revealed, they find empathy and comfort. They come to truly understand and embrace one another. So, while this is a story about secrets, it is ultimately also a story about comfort and healing.

fields.title: W (Double U)
fields.description: A romantic suspense melodrama set in Seoul, 2016, featuring Kang Cheol, a cool-headed genius venture tycoon, and Oh Yeon-joo, a lively and warm-hearted surgeon, standing at the center of an incident where different dimensions intersect in the same space.

fields.title: Weak Hero
fields.description: Yeon Si-eun has no interest in anything other than studying, yet she does not shy away from fights that come her way. Although Si-eun uses her natural intelligence to create advantageous situations and utilizes surrounding tools to protect herself, she eventually faces a crisis because she is alone; at that moment, she receives help from another outsider, Ahn Su-ho, and a transfer student, Oh Beom-seok. In this way, a strange friendship blossoms between these individuals as they fight separately yet together to survive in a jungle-like school.

fields.title: That song
fields.description: A miraculous song suddenly falls before Joseph, a twenty-year-old who has nothing. One day, while spending happy times singing 'that song' that feels like destiny, Cheong-myeong appears before Joseph—a man who has everything, and is even the owner of the song... This is the story of all of us who miss out on small joys while yearning only for what we do not have.

fields.title: A cheerful outcast
fields.description: A story unfolding as the true nature of students isolated in a school due to a sudden massive earthquake is revealed. Based on the webtoon of the same name by Kim Sung-nyung.

fields.title: Review King Jang Bong-gi
fields.description: Jang Bong-gi, an unknown novelist whose novels, written over the past 30 years, have been rejected by publishers. He orders food after hearing on a delivery app that he will receive a free meal if he writes a review... As he writes a glowing review, customers start flocking back, and the restaurant fills up with customers once again. However, a group of malicious commenters appears, intending to ruin the restaurant...

fields.title: 30 days
fields.description: Jeong-yeol, born with intelligence, good looks, and a touch of patheticness. Nara, born with ability, a career, and a touch of eccentricity. They met like something out of a movie and had a movie-like romance, but unable to endure each other's patheticness and eccentricity, they finally decide to become complete strangers. However, with exactly 30 days left until the end of their marriage—which began as a romance but turned into a thriller—they lose their memories in an unexpected accident...

fields.title: pilot
fields.description: Han Jung-woo, a star pilot with top-tier flying skills who was on a soaring streak of popularity enough to even appear on famous TV shows, loses everything overnight and even becomes unemployed due to a momentary lapse in judgment. No airline will take him back now that he is on the blacklist, and driven into a corner, Han Jung-woo completely transforms himself into his younger sister and finally succeeds in getting rehired. However, his joy is short-lived! He faces yet another unexpected obstacle… Will his life, which he dreamed of sailing smoothly, be able to take off safely?

fields.title: Dakgangjeong
fields.description: To think my daughter turned into Dakgangjeong! Will Choi Seon-man, the owner of Modeun Machinery, be able to get back his daughter Mina, who was turned into Dakgangjeong in a mysterious accident? Baek Go-jung, an intern who has a crush on Mina, joins him in a fierce struggle.

fields.title: I’d be happy just breathing next to you.
fields.description: Lee Wan and Hwa Ran are a couple in their 20s with absolutely nothing to their name. Lee Wan dreams of becoming a rapper, while Hwa Ran wants to be a webtoon artist. They decide to move out of their cramped boarding house and live together, but after taking out a loan to secure a place, they fall victim to a deposit scam by a real estate agent and end up moving to a mold-filled second-basement apartment. Will they be able to escape this cave-like basement while protecting their dreams and love?

fields.title: ill-fated relationship
fields.description: Those entangled by an inescapable fate. A doctor tormented by nightmares, a man struggling under a mountain of debt, and a witness to a mysterious accident. A single accident twists the lives of six people. A crime thriller about an inescapable 'bad bond'.

fields.title: Breaking
fields.description: Jo-gak is a killer in his 60s who has spent over 40 years emotionlessly exterminating cockroach-like humans. Revered as a living legend known as "Godmother," he is gradually being treated as a has-been even by Shinseong Pest Control, the company he has worked for for so long. Meanwhile, Tou-woo, a young and hot-blooded killer who has hunted Jo-gak his entire life, joins Shinseong Pest Control and never takes his eyes off him. Jo-gak, who had promised not to create anything worth protecting, develops special feelings for Dr. Kang, the veterinarian who treated him that night despite his undiminished skills, and his daughter. Tou-woo explodes with rage at this unfamiliar side of Jo-gak…

fields.title: beast
fields.description: My only younger sibling has disappeared. I have only one day left. From now on, I become a beast!! To Tae-hoon of the Special Search Unit, his younger sister Bora is his only family in the world. Then, one day, Bora goes missing, and he discovers her shocking footage being live-streamed on an internet pornographic broadcast. Tae-hoon immediately begins tracking down traces of his sister, and as he gets closer to her, he drives himself increasingly insane by their shameless acts… He has only one day left! The brutal revenge of a man slowly turning into a beast begins!!

fields.title: Can this love be translated?
fields.description: A star actor and her interpreter travel the world for filming. While their feelings for each other deepen, the excitement keeps getting mistranslated. Will they be able to find their own unique language of love?

fields.title: There's nothing I can do about it.
Sculpture City
fields.description: A bloody revenge drama in which an ordinary man returns from hell after his life is suddenly completely fabricated and he falls into the abyss.

fields.title: Your taste
fields.description: A war-like kitchen stunt growth romance between Han Beom-woo, a chaebol heir who becomes a 'recipe hunter' acquiring and merging small restaurants to inherit a food conglomerate, and Mo Yeon-ju, a stubborn chef running a signless one-table restaurant in Jeonju.

fields.title: pigsty
fields.description: A drama based on the webtoon of the same name by Kim Kan-bi and Cheon Beom-sik.

fields.title: Good boy
fields.description: A world rampant with violence and crime. Champion athletes turned police officers use their exceptional abilities to take on ruthless villains.

fields.title: Twelve
fields.description: A fantasy action story about angels empowered by the strength of twelve animals and their leader, Taesan, protecting humans and the world from the forces of evil.

fields.title: Number one
fields.description: Whenever Hamin eats a meal prepared by his mother, he begins seeing mysterious numbers before his eyes. The numbers decrease by one each time he eats, and after discovering that his mother, Eunsil, will die if the numbers reach zero, Hamin's ordinary life is turned upside down in an instant. To protect his mother, Hamin starts making all sorts of excuses to avoid home-cooked meals…

fields.title: Kirigo
fields.description: The price of a wish is death. Several high school students are warned of sudden death by the curse of 'Kirigo,' a wish-granting application. Will these students, who are struggling to break the chains of the curse, ultimately be able to survive?

fields.title: vole
fields.description: Moon-jae, a novelist living in isolation from the world, discovers that his life has been stolen by a mysterious 'field mouse'. In response, he forms an unexpected alliance with a loan shark who has been pursuing him and struggles to reclaim his lost life.

fields.title: climax
fields.description: A fierce survival drama about Prosecutor Bang Tae-seop, who plunged into a power cartel to reach the pinnacle of South Korea, and those surrounding him.

fields.title: Paradise
fields.description: As times changed and fewer people visited theaters, they began to close one by one; among them, some third-rate theaters gradually transformed into meeting places for gay men who had been wandering the fringes of society in search of their own cultural spaces. Along with these "theaters frequented by homosexuals," gay bars sprang up throughout the back alleys of Jongno, and the nights of the 1980s began to turn Jongno into a paradise for gays.

fields.title: The worst evil
fields.description: In 1995, a joint investigation begins to dismantle drug organizations involving Korea, China, and Japan. Jun-mo, a rural detective, infiltrates deep into the Gangnam Alliance, the newly emerging villain of Gangnam. Unaware of the strange relationship that will unfold between his wife, Ui-jeong, and the Alliance boss, Ki-cheol... their fates, irrevocably entangled, spiral toward the worst possible scenario. Set in Korea, this crime action drama depicts the process of police officer Park Jun-mo infiltrating a new criminal organization to wipe out the international drug trafficking triangle.

fields.title: sweet sleep
fields.description: Ki-jeong is a "goose dad" (a father whose family lives abroad) leading a repetitive daily life commuting between his workplace and his apartment. Recently, he has been losing sleep every night due to noise from upstairs, which he suspects is caused by a child running around. He visits the upstairs neighbor to complain about the distress, but is met with the response that their child does not run. He tries to turn this misfortune into a blessing by using this issue as an excuse to return to farming, a dream he has long held, but reality tells him that it is not the right time. That night, however, Ki-jeong encounters the suspect behind the noise and puts his pent-up resentment into action.

fields.title: Netherlands
fields.description: A neighborhood devoid of hope and a future. Yeon-gyu, an 18-year-old boy born here who has never been anywhere else, finds his only hope in saving money to leave for the Netherlands with his mother amidst the recurring violence of his stepfather. Chi-geon, born and raised here and now a mid-level boss in a gang, realized early on that the world is hell and lives his life in his own way. One day, Yeon-gyu gets into a fight to protect his younger sister, Ha-yan. Desperate for settlement money, Yeon-gyu is helped by Chi-geon, and this leads him to start a new life within Chi-geon's organization. Following Chi-geon—who is scary and clumsy but like an older brother—Yeon-gyu gradually adapts. As he earns Chi-geon's trust, he begins to fall into increasingly dangerous situations in order to survive within the organization…

fields.title: mantis
fields.description: The bigwigs of the contract killing industry have collapsed overnight. As the order they established crumbles, the underworld shakes. 'Mantis,' a powerful figure biding his time amidst the chaos, opens a new era of killers at his fingertips.

fields.title: The moon flows in this river
private taxi
fields.description: Set against the backdrop of a mysterious taxi that only picks up passengers with reservations, this is a human healing music drama where the ordinary yet special stories of customers, whom everyone can relate to and wish to offer comfort to, flow along with song requests.

fields.title: Haewon, who is not anyone's daughter
fields.description: Haewon, a college student, wants to end her secret relationship with her school teacher, Seongjun. Depressed after meeting her mother, who is immigrating to Canada tomorrow, Haewon meets Seongjun again after a long time. That day, they accidentally run into fellow students from their department at a restaurant, and their relationship becomes known. Haewon becomes even more anxious, and Seongjun makes an extreme suggestion that they run away somewhere together. Haewon often has dreams. Her dreams are likely compared to her waking life, and it would be impossible to say that neither of them is her life.

fields.title: Praying man
fields.description: Pastor Tae-wook (Park Hyuk-kwon), running a small church amidst severe economic hardship, is compounded by the news from his wife, Jung-in (Ryu Hyun-kyung), that urgent funds are needed for his mother-in-law's (Nam Ki-ae) surgery.
