Faced with extreme circumstances, Tae-wook and Jung-in are confronted with different choices, and they grapple with a desperate internal conflict as they imagine scenarios that contradict their faith…

fields.title: Hateful Love
fields.description: A war of words between a national actor who has lost his original mindset and an entertainment reporter obsessed with justice! Fact bombing! Smashing prejudice! Drama

fields.title: The Ultimate Weapon Bow
fields.description: During the Manchu Invasion of 1636, which resulted in 500,000 prisoners being taken captive, there stood a great divine archer in the midst of the fierce war whose story history failed to record. Nam-i, the descendant of a traitor and the greatest archer of Joseon, lives his life solely for the happiness of his only remaining blood relative, his sister Ja-in. On the day of Ja-in's wedding, which he had managed to secure with great difficulty, Ja-in and her groom, Seo-gun, are captured during a raid by the elite Qing troops (Niru) at the happiest moment of their lives. Relying on the bow left to him by his father, Nam-i advances unhesitatingly into the heart of the Qing army. With ghost-like skill, Nam-i eliminates the elite Qing troops (Niru) one by one, closing in on their stronghold step by step. Jushinta, a renowned Qing general who has recognized Nam-i's miraculous archery prowess, begins to pursue him to protect Prince Dorgon and his subordinates. Nami, who uses curved arrows whose trajectory is unpredictable, and Jushinta, who uses the terrifyingly destructive Yukryangsi, begin the greatest archery war in history to protect what is most precious.

fields.title: A stroke of genius
fields.description: Professional Go player Tae-seok loses his brother on a gambling Go board due to a conspiracy by the Assassin Team. Framed for murder and serving time in prison, he gathers top players from across the country years later to confront the Assassins. Tae-seok, Joo-nim, Kkong-su, and Heo Mok-su, united by their respective desires for revenge and a final showdown, devise a plan to play their decisive moves. A series of planned matches against the notorious Assassin Team, who spare no one who loses even a single time, begins in succession...

fields.title: Whose child is crying?
fields.description: Kyu-man goes to make a delivery to the house where a murder occurred. Deep inside the house, he hears the sound of a child crying.

fields.title: Swag
fields.description: A music drama depicting the dreams, love, and passion of those facing the world

fields.title: Night in Paradise
fields.description: Tae-gu, the ace of a criminal organization, loses his beloved sister and nephew in an instant in a mysterious traffic accident. Instinctively sensing that a rival organization is behind this horrific tragedy, Tae-gu risks everything to carry out his revenge. After completing his mission, while hiding on Jeju Island, Tae-gu meets Jae-yeon, who lives alone with her illegal arms dealer uncle and harbors the shadow of death...

fields.title: Basil and Daisy
fields.description: As an adult, No-hae tries to get a driver's license but keeps failing the test. Eventually, he begins learning to drive from his mother's boyfriend, a taxi driver. However, there are more than a few things about this man that he dislikes. Then, he gets into a car accident, and a new driving lesson begins.

fields.title: lighting store
fields.description: The lighting shop, which brightly illuminates the end of a dark alley, is open late into the night again today. The owner waits for customers every night, adhering to the principle of doing business even if only one customer comes.

fields.title: Easy part-time job
fields.description: A peculiar employment agency that only introduces ‘dream jobs’ with hourly wages at least 50 times higher. Hounded by debt, Hyuk-jun jumps into a super-high-paying daily part-time job, completely unaware of the horrors he will face or the hellish site he will be thrown into.

fields.title: Quick
fields.description: Ki-soo is a speed-obsessed delivery man. While driving A-rom, an idol rushing to catch a live broadcast, he receives a phone call. A mysterious voice on the other end warns him that a bomb has been planted in his helmet and orders him to complete a bomb delivery mission within 30 minutes...

fields.title: King of Flattery
fields.description: Hyogosu, a legend in the world of flattery who early on mastered the stillness, middle, and movement of flattery and authored a secret book titled 'The Standard of Emotional Sales,' and Dong-sik, a disciple who surpasses his teacher with innate talent despite still lacking 0.2% in tact and sense. Armed with 'flattery,' a magical art of speech that will turn life around and change the paradigm of life, they shake up South Korea with just their 'tongues.'

fields.title: accomplice
fields.description: The kidnapping and murder case of the late Han Chae-jin, which shocked South Korea 15 years ago! With the statute of limitations approaching, Da-eun senses the presence of her father—the most familiar person in the world—in the voice of the actual killer and begins to trace his past. The deeper she digs, the more Da-eun is engulfed in confusion, and her cruel suspicion toward the father who dedicated his entire life to her only grows...

fields.title: KBS What is the ghost doing?
best seller
fields.description: Baek Hee-soo has reigned as South Korea's top bestselling author for over a decade. However, when her newly published novel is accused of plagiarizing a work she had judged while serving as a juror in a competition, Hee-soo loses her social standing overnight, and even her marriage becomes turbulent. Trapped in a state where she cannot create for two years, Hee-soo moves to a secluded country villa with her daughter, Yeon-hee, at the urging of a long-time friend—a publishing house editor—in hopes of a spectacular comeback. The villa they arrive at exudes an eerie atmosphere: a firmly locked corner room on the second floor, a bizarre vacuum sound intermittently echoing throughout the house, and black mold gradually spreading across the workspace ceiling. Meanwhile, Yeon-hee begins to converse with a mysterious figure referred to as "Unnie" (older sister). Thirsty for creative inspiration, Hee-soo becomes increasingly obsessed with the chilling story Yeon-hee tells her about the events that took place at the villa, eventually completing it as a novel. She rises once again as a bestselling author, successfully making a comeback. However, when it is revealed that even that story is identical to a novel published ten years ago, she finds herself once again at the center of a plagiarism controversy. Heesu, who insists it could not be plagiarism, believes that something at the villa forced her to write the exact same text and returns to the village to clear her name. There, she encounters a mysterious incident surrounding her novel and the villa… Now, she begins a desperate pursuit to uncover the hidden truth!

fields.title: Mask Girl
fields.description: Kim Momi, an ordinary office worker with an inferiority complex about her appearance. The tumultuous life story of a woman who becomes entangled in an unintended incident while working as an internet broadcast BJ every night with her face covered by a mask.

fields.title: brother
fields.description: Judo national team member Go Doo-young suffers an unexpected accident during a match. Upon hearing the news, his older brother Go Doo-sik, a con artist with 10 previous convictions, stages a tearful release scam. Using his younger brother, whose future has turned dark overnight, as an excuse, Doo-sik is paroled for one year as his guardian. However, the shameless brother, who hadn't contacted him even once in 15 years, returns home; far from acting as a guardian, he only makes Doo-young's life an even bigger mess… The unpredictable cohabitation of brothers worse than strangers begins!

fields.title: Standing at the starting line again
nightmare
fields.description: One day, his daughter died suddenly. Yeon-woo, a film director who spends each day in agony unable to forget the daughter he lost in a traffic accident, attempts to bring her back to life through his film, *Nightmare*. As mysterious events continue to unfold around Yeon-woo, who must continue making films despite his deep grief, he falls into an unstoppable madness, confused between dreams and reality.

fields.title: The Killer - The Child Who Can Die
Lovely Doggy again today
fields.description: A captivating and unpredictable fantasy romance drama about a woman cursed to turn into a dog when she kisses, and a man who is the only cheat code to break the curse but is afraid of dogs.

Jongno 3-ga, Exit 6, 7 o'clock—this is where everything began. Cheol-jun, who crossed over to the South in search of freedom, harbors a secret he cannot even share with his North Korean defector friends, who are like brothers to him. Cheol-jun, a young defector who felt lonely living while keeping his gay identity tightly hidden despite having close friends, summons the courage for the first time in his life to step into the South Korean gay community. With the help of Young-jun, a neighborhood friend he met at a spontaneous drinking get-together, Cheol-jun quickly adapts to the community. However, a single small, trivial misunderstanding causes a rift in the network of relationships, shaking the very community to which Cheol-jun has poured his affection.

fields.title: square
fields.description: Ki-joon, who cut his own Achilles tendon and left the square, returns after 11 years to uncover the truth behind the death of his younger brother, Ki-seok, the organization's second-in-command. An intense noir action film that charges straight ahead toward cold-blooded revenge without compromise.

fields.title: Unlock the boss
fields.description: A hybrid team-up drama about a CEO trapped inside a smartphone after getting caught up in a suspicious incident, and a job seeker whose life is turned upside down after finding the strange phone. A live-action adaptation of Park Sung-hyun's webtoon of the same name.

fields.title: The Old Man and the Sea
Winter butterfly
fields.description: Jinho is an 11-year-old head of household living with his ailing mother by cutting and selling wood. His greatest fear is that his mother will die, leaving him alone in the world. One day, after arguing with his mother over a problem involving his friend Seongil, Jinho goes alone to the mountains to cut wood, gets into an accident, and loses his way. His mother searches for him, heading to the mountains and the police station, but she cannot find him. After wandering for days in hunger and cold, Jinho safely makes his way down the mountain. This is because his beloved mother is waiting for him at home. However, Jinho did not know. He did not realize that everything that had happened so far was merely the beginning of his misfortunes...

fields.title: pirate
fields.description: The people of Galmeori Village, having lost their livelihood in the sea to outside aquaculture operators, rely on a single diving boat to survive, risking their lives in the process. However, their lives become increasingly desolate due to the power struggles of organized crime gangs hired by the operators. Woo-man, a native of this village, quits college and moves to Yeosu, where he joins the Citizens' Faction alongside his senior, Hong-baek. One day, Woo-man receives an order from Boss Dolgorae to kill Jeonwol, the owner of the Namhang Faction's fish farm, and flees to Busan to carry it out. However, after being attacked by the Busan Gangun Faction—instigated by Namhang Faction Boss Baekgom—Woo-man escapes the crisis with the help of Gu Jang-saeng and returns to Yeosu with him. Reunited with Hong-baek, Woo-man engages in a duel on board with a Namhang Faction patrol boat that attacks their vessel, only to be thrown into the sea. Rescued by a fisherman couple, Woo-man meets an extraordinary figure in the island village and, through a grueling training process, gains a new perspective on the world. When Uman returns to the village and his father is killed once again by the Namhang faction, he decides to fight against the violent organization that is the enemy of the entire village.

fields.title: Himalayas
fields.description: At an altitude of 8,750 meters, in the Himalayas’ Everest Death Zone—a divine realm forbidden by human access—our colleague lies buried. Beneath the mountain, people who were one and another family embark on a heart-wrenching journey with no records, no honor, and no rewards to retrieve the body of a junior team member who lost his life. The moving true story of Captain Um Hong-gil and the Human Expedition, a great challenge never before attempted, is revealed!

fields.title: Project spirit
fields.description: Director Lee Geun-woo sets a goal to cast Gong Hyo-jin and, in order to become famous, produces a unique collaboration music video with unknown singer Ha Si-yong and popular singer Nam Do-min from Misari.

fields.title: Retrial
fields.description: A taxi driver murder case that shook South Korea has occurred! Hyun-woo, a teenage boy and the sole witness, is framed by coercive police interrogation and ends up spending 10 years in prison. Meanwhile, Jun-young, a lawyer on the brink of ruin with no money or connections and only mounting debt, learns of Hyun-woo's case while volunteering to win the favor of a major law firm representative. He instinctively senses that this is a golden opportunity to gain honor and fame. However, upon actually meeting Hyun-woo, Jun-young finds his heart burning with a sense of justice once again, and with Jun-young's help, Hyun-woo finds hope to believe in the world once more... Encounter the sincerity that will make your heart beat again!

fields.title: Seo Bok
fields.description: Ki-heon, a former agent living a life cut off from the outside world due to a traumatic past event, receives a final offer from the intelligence agency he cannot refuse. He is tasked with safely transporting Seo-bok, a test subject created through stem cell cloning and genetic manipulation. However, while carrying out the mission, they come under unexpected attack; after barely escaping, Ki-heon and Seo-bok embark on a special journey together. Seo-bok, finding everything fascinating as he encounters the world outside the laboratory for the first time, and Ki-heon, eager to hastily complete his final mission, clash at every turn. Meanwhile, the pursuit by various groups vying for Seo-bok—who could be both the savior and the disaster of humanity—intensifies, forcing them to make an unavoidable choice…

fields.title: The Outlaws 2
fields.description: In 2008, four years after the Garibong-dong crackdown operation, the Violent Crimes Unit of the Geumcheon Police Station receives a mission to extradite a suspect who has fled to Vietnam. While scouting the area, Ma Seok-do and Jeon Il-man become suspicious of the suspect and, after questioning him, discover the existence of the vicious Kang Hae-sang. Despite lacking investigative authority, the two detectives traverse every corner of Ho Chi Minh City with the sole determination to catch him, who commits unprecedented crimes while traveling between Korea and Vietnam.

fields.title: origin
fields.description: Sun, a woman of the night, is bribed by gangster boss Lee Ga to seduce his subordinate, Seok-gu, with the intention of killing him, and they go to Mt. Seorak. The boss had always felt his position threatened by this subordinate. However, while accompanying him to Mt. Seorak, Sun becomes captivated by him and breaks her promise to the boss. Sun finally confesses to Seok-gu the order to assassinate the boss. Consequently, a life-or-death battle ensues between Seok-gu and the boss's gang, who had been tailing them. As a result, the gang destroys themselves, and she returns to the streets at night.

fields.title: revolver
fields.description: Police officer Soo-young, eager to move into her dream new apartment, becomes entangled in an unexpected corruption scandal. She accepts an offer of a substantial reward if she takes the blame for everything. Two years later, on the day of her release, the only person who comes to see her in front of the prison is Yoon-sun, a complete stranger. Soo-young instinctively senses that something has gone wrong. Desperate to reclaim everything she has lost, she sets out to find Andy, the man who promised her the reward, only to confront a larger and more dangerous force lurking behind him…

fields.title: Diva
fields.description: Lee Young, a diving diva watched by the whole world, is involved in a car accident one day along with her colleague and best friend, Sujin. Unlike Lee Young’s deep affection for the missing Sujin after the accident, her colleagues spread suspicious rumors about her; amidst the confusion, Lee Young must regain her perfect skills. Ultimately, her intense desire to maintain her position as the best and her fear of Sujin’s true feelings drive Lee Young further into madness...

fields.title: rime
fields.description: A superpower human action series in which children living in the present while hiding their superpowers and parents living while concealing painful secrets from the past stand together to confront massive dangers that transcend time and generations.

fields.title: martial arts practitioner
fields.description: Lee Jeong-do is a martial arts black belt who cannot simply ignore those in need. Probation Officer Kim Seon-min recognizes this quality and recommends that he become a ‘Martial Arts Officer.’ Now, their active roles in monitoring electronic ankle monitor wearers and preventing crime unfold.

fields.title: Typhoon Company
fields.description: A drama depicting the struggles of small and medium-sized enterprises and their families as they face the IMF bankruptcy crisis head-on and break through it.

fields.title: The story of Manager Kim, who lives in Seoul and works for a large corporation
From a low place
fields.description: Since her brother's suicide, Yunseul finds it painful to look at her mother, Haesook. For some reason, Yunseul visits her hometown for the first time in a long while and is shocked by the unrecognizable state of the house. Haesook's daily life appears precarious. She seems to have lost her appetite, is excessively attached to church activities, and often drives off somewhere unexpectedly late at night. Her anxiety intensifies, and Yunseul attempts to intervene in Haesook's life; in the process, the two suffer an unexpected accident, which is the aftermath of a local tragedy. From this point on, their standing within the community changes drastically.

fields.title: Recharge me
fields.description: Baek Ho-rang, the perfect third-generation chaebol. His only weakness is an artificial heart. Just as his battery is about to run out of power, he meets Na Bo-bae, who has electricity flowing through her entire body. With the thrilling deal he makes with her, will both his battery and his romance be recharged?

fields.title: Still brilliantly
fields.description: The story of Sun-ok, who reunited after 60 years with her best friend, with whom she shared the most brilliant moments of her life.

fields.title: Love just as you are now..
I love Italy
fields.description: "I Love Italy" is a South Korean television drama.

fields.title: reincarnation
fields.description: A man arrived. Together, they visited the place where he and his comrades had died. The film is a journey to confront the dead of the Vietnam War and the Iran-Iraq War. Like watching someone's dream, they encounter scattered scars through various paths. A film that mediates the world between the dead and the living.

fields.title: Hidden Face
fields.description: Suyeon, a cellist in the orchestra led by conductor Seongjin and his fiancée, vanishes one day, leaving behind only a video message. Seongjin suffers from the grief of losing Suyeon, but feels a strong attraction to Miju, the cellist who took her place. On a rainy night, swept up in their mutual desires, Seongjin and Miju commit an unforgivable act at Suyeon's house. Meanwhile, Suyeon, believed to have disappeared, is trapped in a secret room within the house from which she cannot escape alone, witnessing her hidden true self...

fields.title: Winter's Light
fields.description: Eighteen-year-old Dabin comes from a financially struggling family and must look after his sick younger sibling, let alone attend tutoring. Although he studies quite well, he has no concrete dreams. His only solace is his girlfriend, Jae-eun. At the tail end of his eighteenth year, he finds something he wants to do: participate in an overseas training program with Jae-eun. To raise the participation fee, Dabin starts a part-time job cleaning motels and saves money. Then, one day, he finds himself needing a large sum for his sibling's eye surgery…

fields.title: stock
fields.description: An unidentified mass infection breaks out in a skyscraper in downtown Seoul. The building is instantly sealed off, leaving the people inside completely isolated. Initially crawling like beasts, the infected gradually evolve, beginning to walk on two legs, distinguishing people, and attacking survivors in packs. Biotechnologist Kwon Se-jeong and the survivors head to the rooftop where the rescue team awaits, seeking out Seo Young-cheol, who reported injecting himself with a vaccine. However, as they ascend, the situation becomes increasingly unpredictable, and Seo Young-cheol leads the infected to block the survivors' path...

fields.title: Beauty Inside
fields.description: There is a man who becomes a different person every time he wakes up. Woojin, a man who transcends nationality, gender, and age every day, has lived as a furniture designer without revealing his true identity. Then one day, Woojin meets a woman named Isu at a furniture store and experiences the feeling of love for the first time. Having always watched over her in his different forms, Woojin asks Isu out on a date. After their heart-fluttering first date, he tries to stay awake to maintain his appearance. Woojin spends a few days living happily like an ordinary person, but eventually, he falls asleep and transforms back into his other self. Hovering around her, Woojin finally summons the courage to reveal his secret...

fields.title: The atmosphere of that day
fields.description: Sujeong and Jaehyun end up sitting next to each other by chance on a KTX train bound for Busan. Jaehyun, unable to stop catching his eye of the charming Sujeong, lets out a remark: “Um… I’m planning to sleep with you tonight.” Free love, open mind! Jaehyun, a man who boasts a 100% success rate whenever he sets out to win her over, launches a fierce attack that gradually draws Sujeong in… “I’m not that kind of woman!” Ten years of dating, unwavering devotion! Sujeong, the modern-day “iron wall” who avoids so many things, is momentarily flustered but stands up against Jaehyun’s seduction with an impenetrable defense. The aggressive man vs. the woman with the iron wall! Who will be the winner in this precarious push-and-pull romance between the two?

fields.title: How to live in this world
Don't save me
fields.description: Sunyu's father passed away alone, leaving behind a large debt from his business. Sunyu and her mother, a twelve-year-old girl, move to a new place to make a fresh start. Sunyu, who used to be bullied, seems to be adapting well to her new school. Good at both studying and drawing, she quickly becomes close with her friends, particularly receiving the intense attention of a mischievous boy named Jeong-guk. Just as Sunyu's life, once overshadowed by darkness, is slowly brightening, her grandmother visits the school to collect her father's life insurance money and causes a disturbance, bringing Sunyu's plight to light.

fields.title: Karate
fields.description: A youth action film about Chaeyoung, a girl who has been learning karate from her father who runs a dojo, who meets Jonggu, a pure and righteous boy living with his single mother, and Haeseong, who is fed up with the life of a delinquent and striving for a new beginning, as they grow together through karate.

fields.title: bat
fields.description: Sang-hyun, a priest who became a vampire after receiving a blood transfusion of unknown origin, struggles between his thirst for blood and his faith. However, upon coincidentally meeting his childhood friend Kang-woo and his wife Tae-ju, he awakens to his own human desires. Captivated by Tae-ju's mysterious charm, Sang-hyun craves pleasure, while Tae-ju becomes obsessed with Sang-hyun, who awakened her desires that had been suppressed by her hysterical mother-in-law and incompetent husband. Their love, which had been growing increasingly bolder, enters a new phase when Tae-ju discovers Sang-hyun is a vampire and proposes killing her husband, a proposal Sang-hyun accepts...

fields.title: It's been a long time.
fields.description: At 33, Yeon-kyung, who had been consistently failing auditions, decides to give up on music. She has chased her dream of becoming a singer ever since the moment she sang at Jung Seo-ha's radio contest in middle school, but she no longer has the strength to endure. One day, Yeon-kyung receives a letter and a guitar from Hyun-soo, a friend with whom she made music in high school. Hyun-soo's letter throws Yeon-kyung further into confusion, and to bid farewell to her long-held dream, she travels to Wolmido, a place filled with memories of the days when she loved music.

fields.title: miracle
fields.description: In a village where the only way to get around is by train tracks but there is no actual train station, Jun-kyung has only one goal: to have a train station built in the village. Despite the opposition of his principled engineer father, who dismisses the idea as impossible, Jun-kyung insists on staying in the village and endures a five-hour round-trip commute to school. Together with Ra-hui, his self-proclaimed muse who instantly recognized the extraordinary within his eccentricity, Jun-kyung’s sole efforts to build a train station continue...

fields.title: Archaeology of Love
fields.description: Young-sil and In-sik fell in love just eight hours after meeting. Convinced that Young-sil was a free spirit, In-sik extracted a promise from her that he would stay with her no matter the circumstances. As time passed, In-sik’s obsession with Young-sil intensified, and Young-sil tried to keep her promise to In-sik even amidst their twisted relationship. However, despite Young-sil’s efforts, the two broke up. Breaking free from the shackles of an unsettling past spanning eight years, Young-sil begins to prepare to confront her love head-on.

fields.title: Seoul Grand Operation
fields.description: Ahead of the 1988 Seoul Olympics, a team comprised of drivers and mechanics is deployed on a special undercover operation. The objective is to uncover and dismantle a large-scale money laundering organization. A car-chasing action blockbuster capturing the high-speed chase of the Sanggye-dong Supreme Team as they are deployed in an investigation into VIP slush funds.

fields.title: Anna
fields.description: A work that tells the story of Yumi, a woman who ends up living the life of a completely different person, starting with a trivial lie born of relative deprivation, and eventually loses her identity and a part of her life.

fields.title: Can I become a stranger?
fields.description: The love and life growth stories of divorce lawyers for whom divorce is easy and separation is difficult.

fields.title: Beneficial Fraud
fields.description: A collaboration between two polar opposites—a con artist incapable of empathy and an overly empathetic lawyer—and a relatable revenge drama against absolute evil, as well as a con game you desperately want to believe in but cannot until the very end.

fields.title: large family
fields.description: Mu-ok, the owner of Pyeongmanok—the epitome of a self-made gourmet restaurant where people have lined up since the days of social media—becomes deeply worried after his only son, Mun-seok, whom he believed would carry on the family legacy, becomes a monk. While he worries about the family lineage destined to die out with his generation, young guests visit Pyeongmanok one day, claiming Mun-seok is their father! Mu-ok, now poised to continue the family line he thought would end, experiences a happiness he has never tasted before; meanwhile, as Mun-seok reflects on his past before becoming a monk, he uncovers a shocking truth…

fields.title: Love Phobia
fields.description: The story of Seon-ho, a romance novel writer with 100% emotion, and Bia, the CEO of the AI dating program 'It's You' with 0% sensitivity, meeting, understanding each other, and finding love.

fields.title: Lady Dua
fields.description: Sarah Kim, a woman who wanted to become a masterpiece, even if it was a fake. Her name can be heard everywhere, but the real her cannot be met anywhere. Detective Moo-kyung, with his keen gaze and tenacious obsession, tracks down her mysterious identity.

fields.title: Generational Regret
fields.description: A hilarious story of a father and son: a father trying to protect the family and his eldest son attempting an exorcism after hearing from a shaman one day that "the ancestral spirits are angry."

fields.title: Green Grape Candy: A Promise from 17 Years Ago
fields.description: Sun-ju reunites with her middle school classmate Sora at the hospital she visited after hearing news of her fiancé Ji-hoon's accident. Upon discovering that Sora is the author of a new book being prepared by Ji-hoon's publishing company, Sun-ju is engulfed by an inexplicable sense of unease. Leaving Ji-hoon behind to join the business trip that Ji-hoon and Sora were planning to take together, Sun-ju meets Jung-eun, the older sister of their childhood friend Yeo-eun, there. Forced to stay at Jung-eun's house due to a sudden accident on the way back, they confront long-forgotten memories that night…

fields.title: Parasite
fields.description: At dawn, gruesome corpses, reduced to nothing but skin and bones, begin to float on the Han River. Following this, unidentified bodies start appearing in rivers and streams across the country… The cause is a ‘mutant horsehair worm’ that manipulates the human host’s brain to induce them to jump into the water and drown. With a short incubation period and a 100% fatality rate, the ‘horsehair worm disaster’ spreads rapidly through the four major rivers, devastating South Korea. As the death toll rises exponentially, the government activates an emergency response headquarters and enters a national readiness posture to isolate all infected individuals; however, the deranged infected desperately try to break through security and rush toward the water. Meanwhile, Jae-hyuk, a pharmaceutical sales representative who was too overwhelmed by work to look after his family, struggles to find a cure to save his wife and children, who have unknowingly become infected with the horsehair worm. In the process, he discovers ominous clues related to the disaster and sets out to solve the case…

fields.title: weight
fields.description: In a morgue with a grotesque atmosphere, gripped by a beautiful yet ambiguous energy of unfathomable time and space, a hunchback is seen wiping and dressing up corpses amidst the resounding aria of a young boy bidding farewell to his beloved grandfather to heaven. As always, when the paramedics move the corpses onto the iron beds and leave without a word, the hunchback pays no heed to it, wiping away the blood and draining it into a bucket.

fields.title: User Manual for Men
fields.description: The ultimate dating secret for the nation's average girl is revealed! Choi Bona is a CF assistant director who takes on all the menial tasks due to her indecisive personality. A haggard face and greasy hair from consecutive late nights have long become her daily routine... Above all, she is a quintessential "average girl" of this era whose memory of ever having a proper relationship is hazy. Then one day, after finishing an outdoor shoot, Choi Bona accidentally gets her hands on a "Manual for Men." When she follows Dr. Swalski's instructions on the tape with skepticism, she miraculously manages to captivate not only the eyes of passing men but also the heart of top Hallyu star Lee Seung-jae... Will Choi Bona be able to start a new love through the "Manual for Men"? You too can start dating!

fields.title: unknown
fields.description: On my first birthday after marriage, my wife died. Ishigami (played by Hidetoshi Nishijima) lives a happy life with his beloved wife. He heads home filled with excitement to celebrate his first birthday with her. Returning home with high hopes, Ishigami is shocked to discover his wife's cold corpse. However, he receives a phone call from his wife, whom he believed to be dead, plunging him into even greater confusion at the unbelievable situation. As Ishigami investigates the truth behind the incident, he receives help from Kang Ji-won (played by Kim Hyo-jin), a Korean journalist visiting Tokyo for coverage. However, he becomes entangled in a massive conspiracy upon discovering that all his memories have been fabricated… A dead wife's body and a single phone call. Everything crumbles, and memories vanish!

fields.title: godsend
fields.description: Those who seek to buy salvation, those who seek to sell pain. Their mysterious waiting begins. Seung-yeon cannot have the child she desperately desires. So-young falls into a predicament after conceiving an unwanted child. To fill each other's voids, the two decide to await a new life together at a secluded cabin deep in the forest. However, their comfortable peace is short-lived, as the arrival of strangers begins to threaten them... Will the breath of salvation truly reach them?

fields.title: montage
fields.description: Fifteen years ago, a kidnapper vanished without a trace. Five days before the statute of limitations expired, the culprit placed a single flower at the crime scene. A few days later, the exact same crime from 15 years ago was repeated. A grandfather who lost his granddaughter before his eyes, a mother who searched for the culprit from 15 years ago, and a detective who staked his life on this unsolved case. Finally, a decisive moment arrived for everyone.

fields.title: On the way home
fields.description: An ordinary wife whose beloved husband and daughter are her whole world. On the day her passport was stamped for the first time, she is framed as a drug trafficker in France and imprisoned. A prison on the remote French island of Martinique, 12,400 km across the Atlantic and on the other side of the globe, a 22-hour flight from Korea. A strange place where she cannot understand a single word. Will she be able to return home?

fields.title: apostle
fields.description: Plagued by controversy over the legitimacy of his succession throughout his reign, King Yeongjo devoted ceaseless effort to becoming a perfect king in scholarship and etiquette. He hoped that his precious son, the Crown Prince, born late in life, would become a king recognized by all, but he became disappointed as the Crown Prince deviated from his expectations. The son, who had been the joy of his father Yeongjo with his extraordinary intelligence in his childhood, possessed a free-spirited nature and excelled in the arts and martial arts, unlike his father. Although Sado wanted to become the perfect Crown Prince as Yeongjo wished, he gradually came to resent his father, who failed to understand his true feelings and only pressured him.

fields.title: Working Girl
fields.description: Bo-hee, a workaholic who finds more pleasure in achieving good work results than in sex with her husband, is the top ace at work but has a terrible home life. She makes a fatal mistake during an important presentation just ahead of her promotion and gets fired. To make matters worse, all that awaits her at home is a message from her husband announcing their breakup. Then there is Nan-hee, the owner of a sex shop and an evangelist of the world of "proper casual flings." With her philosophy that women are divided into those who have felt "that" and those who haven't, she is more knowledgeable about sex than anyone else. However, her own sex shop is filled with red stickers... Seemingly perfect but actually a total klutz, the secret partnership begins between two working women whose lives have gone bankrupt overnight!

fields.title: Hidden Time
fields.description: Surin moves to Hwanodo with her stepfather after losing her mother. Seongmin is the first to approach Surin, who lives alone, lost in her own daydreams. Using their own secret codes, in their own private space, they build memories known only to the two of them. One day, Surin goes up into the mountains with friends to watch a construction blasting site; everyone disappears except for Surin, who is the only one to return. A few days later, a man claiming to be Seongmin appears before her. Seongmin asserts that he became an adult after being trapped in "stopped time." While Surin is the only one who believes him, the police and villagers remain suspicious, and Seongmin finds himself on the run…

fields.title: Olle
fields.description: A successful corporate manager? Jung-pil (Shin Ha-kyun) “Does it make sense to be first on the list for early retirement just because I don’t have a wife and kids to support?” Su-tak (Park Hee-soon) dreaming of becoming a successful lawyer? “Don’t even talk about it unless you’ve studied for the bar exam for 13 years.” A top-tier news anchor at a broadcasting station? Eun-dong (Oh Man-seok) “Are you jealous of me? Me… Never mind. What’s the point of talking about it?” Just when they want to quit everything, a call comes from Jeju Island! A red sports car, a plate of wild grouper, and a guesthouse instead of a luxury hotel?? When you need a pause in life, an unexpected escape begins on Jeju Island! Olé!!

fields.title: elk
fields.description: Mr. Tak, the owner of Taeyang Car Center, doubts the customer's claim that he hit a roe deer. Although he is even insulted by the customer, he stays behind alone and calls the police. Just then, Mr. Tak encounters an unexpected person and learns the truth behind the roe deer.

fields.title: Coffee Mate
fields.description: In-young, who loves people-watching at cafes, finds herself inexplicably drawn to Hee-soo, a man she frequently runs into there. One day, Hee-soo approaches In-young first and strikes up a conversation, and the two decide to become "coffee mates," meeting only at the cafe to share stories they couldn't tell anyone else. As she confides secrets she couldn't even tell her husband, In-young feels a long-awaited flutter in her heart for Hee-soo. During their time together, the two feel a sense of liberation from their suffocating reality, but swept up in a subtle storm of emotions, their relationship spirals out of control…

fields.title: tunnel
fields.description: Jeong-su, a manager at a car dealership, is on his way home excitedly anticipating a big deal when he suddenly finds himself trapped alone inside a collapsed tunnel. All he has with him is a cell phone with 78% battery remaining, two bottles of water, and his daughter's birthday cake. Upon hearing news of the massive tunnel collapse, the government urgently forms an emergency response team. Rescue leader Dae-gyeong attempts various methods to enter the completely blocked tunnel, but the rescue operation proceeds slowly. Meanwhile, Jeong-su's wife, Se-hyeon, conveys hope to her husband through the radio—the only thing he can hear—and refuses to give up hope for his safe return.

fields.title: One line
fields.description: Min-jae, an ordinary college student, meets Manager Jang—a legendary veteran of the so-called "loan scam" world who deceives everyone to steal money from banks—and is reborn as a rising star in the industry. Boasting fantastic chemistry, this new type of criminal fraud ring of five sweeps up every penny they can get their hands on! However, these con artists, who can never truly trust one another, gradually begin to reveal their true intentions… Lie about your name, age, and occupation! The real con artists' final operation unfolds!

fields.title: Master
fields.description: Chairman Jin of One Network has been riding high, defrauding tens of thousands of members with his eloquent speech, a talent for seducing, and connections spanning political circles. Kim Jae-myung, the head of the Intelligent Crime Investigation Team who has been tracking him for six months, pressures Park Jang-gun, Chairman Jin's closest aide. He demands that Park hand over the location of One Network's computer room and Chairman Jin's lobbying ledgers. Park Jang-gun, the mastermind behind One Network's growth with his exceptional programming skills and brilliant mind, senses that his plans have hit a snag and begins to strategize quickly. While Jae-myung tightens the net to capture not only Chairman Jin but also the power hidden behind him, Jang-gun devises a plan to seize this opportunity to pocket the money and escape police pressure. However, Chairman Jin notices a traitor among his executives and activates a new plan…

fields.title: money
fields.description: Jo Il-hyun, a rookie stock broker who entered the Yeouido financial district harboring only the dream of becoming rich. With no connections or backing, and earning zero commission, he soon finds himself on the brink of dismissal. In this moment of crisis, he meets "Number Tag," a legendary and mysterious mastermind behind financial schemes, and is offered the opportunity to participate in a deal that could yield massive profits. After accepting the dangerous offer, Il-hyun makes a fortune in an instant. However, just as Il-hyun continues his winning streak, Han Ji-cheol, a "watchdog" from the Financial Supervisory Service who has been tracking Number Tag, appears and begins to close in on him…

fields.title: We were the only ones who had to be in danger
Hit-and-run
fields.description: Eun Si-yeon is a police lieutenant in the Internal Affairs Division, the most elite unit within the police force. Working alongside Chief Yoon—the only person the unit trusts and follows—Si-yeon was tightening the net to catch Jeong Jae-cheol, a businessman and former F1 racer. However, she is disgraced for conducting excessive coercive interrogation and is demoted to the Hit-and-Run Task Force. The team consists of Chief Woo, a pregnant leader who turned out to be the top graduate of the Police Academy, and Seo Min-jae, an ace constable with a natural talent for cars. With only two members, lacking manuals, manpower, or time, the Hit-and-Run Task Force is unrivaled when it comes to catching hit-and-run drivers. Si-yeon, who had been keeping a close eye on Jae-cheol, discovers that he is a prime suspect in an unsolved hit-and-run case currently under investigation. Min-jae, the ace of the task force who relentlessly pursues hit-and-run offenders, and Si-yeon, who has staked everything on catching Jae-cheol, who engages in all manner of corruption, stand together in this new challenge. As their teamwork begins with them joining forces toward a single goal, the counterattack by Jae-cheol, an uncontrollable speed demon determined to evade the investigation by any means necessary, is also becoming increasingly audacious…!

fields.title: Express delivery
fields.description: Eunha, a professional express delivery driver, gets entangled in an uncontrollable series of events due to an unexpected delivery mishap. From an unreturnable package she happened to take on to 30 billion won from a mysterious source, she becomes a target of the police and the National Intelligence Service, engaging in an all-out chase through the heart of the city…

fields.title: ivy
fields.description: Eun-su and Ye-won, a same-sex couple, are living happily together. Then, one day, a horrific car accident occurs; Eun-su suffers serious injuries, and her older sister, Eun-hye, dies. Eun-su becomes disabled, and Eun-hye's daughter, Su-min, is left an orphan. Now, Eun-su and Ye-won must take care of Su-min. Immediately after the accident, Ye-won asks, "Aren't we family? How can a family abandon each other just because something like this happened?" but Eun-su replies, "Family? Who would acknowledge us as a family?" As Ye-won wished, the three women who have come to live together hope to become a family. Spending their days together and even going to the beach, they appear to be living as a happy (pseudo) family. However, just like Eun-su's despairing answer, the norms of the world stand in the way of their becoming one.

fields.title: confession
fields.description: Yoo Min-ho heads to a hotel after being threatened with the exposure of his affair, only to be attacked by a mysterious assailant. When he regains consciousness, he finds his companion, Kim Se-hee, dead, and the culprit has vanished without a trace. Framed as the sole suspect in a locked-room murder case, Yoo Min-ho transforms overnight from a successful businessman into a man accused of murder. To prove his innocence, he seeks out Yang Shin-ae, a lawyer with a 100% success rate. Meeting at a secluded villa deep in the snow, Yang Shin-ae insists that the case must be reconstructed from the beginning to ensure a perfect testimony. As the pieces of the puzzle come together, another incident Yoo Min-ho has been concealing begins to surface…

fields.title: Emergency declaration
fields.description: Veteran detective team leader In-ho investigates a case following a tip-off about a video threatening an airplane terror attack, only to discover that the suspect is actually on Flight KI501. Jae-hyuk, who has decided to travel to Hawaii for his daughter's treatment despite his fear of flying, is uneasy about a stranger lurking nearby and making threatening remarks. As unexplained deaths occur on Flight KI501, which took off from Incheon for Hawaii, the scene turns into chaos and fear, extending beyond the aircraft to the ground. Upon hearing this news, Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Sook-hee forms a counter-terrorism center and convenes an emergency meeting to find a way to land the plane…

fields.title: The Girl Who Loved a Horned Man
ballerina
fields.description: A former bodyguard discovers the death of a dear friend. He embarks on a beautiful revenge to fulfill his friend's last wish.

fields.title: Seonsan
fields.description: A woman inherits the ancestral burial ground left behind by her uncle, whose very existence she had forgotten. Ominous events unfold one after another, and eventually, secrets hidden behind a veil begin to surface.

fields.title: Veteran 2
fields.description: Veteran Detective Seo Do-cheol and the detectives of the Violent Crime Investigation Unit fight crime day and night, neglecting even their own families. One day, the nation is thrown into turmoil by a serial killer when the death of a professor is revealed to be connected to previous murder cases. The detectives begin an investigation, tracking down clues. However, as if mocking them, the serial killer shakes the entire nation once again by releasing a trailer online designating the next victim. The Violent Crime Investigation Unit assigns Park Sun-woo, a justice-driven rookie detective who caught Seo Do-cheol's eye, to the case. And so, the case takes a new turn...

fields.title: Someday, a wise residency life
fields.description: A story about the realistic hospital life and friendship between university hospital professors and resident doctors. A spin-off of the drama "Hospital Playlist".

fields.title: 5 Minutes Between You and Me
fields.description: Five minutes of sharing music, time just for the two of us. It is 2001. Kyung-hwan, a new transfer student, finds everything unfamiliar and new. Jae-min, his seatmate and class president, shows interest in Kyung-hwan, who had been living like a loner listening to his favorite Japanese music, and the two discover they share similar musical tastes. From recess spent sharing their favorite music to the walk home from school listening together with earphones in the back seat of the bus, they carefully build memories known only to them. Then, one day, as Kyung-hwan's feelings for Jae-min grow stronger, he confesses his secret...

fields.title: My brother is back
fields.description: Five years ago, I was wronged by him, but now I have returned triumphantly for revenge! I proudly became independent to put an end to my life of abuse, but society was just as cold as ever. In the end, I had no choice but to return to that house, but recalling my relationship with that sworn enemy, I have no choice but to fiercely sharpen the blade of vengeance every day. My life is such that even 880,000 won is a blessing. Somehow, I’m about to become a father, and while I struggle to make ends meet, my battle gauge keeps rising day after day due to this bloody conflict with him! I have been the number one for my entire life, but an unexpected rival has appeared! That guy who ran away five years ago is back. I, who wielded absolute power in my own home my whole life, am slowly being pushed back. However, you must not underestimate me. I am the professional informant whom everyone shudders at. I am the fearsome Red Riding Hood. My son is no exception. I will defend my reputation! He is the father, and that guy is the son. The bloody battle of a lifetime between these blood rivals, who know each other best, is about to begin!

fields.title: The Second Story of Gosa: Student Teaching
Drama Special - The Woman of Olle-gil
Violent Crimes Unit
fields.description: A crime drama depicting episodes set against the backdrop of the Gangnam Police Station's Violent Crimes Unit

fields.title: Steel Battalion: The Iron Deliveryman of National Salvation
fields.description: Kang Dae-oh, an average-looking Chinese restaurant deliveryman, is a lifelong single who has never been in a relationship. He has a crush on Ye-rin, a college student he fell in love with at first sight while delivering jajangmyeon, but she stands in his way due to her insurmountable credentials, leaving him heartbroken and unable to confess his feelings. One day, having overheard a tip about Ye-rin's birthday party, Dae-oh musters up the courage to rush to the venue. However, upon arrival, he finds himself at the site of a democratization movement where all the so-called "successful" college students are gathered! "I thought I could have you if I made a revolution!" Caught between the students and unable to decide what to do, Dae-oh decides that since he's already gone this far, he will impersonate a legendary revolutionary fighter from the student movement—Ye-rin's ideal type—to win her heart... Will the average-looking Kang Dae-oh be able to achieve the democratization of romance in this land?

fields.title: Red Vacation Black Wedding
fields.description: Hee-rae (Ahn Ji-hye) has been having an affair with Tae-mook (Jo Seon-mook), a married man, for several years. They promised to go on a trip abroad, but when they head to the airport the next day, Tae-mook is nowhere to be found. His wife, Bok-soon (Lee Jin-ju), has left for Muju to confine him. Hee-rae misunderstands, believing Tae-mook has declared a breakup, but upon receiving a text message from him telling her to come to Muju M Pension, she leaves for Muju, completely unaware of what lies ahead. Meanwhile, Su-ji (Oh In-hye) is having an affair with her former mentor, the man (Jo Seon-mook) who officiated her wedding. Filled with fantasies of sleeping with Su-ji during the wedding, he returns to the home where they used to live together after she leaves for her honeymoon. However, someone knocks on the door. It is Su-ji, who says she wanted to see him one more time before leaving for her honeymoon…

fields.title: The Lady in the Sword: Memories of the Sword
fields.description: In an era ruled by the sword, the betrayal of a man who dreamed of becoming king at the end of the Goryeo Dynasty, and the two swords aimed at him 18 years later. Yu Baek, the sword that coveted Goryeo. Wol So, the sword that upheld righteousness. Hong Yi, the sword that dreamed of revenge. Three swords with differing intentions clash.

fields.title: slow motion video
fields.description: A strong-willed man who can see even the fleeting moments others miss. Leaving behind a childhood where he was ridiculed for his unique eyesight, he rises to become the ace of the CCTV control center, recognized for his exceptional ability to capture instants. This man, who watches over us all day long and unexpectedly enters our daily lives!

fields.title: Come, Together
fields.description: In a South Korea facing an era of 1.35 million unemployed, 1 million credit delinquents, and 18 trillion won spent on private education, a crisis strikes an ordinary family struggling to make ends meet. There is Beom-gu (Im Hyung-guk), fired from the company he worked at for 18 years; Mi-young (Lee Hye-eun), a credit card saleswoman who lost her top spot to a rival due to fierce competition; and Hanna (Chae Bin), a student retaking her college entrance exams who anxiously awaits news of her acceptance every day. Although they are family, these three lack the capacity to comfort each other's problems, and amidst this crisis, they face unexpected events...

fields.title: superman
fields.description: Dohyun, a gymnast who ended up working at the library after causing trouble at school, meets Suhyun, a mysterious girl who borrows books every day. At Suhyun's urging, he begins reading books for the first time in his life, even shedding tears! “Is there really a path inside books?” Watching airplanes fly in the sky and shouting on a bridge over the Han River, the two grow closer. Dohyun begins to feel emotions for Suhyun for the first time: excitement, nervousness, and a pounding heart! However, wavering and full of unknowns, Dohyun and Suhyun find every moment difficult.

fields.title: Fish that came out onto land
Faces
fields.description: One day, Giseon, a high school administrative staff member, suddenly becomes curious about Jinsu, a student on the soccer team. Giseon's ex-girlfriend, Hyejin, quits her job and is busy remodeling her mother's small restaurant. Hyunsu, a delivery driver who is the only one free, brushes past them. The characters, who seem to live only within their own worlds, faintly overlap.

fields.title: Home
fields.description: Bogeumjari Housing - Ji-soo and Se-hoon, who plan to adopt a child to win the lottery for multi-child housing, end up adopting a mysterious child named Tak. Upon meeting Tak when he arrives home, Ji-soo begins to be engulfed by an inexplicable sense of unease. Tak dotes on the couple's seven-year-old daughter, Bom. However, Bom feels uncomfortable around Tak, and Ji-soo, who is nine weeks pregnant and watching this situation unfold, also becomes increasingly irritable. Her husband, Se-hoon, who is solely devoted to his desire to receive a new house, fails to understand Ji-soo's ominous feelings, and thus, the relationship between Ji-soo's family and Tak heads toward an unpredictable phase.

fields.title: upper class
fields.description: Tae-jun, an economics professor who enjoys both popularity and respect from his students, runs for National Assembly as a promising political newcomer through a chance opportunity. Meanwhile, his wife, Su-yeon, the deputy director of the Future Art Museum, aims to take over the directorship through the museum's reopening exhibition. However, when it is revealed that a dark deal between the Mirae Group and the Minguk Party lies behind Su-yeon's art dealings and Tae-jun's election campaign, the couple faces a crisis just as they are on the verge of entering perfect high society. Unable to let this opportunity slip away, Tae-jun and Su-yeon propose a new deal to the Minguk Party and the Mirae Group...

fields.title: Angry Bull
fields.description: Dong-cheol, having left his rough past behind, was living an upstanding life distributing dried seafood at a fish market. One day, his wife, Ji-su, is kidnapped, and although he reports it to the police, her whereabouts remain unknown. Then, Dong-cheol receives a call from the kidnapper. Instead of offering a large sum of money, the kidnapper makes an outrageous offer to pay him for Ji-su's abduction. Enraged by this, Dong-cheol begins to take action to rescue her…

fields.title: girl
fields.description: Yunsu carries the scar of a friend's suicide caused by rumors stemming from a trivial slip of the tongue. On the day he moves to a rural village, he falls for Haewon, a girl skating on a frozen lake. Before long, he learns that everyone in the village speaks of her disrespectfully... and he finds himself unable to simply stand by and watch a girl bearing wounds eerily similar to his own past, which was also tormented by rumors... “We didn’t kill her.” One night, as cruel rumors once again sweep through the village, Yunsu witnesses Haewon entering a room holding a knife, and the next day, her father is found dead with one arm severed. Faced with increasingly horrific events, rumors, and cold stares, Yunsu is ultimately forced to make an irreversible choice to protect Haewon.

fields.title: Brave citizens
fields.description: A contract teacher and ordinary citizen who has lived a quiet life just to make a living, turning a blind eye to injustice, feigning a cold temper, and feigning weakness. She witnesses the boundary-crossing behavior of Han Su-gang, an arrogant absolute ruler who fears neither the law nor the police. Unable to tolerate his continued evil deeds any longer, she resolves to deliver a satisfying blow while concealing her true identity…

fields.title: birth
fields.description: Kim Dae-geon is a curious young man of action rather than words. He willingly accepts his destiny to become Joseon's first priest and sets out to study in Macau with his fellow seminarians, Choi Yang-eop and Choi Bang-je. In a time when foreign invasions continued both within and outside the country and the Opium War had not yet ended, Kim Dae-geon, who dreamed of a new Joseon, traversed the seas and lands with boundless energy, ultimately paving the way for the modern era!

fields.title: Window shopping
fields.description: An action thriller depicting the desperate survival and revenge of children who barely survived the brink of death after being abandoned by their adoptive parents.

fields.title: Polar Star
fields.description: In Seoul, South Korea, a presidential candidate is shot during a Mass praying for peaceful reunification. At this historic scene that shocked the world, Moon-ju and San-ho meet as if drawn by fate. As they get closer to the truth hidden behind the incident, a massive conspiracy surrounding the Korean Peninsula is revealed… Can the two brave the fierce storm and reach the brightest place?

fields.title: husbands
fields.description: Ex-husband X Current Husband, Rescue the Kidnapped Wife! Two husbands with vastly different personalities and professions unexpectedly join forces with the sole determination to save the wife. A comedic action film highlighting the unpredictable teamwork chemistry between the two men.

fields.title: Boy's Story
fields.description: A fable about a monster created by the indifference of adults. Unable to endure his father's ceaseless abuse any longer, 13-year-old Young-hoon runs away from home. With nowhere to go and no one to welcome him, Young-hoon boards the subway aimlessly at Oido Station, where he coincidentally meets Hyun-soo, an orphan of the same age. Hyun-soo, having escaped from the orphanage and already served time in a juvenile detention center, inspires a strange sense of admiration in Young-hoon due to his uninhibited behavior, leading him to come to rely on him. One day, upon hearing the news that his girlfriend, Hanna, is pregnant, Hyun-soo heads with Young-hoon to the area around Seoul Station, where children of the same age live in a group, in order to raise money for hospital bills.

fields.title: The Conspirators
fields.description: Sang-ho and Chae-hee board a passenger ship bound for Weihai, China, amidst a throng of travelers. They are overjoyed to be on their first trip together. However, their excitement is short-lived. That night, while Sang-ho is briefly away, his wife vanishes without a trace from the ship, which lies in the middle of the open sea with no exit. Even more confusing is the fact that all the photos taken with her during the trip, as well as her belongings, have disappeared! To make matters worse, her name is missing from the passenger manifest. Meanwhile, Young-gyu, the mastermind behind the organ trafficking operation and the industry's top expert, receives an offer he cannot refuse from the mastermind Dong-bae and is preparing for the operation alongside Kyung-jae, a traveling surgeon; Jun-sik, the transporter; and Dae-ung, the lookout. The operation is being conducted in top secret, from bribing customs officers to transporting the package. Amidst the tension where not a single mistake is tolerated, Young-gyu is engulfed in shock upon examining the "package" on the workbench. It is the Chae-hee he knew from the past! Now, they have only six hours left to reach Weihai! Sang-ho begins his relentless pursuit in search of his wife, and Young-gyu falls into a dilemma where he can neither kill nor save Chae-hee…

fields.title: Love at the End of the World
Adult Encyclopedia
fields.description: Fourteen-year-old Gyeong-eon meets her uncle Jae-min, whom she has never met before, at her father's funeral. Jae-min, a bumbling con artist, loses all the insurance money left to Gyeong-eon, so the two stage a daring scam against a local pharmacist, posing as father and daughter, in order to raise money.

fields.title: bargaining
fields.description: The worst kidnapping incident occurs in the conflict zone of Afghanistan, where South Koreans are abducted by the Taliban. Jae-ho, a diplomat specializing in negotiations but unfamiliar with Afghanistan, heads to the scene and meets Dae-sik, an agent from the National Intelligence Service. A diplomat with strong principles and an NIS agent well-versed in local conditions. Although their positions and methods differ, they move forward together toward the goal of saving the hostages. As the deadline for killing approaches and negotiation counterparts and conditions shift by the minute, the chances of a successful negotiation become increasingly slim...

fields.title: Wonderland
fields.description: In a world where the Wonderland service—which restores the deceased using artificial intelligence—has become commonplace, Baili commissions the service to hide her own death from her young daughter, while Jungin shares a happy daily life with her boyfriend Taeju, who has been resurrected as an alien in Wonderland after an accident. People are now able to choose a life free from longing or sorrow. One day, Taeju miraculously wakes up from his coma and returns to her side; however, as she faces a reality where everything is unfamiliar and confusing, cracks begin to appear in Jungin's heart. Meanwhile, Baili, restored as an archaeologist roaming excavation sites in Wonderland, strives to be a mother who is like a friend to her daughter through video calls, but an unexpected error occurs when the service suddenly shuts down…

fields.title: Limit
fields.description: Detective So-eun takes on the role of a stand-in mother for the investigation following a series of child kidnappings. While struggling to find a lead in the case, So-eun receives a mysterious phone call. Then, a familiar voice is heard on the other end of the line. The culprit demands a negotiation with So-eun herself, rather than the stand-in…

fields.title: fairy
fields.description: The cafe's profit determines the family hierarchy! Young-ran and Ho-cheol, who run a cafe in the same neighborhood, head straight for romance after a subtle war of nerves and become a married couple. Due to their remaining lease, Young-ran and Ho-cheol end up running their shops separately. A subtle, yet ironic, competition arises where higher profits elevate their family rank, while lower profits lower it. Then, a fairy arrives like a mysterious stroke of luck! One day, an unexpected accident leads them to meet a mysterious young man named Seok, with whom they begin living together. As soon as Seok helps out at Ho-cheol's cafe, the profit margin skyrockets. Suspicious of the sudden turnaround in returns, Young-ran realizes that business is booming simply because of Seok's presence, leading to a childish battle of wits…

fields.title: Kyung-ah's daughter
fields.description: Yeon-su, the only source of strength for Gyeong-a living alone, has been so difficult to even see since she moved out. Then one day, a video leaked by her ex-boyfriend shatters Yeon-su's ordinary life, and this incident sends uncontrollable ripples through the once-calm lives of the mother and daughter…

fields.title: The sea between you and me
fields.description: One night, Sumin secretly looked at his lover Eunyoung's smartphone and became convinced that she had another man. A few days later, when Eunyoung returned home after working overtime, he unexpectedly asked her to go with him to Mokseom Island in the West Sea, which served as the motif for his novel.

fields.title: Strong Woman Gangnamsun
fields.description: There was a Do Bong-soon in Dobong-gu. Descendants possessing this strong genetic trait, which originated from a powerful ancestor, are living in other regions as well. Genetically speaking, they would be about sixth cousins to Do Bong-soon. In other words, Do Bong-soon's grandmother and Kang Nam-soon's grandmother are sisters. A global three-generation project created by these three mother and daughters: Kang Nam-soon and her mother Hwang Geum-ju—who were given names that were vulgar and lacked nobility for the illogical reason that they would offset the peculiarity of their special genetic traits—and Nam-soon's maternal grandmother Gil Jung-gan! As the saying goes, the more of good things, the better. More is better! Stronger power and more comedy!

fields.title: I'm sorry, thank you
fields.description: An omnibus film depicting the love and bonds with animals, human companions such as dogs and cats. You, the kindest and prettiest person in the world, who cared for me like a father, became my lonely friend, and followed me around like a younger sibling... Warm physical contact with animals that soothe the heart.

fields.title: My Little Hero
fields.description: Music Director Yoo Il-han (Kim Rae-won) is a man riddled with arrogance and snobbery! Once a promising musical director, he now drifts from one children's musical to another, dreaming of a comeback after a major production he directed flopped. Then, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to break into Broadway presents itself: a musical audition program! This audition, where he teams up with child actors via a blind test, is a veritable war for him! Yoo Il-han teams up with Young-gwang (Ji Dae-han), an unconventional partner blessed with a heavenly voice. Aside from his singing ability, Young-gwang lacks the visuals, dancing skills, or connections compared to the other actors. Yoo Il-han, who is deeply displeased with Young-gwang—whose complexion is even different from his own—for the audition to play the lead role of "King Jeongjo of Joseon," subjects him to unilateral, grueling training driven by his obsession with winning first place. "Until you succeed!" Despite Yoo Il-han's reckless training, Young-gwang refuses to give up on his challenge. He discovers that Young-gwang also has another reason why he must win... Can Yoo Il-han, who has zero communication, zero hope, and is bursting with bravado, advance to the dream stage of Broadway with his unconventional partner Young-gwang, who has only a 1% chance of winning?

Han Min-woo is a genius bestselling novelist enjoying immense popularity thanks to his dazzling resume and good looks. With his marriage to his wealthy and charming fiancée, Eun-hye, just around the corner, his life seems perfect. However, the novel he recently began writing is not progressing well, and he is plagued by frequent insomnia. Furthermore, starting one day, he finds himself unable to escape someone's gaze, no matter where he goes, who he is with, or what he does. Then, one day, as if drawn in a dream, he opens the door to Lupin Bar, a pub located in an alleyway. There, he meets a girl dressed in purple. Her name is Mimi. She is Min-woo's first love, whom he parted ways with 11 years ago, and the very owner of the gaze that has been following him. Meanwhile, Eun-hye grows anxious due to Min-woo's continuing, inexplicable behavior. She instinctively senses that, contrary to her unwavering love for him, his gaze is directed toward someone else. Min-woo sets out to find clues to his unresolved novel and to reclaim the memories of his first love that had been completely forgotten. Meanwhile, Mimi hovers around Min-woo, seemingly being chased by something. Eun-hye, who can only watch helplessly as Min-woo wanders through memories of his first love. Their terrifyingly sad and beautiful love story begins.

fields.title: Person of merit
fields.description: Park Il-rae, a despicable old man facing death, takes on the challenge to fulfill his final dream of becoming a person of national merit. The chaotic journey of the Korean Don Quixote, Park Il-rae (meaning "the seed waiting for the sun"), as he attempts to become a national meritorious service recipient!

fields.title: We are brothers
fields.description: Brothers Sang-yeon and Ha-yeon, who were separated at an orphanage in their childhood, successfully had a dramatic reunion 30 years later! But now that they've actually met... are they really blood relatives?! To make matters worse, their joy at reuniting after 30 years was short-lived, as their mother vanished without a trace after just 30 minutes! Chasing a tip about her sighting, the two brothers embark on a nationwide expedition across every corner of the country! From their accents and styles to their professions, these brothers are just so different! Will they be able to find their missing mother and rediscover their lost brotherhood?

fields.title: silence
fields.description: Im Tae-san is a man who has it all—wealth, love, and the world. On the day he believed his life was perfectly happy, his fiancée, the famous singer Yuna, is murdered, and his daughter, Im Mi-ra, is named as the suspect. The case draws the public's attention. Im Tae-san begins to pursue the case in his own way to prove his daughter's innocence, as she cannot remember the events of that day. Rejecting the best legal team, he hires Choi Hee-jung, a young lawyer who believes in Mi-ra's innocence and will embrace her. A fierce legal battle ensues over the time Mi-ra cannot recall, but the case takes an unexpected turn when the existence of Kim Dong-myeong, a fan of Yuna who possesses the CCTV footage from that day, is revealed...

fields.title: Beast
fields.description: A sensational murder case shakes South Korea, and Han-su, the ace of the Violent Crimes Unit who has stopped at nothing to catch criminals, begins an investigation with his junior detective, Jong-chan, to apprehend the culprit. Meanwhile, drug broker Chun-bae provides Han-su with crucial clues about the killer in exchange for covering up the murder, but as Han-su's rival detective, Min-tae, catches on to this, the case spirals out of control...

fields.title: The most beautiful farewell in the world
fields.description: “I’m tired.” The head of the household (Kim Gap-soo) who cares only about his hospital work. “Give me food, give me food.” The grandmother (Kim Ji-young) who has become like a child. “I’ll handle it myself.” The eldest daughter (Park Ha-sun) who is always busy. “It’s fine.” The son who is a three-time college entrance exam failure obsessed with his girlfriend. “Give me some money.” The unemployed uncle and aunt (Yoo Jun-sang & Seo Young-hee) who cause trouble at the slightest provocation. And... the mother (Bae Jong-ok) who has many dreams and much to do. The moment of farewell arrived in a daily life that seemed destined to repeat forever. Since that day… we became a true ‘family.’

fields.title: Bad Guys and Girls
fields.description: ‘Finally! I found my woman?!’ The refreshing girl who made my heart flutter—turned out to be… the specialist in phone terror, the very… ruthless… card company woman! ‘Finally! I found my man?!’ The kind man who returned my wallet—turned out to be… the very… vicious… customer who was screwing me over! A wrongful encounter between a detective with a bad credit rating and a counselor with a bad temper! A guy who is even more tenacious has appeared before this debt collection expert… Their neck-and-neck, fiery ‘debt’ war begins!!

fields.title: I am a dad
fields.description: Han Jong-sik (Kim Seung-woo), a corrupt detective who frames innocent people to make them criminals, protects a criminal organization, and pockets bribes to keep his sick daughter alive, receives a call one day from a hospital organ transplant coordinator (Choi Jung-yoon) informing him that a heart has been found for his daughter Min-ji (Kim Sae-ron). However, he discovers that the guardian is none other than the magician Na Sang-man (Son Byung-ho), whom he had wrongly framed and sent to prison. Meanwhile, Detective Kim (Im Ha-ryong), Jong-sik's colleague who harbors doubts about Sang-man's case, discovers crucial evidence that could reveal the real culprit and begins to threaten Jong-sik. Cornered, Jong-sik senses that Sang-man will not easily consent to the transplant and attempts to hand him over to a criminal organization; however, sensing this, Sang-man kidnaps Jong-sik's daughter and disappears instead…

fields.title: Pinching off romance
fields.description: Cheon Ji-woong, an unemployed young man who fails to find a job repeatedly, has run out of his allowance, and can't even afford a single penny for a date, is on the verge of being kicked out of his rented rooftop room to make matters worse. However, he meets Gu Hong-sil, a "bottle-collecting savior" who appears just in time. Hong-sil, a national treasure-level penny-pincher with a life philosophy that she can't spend money on dating, religion, or illness, makes Ji-woong a tempting offer to teach him her money-making know-how. But as the saying goes, nothing in this world is free! Hong-sil sets a condition: he must unconditionally follow her instructions for two months. The strange thing is, Hong-sil opens Ji-woong's bank account in her own name. Hong-sil bosses Ji-woong around like a half-servant, while Ji-woong reluctantly follows her into the workforce. Despite clashing at every turn, their tough partnership begins to gradually grow their bank balance...

fields.title: You don't even understand my feelings
Couples
fields.description: Yu-seok, searching for his girlfriend who vanished after leaving a single text message; Ae-yeon, a woman clutching only a high-quality cubic zirconia ring left by her ex-boyfriend; Na-ri, a woman wandering like the wind in search of love; Bok-nam, a self-proclaimed "urban hyena" who fell in love with a friend of a friend; and Byeong-chan, a rough man who believed love would never exist for him. Five singles, each with their own unique story, become entangled in a web of coincidence and destiny, fate and misfortune...

fields.title: Aging family
fields.description: A family acting immature begins to gather once again at Mom's peaceful home. There is Han-mo, the immature, unemployed eldest who lives off his mother; In-mo, the second, a box-office flop director; and Mi-yeon, the third, a shameless romanticist on her third marriage. With the three siblings who are nothing but awkward around each other, and Min-kyung, a middle school girl who is the spitting image of Mi-yeon and lacks common sense, the inside story of this group, where incidents and accidents never cease whenever they get together, is revealed.

fields.title: scary stories
fields.description: A high school girl slowly opens her eyes to the strange sound of a knife slashing beyond the sound of water. Looking around with eyes filled with fear, she soon realizes that she has been kidnapped by an unknown man. Feeling the terror of death as the man slowly approaches, she begins to tell a ‘scary story’ to buy time…

fields.title: Suspect X
fields.description: A genius mathematician's perfect alibi begins! Seok-go (Ryu Seung-bum), once known as a genius but now living an ordinary life as a high school math teacher, discovers one day that Hwa-sun (Lee Yo-won), who moved in next door, accidentally killed her ex-husband. Seok-go devises a perfect alibi for her, whom he had been secretly watching over, and surprisingly, Hwa-sun even passes a lie detector test, moving further away from the list of suspects. However, the detective in charge of the case, Min-bum (Jo Jin-woong), is convinced by his animalistic instincts that Hwa-sun is the killer and begins to relentlessly pursue her. Will the alibi established by the genius mathematician Seok-go be able to save her?

fields.title: cold
fields.description: A man who transported undocumented migrant workers to Bundang dies after contracting a virus of unknown origin. Less than 24 hours after the patient's death, identical patients begin appearing one after another at every hospital in Bundang. As the death toll rises exponentially, the citizens of Bundang are left defenseless against the virus. Fear of infection grips South Korea; facing the worst virus in history—infecting 3.4 people per second via the respiratory system and leading to death within 36 hours—the government declares a national disaster to prevent a secondary spread, ultimately making the unprecedented decision to lock down the city. Quarantined without a moment to escape, people are engulfed in chaos, and those trying to save their loved ones amidst the catastrophe and those fighting to survive begin a life-or-death struggle…

fields.title: Queen of the Night
fields.description: Young-soo is an ultra-A-grade timid man. He is the epitome of an unappealing, timid guy who has never dated, possessing no interest in women even if a perfect woman like Lee Hyori were to appear. However, while stopping by a sandwich cafe for lunch, he meets a part-timer named Hee-ju and falls in love at first sight. Due to his timid nature, he endures dozens of days of eating sandwiches for lunch without even being able to strike up a conversation. Finally, gathering his courage and calming his trembling heart, he proposes to her holding a single rose. Fortunately, Hee-ju, recognizing Young-soo's pure heart, readily accepts his proposal, and the two successfully get married. Young-soo feels like he has everything in the world; his newlywed life is a smooth ride, and his happiness index keeps rising. Then, one day, he accidentally discovers an ominous photograph behind the toilet. He cries out with his mouth, “Nah… it can’t be Hee-ju,” but suspicion is already stirring within him, and soon he begins to cautiously dig into his wife’s dark past behind her back.... She possesses an angelic appearance, first-class hotel-quality cooking skills, and the intellectual capacity to speak three languages. ‘Hee-ju,’ the Ultra-Class Ideal Wife—I’ve been deceived!
