To think that the woman I thought was Korea’s quintessential ideal wife had such a dark past! “My suspicion began small, but the end of my obsession shall be glorious!”

fields.title: Big Match
fields.description: Top-notch action! The chase is instinctive! Humor is optional! The super-fast, infinite chase begins for the indomitable fighter 'Ik-ho' (Lee Jung-jae) to rescue his brother (Lee Sung-min), who was kidnapped by the genius villain 'Ace' (Shin Ha-kyun)! From escaping a jail cell to a massive gambling den, Sangam Stadium, and Seoul Station, a non-stop chase unfolds across the entire city. There is only one rule of the game: stop or die. A once-in-a-lifetime, life-or-death big match begins! A super-entertainment action film depicting 'Ik-ho's' (Lee Jung-jae) endless chase across the entire city to save his brother from the genius villain (Shin Ha-kyun).

fields.title: Don't forget me
fields.description: Seok-won is a man whose memories of the past 10 years have been erased following a car accident. With his friends, family, and even his own identity blurred, Seok-won coincidentally meets Jin-young at the hospital, a stranger who sheds tears upon seeing him. Although he doesn't know much about her, Seok-won finds new happiness in being with Jin-young. Jin-young falls in love with a man who is amazed by smartphones and doesn't know figures like Yuna Kim or Ryu Hyun-jin. She cherishes and is happy with the time she spends with him, who remains stuck in the past of 10 years ago. However, this happiness, which feels as if time has stopped, is short-lived. As Seok-won's memories of the past gradually return, Jin-young begins to waver, fearing that her current happiness will be shattered…

fields.title: Rogue
fields.description: Detective Jung Jae-gon is a man willing to use any means necessary to catch a criminal. He is pursuing Park Jun-gil, who committed murder and went into hiding. The only clue to catching him is Park Jun-gil's lover, Kim Hye-kyung. Hiding his identity, Jae-gon infiltrates "Macau," the hostess bar where Hye-kyung works, as a sales manager. However, while staying by Hye-kyung's side to catch Jun-gil, Jae-gon senses the loneliness, tears, and innocence hidden behind the decadent and tough exterior of the barmaid. Addicted solely to the goal of catching the culprit, he finds his heart wavering without even understanding the nature of his own emotions. Meanwhile, Hye-kyung, waiting for Jun-gil to contact her at any moment, begins to open her heart to him for staying by her side.

fields.title: Love story
fields.description: Yun-ju (Lee Sang-hee), an art student, meets someone who keeps catching her eye while preparing for her graduation exhibition. Drawn in by the warmth she felt from a brief eye contact, Yun-ju begins to feel increasingly drawn to him. Ji-su (Ryu Seon-young), who is pursuing her dream while working part-time jobs, meets someone who looks at her warmly one cold winter day. Some time later, Ji-su meets that person again and reaches out her hand to try and keep their feelings connected. Can this happiest and warmest moment, when their hearts were united, truly last forever...?

fields.title: Exclusive: The Liangchen Murder Case
fields.description: Heo Mu-hyeok, a passionate reporter facing the crisis of divorce and dismissal, breaks the scoop of a lifetime regarding a serial murder case thanks to a chance tip. However, when he discovers that the serial killer's handwritten note he obtained exclusively is a passage from the novel *The Liangchen Murder Case*, Mu-hyeok realizes that the scoop that shook the world was an unprecedented mistake. Events unfold exactly as he reports them. Unaware of this, the newsroom awaits follow-up reports, while the police pressure Mu-hyeok to reveal the details of his investigation. Amidst an uncontrollable situation where a witness claiming to know the truth behind the scoop even appears, actual murders begin to occur exactly as Mu-hyeok reported in his false report…

fields.title: Mrs. Cop
fields.description: A perfect score as a police officer, a zero as a mother. This work portrays the greatness and hardships of South Korean working mothers through the exploits of a righteous and passionate female police officer. In 2013, when the world was in an uproar over the Yeomchang-dong rape and murder case, Young-jin, the team leader of Violent Crimes Team 5, who was desperate to apprehend the serial killer, finds a prime suspect right before his eyes while on stakeout with his right-hand man, Jae-deok. But of all days, today is his only daughter's school performance! He ignores a call from his younger brother, Nam-jin, urging him to hurry, and even breaks his promise to his daughter to catch the culprit, yet something feels off...

fields.title: Wednesday prayer meeting
fields.description: Hera is a middle-aged woman who works in door-to-door cosmetics sales. Having narrowly escaped a crisis thanks to Soyeon, whom she met by chance, Hera offers Soyeon a part-time job at a Wednesday prayer meeting in gratitude for the kindness shown to her.

fields.title: more
fields.description: Hojeong and Jieun are best friends. Their relationship, which had always been together, begins to crack slowly with the arrival of Junyeong, a male classmate. (2017 7th Seoul Pride Film Festival)

fields.title: Change of seasons
fields.description: Mikyung lives separately from her husband while raising her high school senior son, Suhyun. Although Suhyun is not particularly affectionate toward his mother, he is a kind son. One day, Suhyun brings home his friend Yongjun, who is going through a difficult time, to live with them. Yongjun is a young man of few words with a somber expression. A few years later, after being discharged from the military, Suhyun is involved in an accident while traveling with Yongjun and falls into a critical condition. Mikyung, who stays by her son Suhyun's side during his battle with the disease while he is in a vegetative state, feels nothing but resentment toward Yongjun for returning unharmed. Later, upon belatedly discovering that Suhyun and Yongjun were in love, Mikyung disappears with her son Suhyun without Yongjun's knowledge. Left alone, Yongjun searches desperately for Suhyun and Mikyung.

fields.title: Ryeonhui and Yeonhui
fields.description: Kim Ryeon-hui, who lost her child while defecting from North Korea, barely survives day by day, burdened by heavy guilt. Seventeen-year-old Kim Yeon-hui appears at the convenience store where Ryeon-hui works and steals expired triangle kimbap. Ryeon-hui is stunned to learn that the runaway girl, Yeon-hui, is pregnant with a child whose father's identity is unknown—a fact one would only be known after birth. Through Yeon-hui, who is like a small bird flying into her life, Ryeon-hui discovers hope to break free from the guilt she has long carried and start a new life…

fields.title: The gambler
fields.description: News breaks that Jang Doo-chil, the notorious swindler who turned South Korea upside down, has suddenly died. However, rumors circulate that he is still alive, and speculation begins to spread that the powerful figures who protected him intentionally let him go. Ji-sung, a swindler who targets only other swindlers, claims that Jang Doo-chil is still alive and proposes to Prosecutor Park Hee-soo, who is in charge of the case, that they catch him for sure. Enlisting the help of Prosecutor Park’s unofficial trio of swindlers—Go Seok-dong, Chun-ja, and Manager Kim—they begin to devise a new plan to approach Kwak Seung-geon, Jang Doo-chil’s right-hand man who has gone into hiding. However, Prosecutor Park is secretly formulating an operation for a different purpose than arresting Jang Doo-chil. Sensing this, Ji-sung and the other swindlers begin to devise their own plans to avoid being deceived by one another…

fields.title: A winter guest scarier than a tiger
fields.description: One winter day, when a tiger escapes from the zoo, Gyeong-yu (Lee Jin-wook), who had been living with his girlfriend, is kicked out by her for unknown reasons. With nowhere to go, Gyeong-yu starts working part-time as a designated driver, dragging a single suitcase. Then, one night, Yu-jeong (Go Hyun-jung), who has become the novelist Gyeong-yu had always dreamed of becoming, appears before him.

fields.title: Vampire Prosecutor
fields.description: A drama depicting the investigation of a vampire prosecutor who can see the final circumstances of a murder and the trajectory of the blood when tasting the blood of the dead.

fields.title: freight car
fields.description: One month before their wedding, Moon-ho and Seon-young stopped at a rest area on their way to Moon-ho's parents' house. When Moon-ho returned from buying coffee, all that awaited him was his car idling with the door open. Her phone was off, and she had vanished without a trace. To find her, Moon-ho sought help from his cousin, Jong-geun, a former homicide detective. However, everything about her—she has no family or friends—is fake. Suspecting that this is no ordinary missing person case due to Seon-young's unusual behavior—withdrawing her entire bank balance and erasing her fingerprints from her home on the day of her disappearance—Jong-geun discovers that she is connected to a murder case. Who exactly was she? As they get closer to uncovering her true identity, increasingly shocking truths begin to be revealed…

fields.title: Eunkyo
fields.description: One day, a high school girl named Eun-kyo unexpectedly appears at the home of the aging poet Lee Jeok-yo, located in a secluded mountain area frequented only by his disciple, the novelist Seo Ji-woo, who treats him like a father. As Eun-kyo begins helping with the housework and lets out a clear laugh, Lee Jeok-yo is captivated by her fresh physique—young, innocent, yet possessing a sensual allure. Meanwhile, the disciple, who respects his teacher yet is torn between jealousy toward the girl Eun-kyo and his inability to grasp his master's talent, silently grows a sense of inferiority. Thus unfolds the hidden story of these three people, entangled in jealousy and allure...

fields.title: Marriage Tricks
fields.description: The Trick of Marriage is a South Korean television drama. Cast: Kang Hye-jung: as Yoo Gun-hee, Lee Kyu-han: as Lee Kang-jae, Lee Young-eun: as Yoo Sun-hee, Lee Min-woo: as Seo Jang-won, Cha Hwa-yeon: as So Doo-ryun, Yoon Joo-sang: as Lee Hak-gun, Park Min-ji: as Yoo Min-ji, Kim Won-jun: as Park Soo-ho, Kim Se-jeong: as Yoo Min-jung, Seo Jae-kyung: as Kim Soon-dol, Kim Jae-deuk: as Park Se-won, Park Ga-won: as Hana, Park Jung-won: as Park Chang-gil, Son Jung-min: as Bella, Kim Dong-soo: as Bella's Husband, Kim Ik-tae: as Director Park, Jung Seung-ho: as Jang Deok-pal, Jung Ha-yoon. External links: 2012 Drama, tvN Television Drama.

fields.title: Jump to the south
fields.description: The Choi Hae-gap family—the true bosses of this era who refuse to do what they disapprove of and speak their minds—are coming! Choi Hae-gap and his family want to live their lives refusing to do what they disapprove of and speaking their minds. Believing that they can thrive without trying too hard or being different from others, they set off for a southern island in search of happiness. However, their peaceful life is short-lived as they encounter an unexpected incident that shakes the island to its core...

fields.title: The Law of Sensuality
fields.description: "We certainly have an elegant vibe!" Shin-hye, a single woman in her 40s dating a younger man; Mi-yeon, a provocative housewife who confidently pursues her desires; and Hae-young, a single mom dating secretly behind her daughter's back. These three friends, in the prime of their 40s blooming more brilliantly than flowers, believe they are at their best right now! Although they live with their own wounds and worries, this is their honest story of wanting to brazenly reveal their feelings, enjoy life to the fullest, and pursue work, love, and sex with passion—just for this moment.

fields.title: My love, my bride
fields.description: Regret whether you do it or not? Is marriage really like this for everyone?! Young-min (Jo Jung-suk) and Mi-young (Shin Min-ah), an ordinary Korean couple, tied the knot after four years of dating. Their sweet newlywed life, which they thought would be endlessly happy, was short-lived. As minor misunderstandings and frictions arise, their "dream of marriage" begins to shatter one by one... Was this really the right decision to get married? Young-min, an immature husband who is impossible to reason with, and Mi-young, a wife whose nagging only increases at every turn—they married because they truly loved each other, so why is it so difficult? A deep, heartfelt story unfolds that goes beyond the marriage they imagined and dreamed of!

fields.title: File: 4022 Days of Rearing
fields.description: A friend who vanished without a trace has reappeared after 11 years. Along with a perfect lover… Su-kyung (Kang Byul), a successful social affairs reporter, carries the heartbreaking memory of the disappearance of her best friend from school, Mi-soo (Ha Yeon-ju). One day, she hears from her senior, Min-guk, the editor-in-chief of a local newspaper, that he saw Mi-soo, and she begins to track her whereabouts. However, the Mi-soo she encounters for the first time in 11 years has transformed completely from her lively self into someone who appears somewhat anxious. And always by her side is her lover, Dr. Han Dong-min (Lee Jong-hyuk), a promising genetic engineering researcher… In December, a shocking truth you never imagined will be revealed!

fields.title: informant
fields.description: As the research results of Dr. Lee Jang-hwan, who succeeded in extracting human embryonic stem cells for the first time in the world, garner national attention, PD Yoon Min-cheol of "PD Chase" receives a phone call from an anonymous informant. Team Leader Shim Min-ho, who had been conducting stem cell research with Dr. Lee until recently, makes a declaration of conscience to PD Yoon, revealing that the論文 (paper) was fabricated and disclosing unethical conduct that occurred during the stem cell experiments. PD Yoon, who plunged into the case relying solely on the informant's testimony, feels overwhelmed by fierce criticism from public opinion and the media claiming that criticizing Dr. Lee runs counter to the national interest, and ultimately faces a crisis where the broadcast is on the verge of being canceled…

fields.title: thawing ice
fields.description: A new town in Gyeonggi Province. Seung-hoon, an internal medicine doctor who got a job at a senior colleague's hospital after divorcing following the bankruptcy of his own, rents a studio apartment in a building owned by Seong-geun, who runs a butcher shop and restaurant while caring for his father, Mr. Jeong, who suffers from dementia. One day, Seung-hoon overhears Mr. Jeong making remarks that sound like a confession of murder while in a semi-conscious state during a sleep endoscopy, leading him to suspect the father and son. Murder cases begin again in the once-quiet town, and Seung-hoon is gripped by fear. Meanwhile, the police arrive, reporting that his ex-wife, who had come to visit him, has gone missing…

fields.title: The room where silkworms were raised
fields.description: Chae Mi-hee (Lee Sang-hee), who has been studying for the civil service exam for 10 years, follows a female student (Kim Sae-byeok) she encounters on the subway one day. While following the student, Chae Mi-hee meets Jo Sung-sook (Hong Seung-yi) and abruptly claims to be Jo Sung-sook's best friend from long ago. Although Jo Sung-sook considers Chae Mi-hee a stranger, she begins to build a new relationship with her as a friend. Meanwhile, Kim Ik-ju (Im Hyung-guk), who lives with Jo Sung-sook, is displeased by Chae Mi-hee's rude intrusion but gradually reveals his vulnerable side to the stranger. At the same time, Jo Sung-sook recalls memories of her best friend, Kim Yu-young (Kim Sae-byeok), from long ago.

fields.title: Female employees of a game company
split
fields.description: Cheol-jong, once a legendary figure in the bowling world, lost everything in an unfortunate accident and now leads a listless life, working as a fake oil salesman by day and a player in gambling bowling rings by night. One day, however, he coincidentally meets Young-hoon, a man who lives in his own world but possesses a genius talent for bowling. Cheol-jong eventually recruits Young-hoon as his partner. Under the leadership of Hee-jin, Cheol-jong's accomplice and a broker in the gambling ring, a major match is finally set in motion. With the addition of "Toad," who shares a persistent bitter feud with Cheol-jong, a fierce showdown begins…

fields.title: lover
fields.description: The day arrives to send her dementia-stricken husband to a nursing home. Noticing that she is also beginning to show signs of dementia, the elderly woman Hyun-ju decides to commit suicide with him. She drives into a secluded forest intending to quietly face death, but her husband, who has become like a child, refuses to listen, causing Hyun-ju to hesitate as well.

fields.title: day
fields.description: Dr. Jun-young, known as a "saint of war," discovers his daughter Eun-jeong dead at the scene of a massive traffic accident while on his way to a meeting on her birthday. After a brief moment of shock, he opens his eyes to find himself back two hours before his daughter's accident. Despite his best efforts to prevent the accident, the outcome remains unchanged, and he endures a hellish cycle of repeating the day his daughter dies. One day, a man named Min-cheol appears before him, claiming to be reliving the very day he lost his wife in an accident. Trapped in the timeline of the horrific accident without knowing the reason, the two men join forces to change the end of the day, but no matter what they do, they cannot prevent death. As they despair, forced to watch the deaths of their loved ones before their eyes every day, a mysterious man appears claiming to be the killer of Jun-young's daughter. Jun-young and Min-cheol realize that this accident is not a simple one, but hides another secret...

fields.title: Roman Holiday
fields.description: Three men with no money but guts, and no hope but full of friendship—the serious In-han (Im Chang-jung), the carefree Gi-ju (Gong Hyung-jin), and the naive Du-man (Jung Sang-hoon)—plan to hijack a cash transport vehicle with the sole determination to spend money to their heart's content, even if it means failing and dying. They succeed! However, their scent of money is short-lived; chased by the police, they end up hiding in the "Roman Holiday" nightclub. Amidst an unimaginably exhilarating atmosphere, a bizarre hostage situation unfolds between the police and the kidnappers. Will they be able to protect the money and turn their lives around?

fields.title: We, who are in the ABCs of the relationship
fields.description: Mingyu, a penniless documentary director fighting injustice; Hanna, a retired figure skater who dreamed of becoming Kim Yuna; and Juhee, who appears perfect but carries the pain of being adopted. These three young people, whose realities were bleak, meet to find Juhee's biological mother. Amidst a Korean society that seems cruel to these three unrelated youths, they encounter the first excitement of youth striving for their dreams.

fields.title: paper flowers
fields.description: Seong-gil, a funeral director who has spent his life honoring the souls of the deceased by folding paper flowers, starts a new job at a large-scale mutual aid society due to his difficult financial situation and his son Ji-hyeok, who has lost his will to live after becoming immobile in an accident. Then, one day, a mother and daughter named Eun-sook and No-eul move into the house next door and unexpectedly enter Seong-gil and Ji-hyeok's lives. Touched by the bright and uninhibited nature of the mother and daughter, the two men gradually begin to harbor the hope they had long forgotten…

fields.title: High five
fields.description: Taekwondo girl Wanseo, aspiring writer Jisung, Fresh Manager Seonnyeo, FM foreman Yakseon, and unemployed hipster Gidong. These five individuals received heart, lung, kidney, liver, and cornea transplants respectively from a mysterious organ donor. However, along with their healthy bodies came unexpected superpowers as a bonus! Confirming each other's existence through their unique marks, they unite in their resolve to form a team, but with abilities, personalities, and tastes all different, arguments and accidents never cease whenever they gather. Meanwhile, Youngchun, the leader of the New God Cult who received a pancreas transplant and gained special abilities likewise, sets out to find the remaining transplant recipients in order to become the absolute ruler he has dreamed of his entire life…

fields.title: Judge from Hell
fields.description: A refreshing action fantasy about the coexistence of good and evil, in which a demon named Kang Bit-na, possessing a judge's body, meets the humane and passionate detective Han Da-on in a hellish reality, punishes sinners, and is reborn as a true judge.

fields.title: The Fiery Priest 2
fields.description: Priest by day, Bellato by night: Boss of the Angel Gang! The hot-blooded, anger-mongering priest has arrived in Busan! A no-holds-barred joint investigation drama taking on the nation's top drug cartel.

fields.title: Acoustic
fields.description: A bright and cheerful youth music film about young people finding dreams, hope, and love through music! Se-kyung, a singer-songwriter suffering from a rare disease that requires her to eat ramen to survive; Sung-won and Hae-won, a rock band vocalist and drummer who are obsessed with music but are incredibly hungry; Jin-hee, a girl who cherishes a song of memories; and Ji-hoo, who follows her. The song of twenty, which will never come again, begins now.

fields.title: I'm afraid of love
fields.description: Sang-yeol (Im Chang-jung), a home shopping food tasting model who is below average in every aspect—looks, education, and fashion sense—except for his overflowing talent for tasting, is in love with his successful fellow model, So-yeon (Kim Gyuri). However, in the eyes of So-yeon, who is flawless in every way—looks and looks—Sang-yeol is nothing more than an easy target. Late at night, while it is raining, So-yeon calls out the approachable Sang-yeol to confide her unspoken worries. After drinking soju with So-yeon until dawn, Sang-yeol wakes up the next day naked in a hotel room, not knowing why. He rejoices at the thought that he spent a sweet night with the So-yeon of his dreams. But So-yeon drops a bombshell on him… The woman he longed for has crumbled overnight! Why on earth?

fields.title: Doctor
fields.description: Everything was beautiful. Until that happened. Choi In-beom (Kim Chang-wan), a top authority in plastic surgery, had it all, including a young and beautiful wife. One day, when everything was perfect with his wife, Sun-jung (Bae So-eun), he witnesses her unbelievably fatal infidelity. Unleashing his thoroughly hidden instincts, he begins to plan an elaborate and beautiful revenge against those around him, unlike anything seen before… June, beware of the psychopathic plastic surgeon!

fields.title: twenty
fields.description: From a wildly popular slacker aspiring to a life of doing nothing, to a hardworking college re-taker tirelessly preparing to become a cartoonist, and a freshman college student with top-tier credentials aiming for a major corporation but who transforms completely the moment he drinks—a dazzling comedy about three 20-year-old friends who shared the most embarrassing moments of their lives together!

fields.title: Fabricated City
fields.description: Kwon Yu is a perfect leader in the gaming world, but an ordinary unemployed man in reality. While at a PC bang, he accidentally receives a call from a stranger asking him to find her lost phone, and subsequently, without knowing why, he is framed as the killer who brutally murdered her. All the evidence seems to be fabricated to point to Kwon Yu as the culprit, and with no one believing in his innocence, Yeo-ul, a novice hacker and member of Kwon Yu's gaming group, discovers that the entire incident was perfectly manipulated by someone for just 3 minutes and 16 seconds. Along with special effects specialist Demolition, all the gaming members gather to track down the truth of the case using their own unique methods, launching a thrilling counterattack against the manipulated world...

fields.title: Testimony
fields.description: Park Deok-jun, an elderly man living alone, is unable to sleep every night due to memories of the past. For him, who makes a living by performing contract torture at a closed bathhouse through a broker named Kang Il-hyun, even holding onto faith and praying is not an easy task. Park Deok-jun is shocked when he sees the church bulletin given to him by Elder Lee, his only confidant, who invited him to a testimony meeting. The protagonist of the testimony is Im Gwang-han, his superior who was a torture police officer in the 1980s. Reunited with Im Gwang-han, Park Deok-jun falls into despair as he reflects on the tragedy of the past. Just then, an unexpected event occurs, prompting Park Deok-jun to restart his question-and-answer session to uncover the truth.

fields.title: Hitman
fields.description: Jun, a legendary assassin and former member of the secret Project Kite Shield, escapes the National Intelligence Service to become a webtoon artist. However, in reality, every work he serializes receives nothing but record-breaking hate comments. After drunkenly drawing top-secret information he shouldn't have, his webtoon unexpectedly becomes a massive hit overnight, but this makes Jun a double target for both the NIS and terrorists...

fields.title: virus
fields.description: Taek-seon is a translator living a life completely drained of energy, motivation, and even romantic feelings. The day after a chaotic blind date with Su-pil, a researcher who has never dated before and even proposed on their first meeting, the world suddenly turns pink. He finds himself smiling for no reason, his eyes are drawn to glamorous dresses he never even glanced at before, and even the work-related group texts from his classmate Yeon-woo, which ring every day, seem simply adorable. However, upon receiving news that he has been infected with the Toxovirus, which has a 100% fatality rate, and meeting Lee Gyun, the only researcher capable of creating a cure, Taek-seon discovers that all these changes are merely symptoms of the virus and embarks on an unexpected journey...

fields.title: She died
fields.description: Gu Jeong-tae is a real estate agent with a hobby of entering homes entrusted by clients to spy on their lives. He becomes intrigued by Han So-ra, an SNS influencer who posts photos of vegan salads while eating convenience store sausages, and begins to observe her. Eventually, Gu Jeong-tae starts frequenting Han So-ra's home, only to discover her slumped dead on the sofa one day. Afterward, someone who knows he entered her home begins blackmailing him, and the net of investigation by Detective Oh Young-ju of the Homicide Unit, who is in charge of the case, closes in on him. Forced to find the culprit himself, Gu Jeong-tae sets out to locate the true killer by scouring the people around Han So-ra through her social media…

fields.title: Morning Comes to the Mental Ward Too
fields.description: Jeong Da-eun is a new nurse at the Department of Psychiatry. No matter how difficult things get, she does her best to be like the warm morning sun to her patients.

fields.title: Family planning
fields.description: A story about a mother with the special ability to edit memories at will who teams up with her family to bring hell to the villains.

fields.title: hunting dogs
fields.description: A Netflix series depicting the story of two young men caught up in the world of loan sharking, where money comes before human life, who risk their lives fighting against a massive force of evil. It tells the story of Gun-woo and Woo-jin, who are confident in their fists, as they team up with President Choi, a retired legend of the loan shark industry, to confront Myung-gil, a notorious illegal loan shark who reigns above the law.

fields.title: The King's Wrath
fields.description: In the first year of King Jeongjo's reign, plagued by ceaseless assassination threats, Jeongjo is unable to sleep even at night. Sang-chaek, his most trusted minister, guards his side like a shadow day and night. As dawn breaks, Jeongjo heads to the Grand Dowager Queen's quarters to pay his morning respects to his grandmother, Queen Jeongsun. Hong Guk-yeong, the commander of the Geumwiyeong responsible for the King's protection, and Sang-chaek follow behind him. Queen Jeongsun, the supreme leader of the Noron faction, subtly reveals her ambition and warns Jeongjo. At Jeongjo's quarters, Jonhyeonggak, Wol-hye, a court lady from the laundry room, visits to collect clothes, while Jeongjo's mother, Lady Hyegyeong, arrives to express concern for her son's safety, stating that she had a bad dream last night. Meanwhile, outside the palace, the most skilled assassin in Joseon receives a commission from Gwang-baek to decapitate the King tonight…

fields.title: Conditions of a Story: Thriller Edition
calamari
fields.description: Mother Seon-ju, daughter Hye-ji, and son Geun-cheol are on their way to the sea. Suddenly, they run out of gas and the car stops. It is the worst day ever, and the frustrated family fights, blaming each other. Why?

fields.title: Slowly and intensely
fields.description: Even in an era of barbarism and violence, some people dreamed. The Korean entertainment industry of the 1960s through the 1980s—people who staked their entire lives on the race for success. The stories of those who endured the world, swallowed their tears, and shone brilliantly unfold.

fields.title: vaporization
fields.description: Heeyong, an immature father who has never once fulfilled the role of a father in his life, suggests to his hometown senior, Seungcheol, that they go meet his son, Gihwa, who is being released from prison. The two men meet Gihwa, who has been released after four years. However, Gihwa turns away from his father, and Heeyong finds himself just as awkward with his son. Seungcheol finds himself in a difficult position caught between the two. The three men climb into a dilapidated, cramped car and embark on an unexpected journey...

fields.title: victims
fields.description: "I prayed every day... begging to be let die!" Ga-in returns to her hometown upon hearing the news that her father is critically ill. However, to Ga-in, her father is merely a painful wound, devoid of any deep affection for her as a family member. The next day, she meets a man at the locksmith shop her father used to run. He is Do-kyung, who has returned to his hometown to practice metalwork. He explains that he, too, came down here after his father passed away and has been living quietly. Driven by a strange curiosity, Ga-in visits his workshop and receives a small bracelet as a gift from Do-kyung. Then, one day on a deserted road, she hears a woman's faint scream. As she approaches, she is attacked and loses consciousness. Time passes, and she finds herself in a basement illuminated only by a dim incandescent light. When Ga-in regains consciousness, she finds her arms handcuffed and her mouth taped shut. Left alone and trembling in fear, a man approaches her. It is none other than Do-kyung. Who led them to this place? What will become of their fate?

fields.title: Happy Housing
fields.description: Living in an old inn because we have no security deposit, we need to find a place to live. I intend to apply for Happy Housing, but I feel nothing but sorrow at my situation, where I must prove my misfortune just to find a room to lay my head in.

fields.title: Creepy Romance
fields.description: Yeo-ri (Son Ye-jin), a woman who has never been able to lead a normal life or even have a proper relationship due to her extraordinary intuition, and Jo-gu (Lee Min-ki), a frail but feisty horror magician who falls for her. What should have been a sweet encounter turns into a daily horror special due to ghosts interfering with their happiness. Unlike Yeo-ri, who is used to this lifestyle, Jo-gu feels his life is in danger every time. Despite the chilling obstacles, Yeo-ri and Jo-gu refuse to give up on this relationship, so they grit their teeth and embark on a life-or-death romance...

fields.title: 4th place
fields.description: Junho is a swimmer with prodigious talent who can never finish higher than fourth place in any competition. However, pressured by his mother, who cannot let go of her obsession with winning first place, he meets a new swimming coach, Gwangsu. With a nonchalant expression, Gwangsu confidently promises not only that Junho will win first place but also that he will be able to choose which university to attend, going so far as to ban his mother from the swimming pool during the training period...

fields.title: The sky is blue again today.
idol
fields.description: Provincial Assemblyman Gu Myeong-hoe, who is garnering fervent public support for his incorruptible morality and being considered a leading candidate for the next governor, discovers one day that his son caused a traffic accident and covered it up. Prioritizing his respected political career above all else, he forces his son to turn himself in. Yoo Jung-sik, for whom his son is his entire world, would do anything for his intellectually disabled son, Bu-nam. He falls into despair when his son, his everything, suddenly returns as a cold corpse after a traffic accident. Unable to understand his son's whereabouts on the day of the accident, he seeks help from the police to find his daughter-in-law, Choi Ryeon-hwa, who vanished without a trace after being with him, but no one listens to him. To uncover the secrets lurking behind his son's death, Jung-sik begins to investigate the accident alone. Meanwhile, Choi Ryeon-hwa is the only one who knows the truth about the accident that night. Having vanished like smoke after being with Bu-nam, she harbors a hidden truth that no one knows—and must never know…

fields.title: The Outlaws 4
fields.description: Three years after a new type of drug case, "Monster Detective" Ma Seok-do and the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency are investigating a drug trafficking case involving a delivery app when they discover that the death of a wanted app developer in the Philippines is linked to a large-scale illegal online gambling organization. The villains include Baek Chang-ki, a former special forces mercenary based in the Philippines who has seized control of South Korea's illegal online gambling market through kidnapping, confinement, assault, and murder, and Jang Dong-cheol, a genius IT CEO plotting an even bigger scheme in Korea. To take control of this larger operation, Ma Seok-do proposes an unexpected collaboration to Jang Yi-su, and with the Metropolitan Police Agency and even the Cyber Investigation Unit joining forces, they begin to eradicate the crime…

fields.title: Hello Ghost
fields.description: Sang-man (Cha Tae-hyun), a lonely man whose greatest wish is to die. One day, he begins to see ghosts. A perverted ghost, a chain-smoking ghost, a crybaby ghost, and a childish ghost cling to him like leeches. Unable to even die because of these ghosts who demand their wishes, Sang-man eventually finds himself fulfilling their desires only to encounter the greatest unexpected moments of his life…

fields.title: Hero
fields.description: The story is set in the fictional city of 'Muyoung City' in a near-future South Korea that has gone bankrupt due to the Great Depression. The plot follows Heuk-cheol (Yang Dong-geun), the son of Muyoung City Mayor Kim Hoon (Son Byung-ho), who gains super-regenerative abilities after being shot and receiving a nano-injection for treatment, eventually becoming a hero. However, with his father and older brother Myeong-cheol (Choi Cheol-ho) acting as the masterminds, his path ahead appears to be arduous. Although IT technology has advanced enough to enable mobile voting via smartphone pupil recognition for identity verification, the city has designated a "special slum" due to the impact of the bankruptcy. Naturally, residents of this slum lack the economic means to purchase smartphones capable of pupil recognition, so voting takes place in an old-fashioned manner (i.e., the way we currently conduct voting). In the South Korea depicted in the drama, perhaps due to a constitutional amendment for decentralization, the mayor possesses greater authority and power than a real-life mayor, even taking the initiative to restructure the police force.

fields.title: Mina Stationery Store
fields.description: Kang Mina, a successful civil servant, changes careers to become a stationery store owner! Kang Mina was living a comfortable life as a district office employee, a job others envied. However, when her father suddenly collapses, she is forced to take over "Mina Stationery Store," which he used to run. Taking this opportunity, Mina plans to sell the entire store she has hated since childhood, but the resistance from her elementary school regulars, who frequent the shop as if it were their own home, is formidable! No elementary school regulars allowed! Selling this troublesome stationery store all off!

fields.title: Wedding Eve
fields.description: Former baseball player Tae-gyu and urologist Ju-young reunite after a breakup. A week before their wedding, they discover each other's shocking pasts. Star chef Won-cheol and nail artist So-mi, in their seventh year of dating. The reason we're getting married? Because we've been together for a long time! Gun-ho, a pure-hearted bachelor running a flower shop, and Vika, a stunning beauty from Ukraine. What stands in the way of their love, which transcends borders and age? Unusual symptoms appearing in Gun-ho's body. Ira, a daddy's girl, and Dae-bok, a mama's boy, are progressing at LTE speed from meeting to marriage. However, marriage is reality! From wedding preparations and honeymoons to religion and family issues, they are completely different! So-mi, who joined a women's club group tour due to a travel agency mistake, bickers with Gyeong-su, a Jeju Island tour guide. A week before their wedding, they are drawn to a fated love! Will they be able to overcome their marriage blues and successfully tie the knot?

fields.title: Hell Money
fields.description: From high school bullies to diss rappers, Jagalchi grandma, foul-mouthed police officers, and subway foul-mouthed women, masters of profanity from all over the country have gathered in one place for a profanity battle to determine the legend. Amidst this, ‘Hell Money’—an extraordinary owner of the teeth(?) who has infused the flavors of life into her curses—is coming! She is the grandma from hell who will relieve this stifling world with her profanity!

fields.title: Fashion King
fields.description: Woo Ki-myung, a bread shuttle with no job he wants to do or dream of becoming. After transferring to a school in Seoul, he ambitiously tries to make a fresh start, but the only person who acknowledges his insignificant existence is Eun-jin, the top student who has abandoned her beauty, and the puffer jacket he bought just because it was trendy turns out to be nothing but a knock-off.

fields.title: boy
fields.description: Sejun, living with a father obsessed with stocks, a sick mother, and an older brother busy earning money, has become indifferent to everything. He simply spends his days hanging out with his friend Jinyoung, pretending that nothing is wrong. Despite their completely different family backgrounds and personalities, Sejun and Jinyoung unknowingly look out for and rely on each other; however, Sejun is actually secretly in love with Jinyoung's girlfriend, Sukyeong. When Sukyeong accidentally discovers Sejun's hidden feelings, the two begin to drift apart from Jinyoung…

fields.title: Grandma Gyechun
fields.description: Gye-chun, a female diver who miraculously found her granddaughter Hye-ji after 12 years, adjusts to living together with her in their Jeju home, just the two of them, as they used to. However, unlike Gye-chun, whose mind is filled with thoughts of her granddaughter from morning till night, the grown-up Hye-ji remains completely inscrutable. As the villagers grow suspicious of the somewhat dubious Hye-ji, she disappears after going to Seoul for an art competition. What is the real reason Hye-ji returned to find her grandmother after 12 years? What happened to Hye-ji during the time she was separated from her grandmother?

fields.title: Youth Police
fields.description: Ki-jun, an enthusiastic police academy student, and Hee-yeol, a theoretical master. These two best friends go out on leave and accidentally witness a kidnapping. They are the only witnesses. Just as they learned in school, Ki-jun and Hee-yeol report the incident to the police without delay. However, due to complicated procedures and insufficient evidence, the investigation shows no signs of progressing! With every second counting and precious time slipping away, Ki-jun and Hee-yeol decide to take matters into their own hands and investigate, facing unpredictable situations along the way…

fields.title: Set plays
fields.description: Seong-cheol, a high school student who grew up neglected in an underprivileged family. To make money in the cold society that abandoned him, he teams up with Ki-jun, who is two years younger than him, and exploits their status as minors to aim for a big score. With a father who left home, a sick older brother, and a mother whose life's purpose has become caring for him, Seong-cheol, abandoned even in this hellish reality, begins a desperate struggle for survival in his own way...

fields.title: gentile
fields.description: Kim (Ahn Sung-ki), a Korean man, lives alone in Warsaw, Poland, working as a Taekwondo instructor. Although his wife and daughter live in Berlin, only six hours away by train, he has been wandering Europe for ten years and hesitates to even send a birthday letter to his daughter. Then, one day, he returns the bag of a woman named Yola (Eva Gavriluk) who had been pickpocketed, and this incident brings the two closer. Another special encounter occurs with a delinquent youth named Michał (Paavoło Brüczyk), and the two become significant parts of Kim's daily life. Through Yola, Kim rediscovers the feelings of love he had forgotten, and watching the always restless and chaotic Michał, he reflects on his own anxious days of youth...

fields.title: Dustman
fields.description: Seoul Station, where dust alarms sound frequently. Taesan, who lives a homeless life based here, looks different from other homeless people at first glance. He lives like a family with Mr. Kim and Dojun in underpasses and empty shops. One day, Taesan meets Moa, a female art student, and together they paint on dust-covered cars. The "Dust Art" created by Taesan and Moa becomes widely known through social media. Through wrist scars that appear to be from a suicide attempt and intermittent images, we learn that Taesan suffered a great trauma in the past and has yet to overcome it. However, through the dust paintings he created by chance, Taesan begins to affirm life and starts to break free from his trauma.

fields.title: Why is Mom's kimchi stew delicious?
evaporation
fields.description: Park Jin-wook, the former Minister of the Central Intelligence Agency who was abducted in the United States for anti-state activities and writing a memoir, returns to Korea in a container. Upon receiving this report, Lee Sang-gyu is ordered by President Han Seong-tae to persuade Park Jin-wook within 48 hours and demands that he stop writing the memoir. However, Park Jin-wook refuses and reminisces about 18 years ago. Han Seong-tae, who launched a revolution under the pretext of reforming corrupt politics, was inaugurated as president as those around him competed to show their loyalty. However, as large-scale protests opposing this followed, the President ordered the identification of the organization behind it. Recalling the subsequent torture, the passage of irregular reform bills, the shifting of blame onto Park Jin-wook, and his assassination, he resolves to publish a book as an apology for being the culprit behind a distorted history.

fields.title: act
fields.description: Pretending not to know about her husband Dong-hyuk's affair with her young student Yeon-mi, she brings Yeon-mi into their home… … But what is Ju-hee’s hidden true intention? A dangerous cohabitation begins between me, my husband, and his mistress!

fields.title: ghost
fields.description: A cyber crime drama featuring the exploits of cyber investigators, containing a warning about the impact of the networked world, such as the internet and social media.

fields.title: The day Min-woo comes
fields.description: Yeon-hee waits anxiously for her lover, Min-woo, to return, just as she does today. One day, visitors come to see her and tell her to get ready, as they are scheduled to depart for Pyongyang tomorrow. They tell her that he is alive. With no idea why he hasn't returned home, Yeon-hee boards the bus to Pyongyang with a trembling heart…

fields.title: Special citizens
fields.description: Byun Jong-gu is a hard-working Mayor of Seoul who loves only the city. However, in reality, he is a political mastermind who aspires to supreme power more than any other politician and is meticulous about image management. Partnering with Shim Hyuk-soo, the undisputed master of election scheming and head of his campaign headquarters, and newly recruiting Park Kyung, a young advertising expert who fearlessly jumped into the election arena, Byun Jong-gu aims for the next presidency and challenges for an unprecedented third term as Mayor of Seoul in constitutional history. However, as fierce attacks from opposing candidates and unexpected incidents occur, Byun Jong-gu’s campaign for a third term faces repeated crises...

fields.title: Cheese in the Trap
fields.description: A cold demeanor hidden behind a gentle smile. The senior I wanted to avoid, Yoo-jung (Park Hae-jin), suddenly approached me and started talking. Eating together, doing assignments together, even watching movies under the pretext of group work... Has he changed? Or does he have ulterior motives? Or does he really... love me? I’ve fallen into the sweet trap of a perfect yet dangerous senior!

fields.title: pawn
fields.description: Incheon, 1993. Duseok and Jongbae, rough and gritty loan sharks, go to collect a debt but unexpectedly end up taking 9-year-old Seung-yi as collateral. Unaware of the implications, Seung-yi becomes collateral, and due to her mother's circumstances, Duseok and Jongbae find themselves responsible for the child's adoption. However, when they discover that Seung-yi, whom they believed had gone to a wealthy family, is actually in a completely different place, the two men bring her back to care for her. Duseok and Jongbae, whose lives are held hostage by a child who arrived without warning. Seung-yi, entrusted to these men as collateral due to debt. Before long, the three of them—Duseok, Jongbae, and Seung-yi—become special to one another...

fields.title: Adults don't know
fields.description: 18-year-old Sejin suddenly finds herself pregnant. Exhausted by irresponsible adults, Sejin wanders the streets and meets Juyoung, a peer with four years of experience running away from home. Sejin and Juyoung become best friends despite meeting for the first time, and with the appearance of blue-haired Jaepil and Shinji at a moment of crisis, these four people who seem somehow alike come together to begin Sejin's miscarriage project.

fields.title: The Pied Piper on the Straight Line
The day I fell into the hole
I will begin my defense.
fields.description: A chaotic story that begins when the male and female protagonists, who left each other with the impression of being a "big law firm's dog" and a "lunatic" after clashing once over a corporate whistleblowing lawsuit, become public defenders and share an office.

fields.title: The Virus
fields.description: Just 3 days from infection to death! The desperate struggle of the 'Special Infectious Disease Crisis Response Team' to save humanity from the fastest mass infection in history. Korea's first virus chase thriller.

fields.title: Life-or-death romance
fields.description: Han Je-in is a mystery novelist known as the "Itaewon Nuisance" among both the police and her neighbors because she suspects everyone in the area of being a murderer. Having spent five years structuring her next work and facing the possibility of her publisher giving up on her, she decides to write a new novel inspired by the Itaewon serial murder case. One day, using her extraordinary intuition, she detects clues of a murder upstairs, but the police refuse to believe her. Determined to catch the killer herself and restore her reputation as a bestselling author, Je-in embarks on a full-scale pursuit of the culprit with the full support of her childhood friend Seol Rok-hwan, a police officer at the Itaewon Precinct, and the assistance of Jason, a mysterious and charming man who is a fan of hers and possesses sharp deductive skills…

fields.title: hunt
fields.description: In a remote mountain in Mujin where a massive coal mine collapse occurred, a huge gold vein is discovered in a place no one visits due to rumors of strange sightings. Dong-geun, having secretly obtained information about the discovery, leads a group of suspicious hunters up the mountain. His joy at this life-changing opportunity is short-lived when the elderly landowner blocks their path, and after a struggle, she falls off a cliff. Meanwhile, Ki-seong, the sole survivor of the mine collapse, spots suspicious men in the mountain—which was supposedly inaccessible due to a landslide—and chases them, only to witness something he should never have seen. At this moment, Yang-soon, the daughter of a colleague lost in the accident, also accidentally enters the mountain and joins the chase. Between the group of hunters vying for the gold and the hunter who must protect what is precious, a life-or-death 16-hour pursuit begins in the inescapable mountains!

fields.title: The history of our relationship
fields.description: Yeon-i, an actress dreaming of a spectacular comeback, and Seon-jae, a perpetually struggling assistant director aspiring to be a film director, put an end to their brief romance. However, maintaining their relationship as mature colleagues (?) and good friends (?), they earn the title of the "Chungmuro Cool Couple" and embark on a joint screenplay project. Just as the opportunity arises for their collaborative script to be made into a film, an unexpected major crisis strikes their relationship… Will the relationship between Yeon-i and Seon-jae—who broke up but couldn't truly let go—reach a happy ending?

fields.title: Lucid Dream
fields.description: Dae-ho, a journalist specializing in corporate corruption, uses lucid dreaming to delve into his past memories and track down clues about the culprit in order to find his son, who was kidnapped three years ago. A man with a tattoo on his right arm, a suspicious man taking photos, and even a mysterious figure appearing in every dream! With the help of veteran detective Bang-seop and his friend, psychiatrist So-hyun, Dae-ho finally comes face-to-face with the man pointed to by all the clues...

fields.title: sleep
fields.description: Hyun-soo and Su-jin are a happy newlywed couple. One day, Hyun-soo, sleeping beside her, mutters strange things. From that day on, Hyun-soo transforms into a completely different person whenever he falls asleep. Unable to remember anything upon waking, Hyun-soo feels a fear that he might harm his family while asleep, while Su-jin cannot sleep due to the terrible terror that begins the moment she falls asleep every day. Despite receiving treatment, Hyun-soo's abnormal behavior during sleep becomes increasingly dangerous, and Su-jin tries everything she can to prevent it, fearing that even her unborn child might be in danger…

fields.title: Sheriff
fields.description: Dae-ho, a former detective fired for excessive investigation and returned to his hometown, acts as a self-proclaimed sheriff, safeguarding the peace of Gijang with his boundless meddling. Just as Jong-jin, a successful businessman, arrives from Seoul to build a beach town in this peaceful neighborhood, drugs begin circulating in nearby Haeundae. Suspicious of Jong-jin’s every move, Dae-ho suspects him of being a drug trafficker and, relying on his detective instincts, sets out on a "solo investigation" with his brother-in-law, Deok-man, as his assistant. However, public sentiment has long since shifted toward Jong-jin—who is wealthy, sophisticated, and possesses the humility to regard him as a benefactor despite Dae-ho’s attacks. Dae-ho finds himself increasingly left high and dry…

fields.title: dot..
fields.description: The father and son have identical Mongolian spots on their buttocks. The son believes that he must remove his father's spot for his own to disappear, so he scrubs his father's spot with an exfoliating towel. However, the son cannot easily erase his father's traces.

fields.title: Golden Slumber
fields.description: Gun-woo is a kind and diligent delivery driver. Having recently gained fame after being named a model citizen, he receives a call from his high school friend, Mu-yeol. Their joy at reuniting after so long is short-lived, however, as a leading presidential candidate is assassinated in a bombing right before their eyes. To a bewildered Gun-woo, Mu-yeol reveals that everything was planned; the organization's scheme is to frame Gun-woo as the assassin and have him self-destruct on the spot. Gun-woo barely manages to escape the scene but is instantly branded the assassin and placed on the wanted list. With CCTV footage, fingerprints, and witnesses completely fabricated, Gun-woo tracks down Mr. Min—a former agent and the figure on Mu-yeol's business card—and through him, begins to uncover the truth behind the incident. Gun-woo fights desperately to survive and clear his name. However, the more he flees, the more his old friends—Dong-gyu, Geum-cheol, and Seon-yeong—are put in danger…

fields.title: Out-of-body experience
fields.description: A man wakes up at the scene of a traffic accident. Reflected in the mirror are unfamiliar faces and names, yet he cannot remember who he is. Shortly after, he wakes up in another person's body. Realizing that his body switches every 12 hours, he begins searching for the connections between the people surrounding him. Intuitively sensing that he is the very person everyone is frantically chasing, the man begins a desperate struggle to find himself…

fields.title: honest candidate
fields.description: A bolt from the blue strikes Joo Sang-sook, a lawmaker who appears before the public as an unrivaled and trustworthy representative of the common people, but in reality considers the working class her own laborers and views lying as a necessity, not an option, for her fourth term—a figure for whom lying is the easiest thing to do. One day, just before the election, she suddenly finds herself possessing a mouth of truth that renders her incapable of telling even a single lie. With the loss of her greatest weapon—lies—her life is shaken to its very core…

fields.title: The day I died
fields.description: On a stormy night, a girl disappears from the edge of a cliff on a remote island, leaving behind nothing but a suicide note. Detective Hyun-su, about to return to duty after a long hiatus, heads to the site to rule the disappearance of the girl—a key witness in a criminal case—as a suicide. As he traces her whereabouts by meeting the former detective who was in charge of her protection, her estranged family, and Mrs. Suncheon, a villager who last saw her, Hyun-su is heartbroken by the pain the girl must have endured alone. As the investigation progresses, Hyun-su becomes increasingly engrossed in the girl, who bears a striking resemblance to himself, and finds himself one step closer to the truth hidden behind the case…

fields.title: Mathematician in Wonderland
fields.description: Lee Hak-seong is a genius mathematician who defected from North Korea yearning for academic freedom. Hiding his identity and backstory, he works as a security guard at a private high school attended by the top 1% of gifted students. With his cold and stoic demeanor, Lee Hak-seong is the number one person students avoid. One day, he meets Han Ji-woo, a high school student who had given up on math and begs him to teach her after she discovers his true identity. As he teaches Han Ji-woo, who was wandering in a world that only seeks the correct answer, how to find the proper solution process, Lee Hak-seong also experiences an unexpected turning point in his own life.

fields.title: Anchor
fields.description: Five minutes before a live broadcast, Sera, the station's star anchor, receives a tip-off predicting her own death. Sera cannot hide her uneasy feeling, as she cannot simply dismiss it as a prank. Convinced by her mother So-jeong that this is an opportunity to become a real anchor, Sera heads to the informant's house and witnesses the bodies of the informant, Mi-so, and her daughter. From that day on, the image of the dead Mi-so begins to recurring before Sera's eyes. As she encounters In-ho, a psychiatrist who was Mi-so's attending physician, at the crime scene, Sera's suspicions toward him also deepen…

fields.title: vacation
fields.description: Yuna is a 37-year-old woman struggling against a heavy reality, barely surviving each dry day. She receives a phone call. It is news from the hospital that her mother is nearing the end of her life. Yuna obtains a monthly leave from her restaurant owner and decides to take a vacation for the first time in ten years. The next morning, Minjae, the owner's son who has long harbored feelings for her, shows up at her boarding house and offers to drive her home. As they get closer to Jeonju, where her mother is, Yuna becomes increasingly anxious and nervous. She asks Minjae to go to a famous restaurant, buy her the prettiest and most expensive coffee, and even suggests stopping by a famous tourist attraction. Minjae finds Yuna's behavior strange, as it is not the behavior of a daughter visiting her mother who is on her deathbed. That night, at the pension where they are staying for the night, Minjae hears from Yuna a story about a past that was, in fact, full of hidden details...

fields.title: It will be somewhat cloudy.
fields.description: In the spring of 2007, the new semester began. However, there is something strange between Garam and Seul. Hyo-eun goes back and forth between them.

fields.title: Double patty
fields.description: You, who used to tear your mouth wide open eating a hamburger; you, who expertly mixed soju and beer with frozen pork belly. Uram, a promising wrestling prospect overflowing with energy like a double patty, and Hyunji, an aspiring anchor. Their magnificent challenge, which gives you strength just by watching them, unfolds.

fields.title: Method: Repetition
fields.description: At the scene of a murder, the suspect is found dead alongside the victim. However, the police are thrown into confusion when it is revealed that the suspect had actually died three months prior. Meanwhile, Im Jin-hee, a reporter tracking the mystery, receives a phone call during a radio appearance from someone claiming to be the true culprit of the murder case and wanting to conduct a live interview. The police and netizens turn their attention to Reporter Im Jin-hee's online broadcast, but the killer appears on the day of the interview and threatens three murders committed by a resurrected corpse…

fields.title: soulmate
fields.description: The film portrays the ups and downs of the relationship experienced by Miso and Haeun, who spent their childhood together, as they grow into adulthood. Their peaceful world begins to crack in subtle ways around their late teens when Haeun starts her first love with her classmate, Jinwoo. As the free-spirited Miso leaves for the city to pursue an adventurous life and Haeun remains in her hometown to build a stable life, the two gradually drift apart. This movie captures the story of Miso and Haeun, two friends who recognized each other from their very first meeting, and Jinwoo, who shared everything from joy and sorrow to excitement and longing.

fields.title: Cabriolet
fields.description: Oh Ji-ah, always smiling, always doing her best in everything, and dreaming of a bright and brilliant future. One day, she unexpectedly receives a diagnosis of thymic cancer. Is it a relief that it is in the early stages? As usual, work is pushed onto her at both work and home. While jogging as usual, her friend Anna visits. Anna, Ji-ah's role model and the CEO of a company, suggests they go on a cross-country road trip in an open-top car tomorrow, but Ji-ah declines due to her piled-up work and surgery schedule. The next day, she is confronted with Anna's funeral portrait. Severely burned out, Ji-ah uses the money intended for her surgery to buy a convertible and sets off on a road trip across the country.

fields.title: Fire woman
fields.description: Sooyeon, a successful actress who even won an acting award, causes a drunk driving accident one day and takes a long hiatus for self-reflection. After her break, she attempts a comeback by publishing an essay, but the world treats her coldly. Plunged into depression, Sooyeon gets into a heated argument with her junior roommate, Gayoung, and binge drinks to relieve stress. Waking up drunk, Sooyeon discovers Gayoung dead, stabbed to death. With no memory of the situation, Sooyeon tries to cover up the truth, but a letter arrives. Realizing that someone is watching her, she risks everything to cover up the truth…

fields.title: Hypnosis
fields.description: Dohyun is an English major dedicated to his studies. He becomes interested in hypnosis by chance through Jinho, a transfer student, and undergoes hypnotherapy under Professor Choi. However, after the hypnosis experience, he begins seeing inexplicable hallucinations of memories, and one by one, his friends also suffer from strange visions before facing a mysterious incident.

fields.title: Time of Hunting
fields.description: In a hopeless city, Jun-seok, released from prison, plans a reckless operation with his family-like friends, Jang-ho, Gi-hun, and Sang-su. Their dreams of a new life are short-lived, however, as a mysterious pursuer appears, putting their very lives in danger. Will these four friends, who mean everything to each other, be able to escape the hunter's hunt?

fields.title: drive
fields.description: A trunk kidnapping thriller depicting the desperate struggle of a popular YouTuber who is abducted by an unknown assailant and must earn 650 million won by live streaming for one hour from the trunk of a moving car.

fields.title: Police station next to the fire station
fields.description: A field log of the joint response between the police catching criminals and the firefighters extinguishing fires. The story of a passionate detective who never fails once he bites, a paramedic who doesn't miss even the smallest wound and soothes the heart, and a firefighter charging into the flames.

fields.title: Cross
fields.description: What if an extreme mission were to suddenly fall upon your married life? A former agent living as a veteran housewife while hiding his past from his wife. He unexpectedly becomes entangled in a dangerous mission, and before he knows it, his wife, a detective, gets dragged into it as well.

fields.title: While waiting for the longitude
fields.description: A romantic comedy about the experiences of former lovers Lee Kyung-do and Seo Ji-woo, who met and fell in love when they were fresh-faced twenty, as they reunite at an unexpected moment in their lives.

fields.title: rod
fields.description: Nestled deep within Cheorwon, Gangwon Province—known for its pristine mountains and clear waters—is the Etiquette Academy. There, you will find Song-yi (Jin Ji-hee), a young teacher who boasts exceptional knowledge and charisma despite her young age. The greatest crisis of Song-yi's 13-year life has arrived: setting right Du-yeol (Ahn Nae-sang), a problematic adult whom society has given up on. Twelve years of waiting... yet the time of parting comes only sooner! In truth, Song-yi is the daughter Du-yeol lost 12 years ago! Keeping this secret, Song-yi clashes with Du-yeol at every turn but refuses to give up, showing him her sincerity. Du-yeol belatedly discovers that Song-yi is his daughter, but the time they have left together is far too short...

fields.title: rest area
fields.description: On Christmas Eve, a homeless family murders an elderly couple and their granddaughter who run a rest stop and begins operating it as their own, posing as the owners. One day, Ji-ho, the daughter of a wealthy family, is on a trip with her parents ahead of her wedding when her parents are murdered by strangers; Ji-ho barely survives but is left paralyzed from the waist down. To help Ji-ho, who is suffering from the aftereffects of the psychological trauma, her fiancé, Kyung-soo (played by Jae-hee), suggests they go on a trip to a secluded place, and Kyung-soo and his group set off on a weekend trip. Late at night, while traveling, they happen to stop at the rest stop run by the homeless family… That night, the ugly truth of humanity is revealed at that rest stop, and a chilling curse of Satan, brought about by human wickedness, begins…

fields.title: On the way back
fields.description: Choi Dong-woo became sexually incapacitated due to lower-body paralysis after sustaining injuries while fighting in the Korean War. He became a novelist and is currently serializing a story in a newspaper based on his own marital relationship. Lying in bed on the second floor, he begins his day listening to the sound of his wife's footsteps as she climbs the stairs every morning carrying a bowl of medicine; he is consumed by a sense of shame for having failed to fulfill his role as a husband during their 14 years of marriage. His wife emphasizes to him that it was her own choice, but her feigned indifference only plunges him into despair. Ji-yeon occasionally travels to the newspaper office in Seoul to deliver manuscripts on behalf of her disabled husband. The time she spends away from home visiting various parts of the city is the only opportunity for Ji-yeon, who lives a life of endurance without satisfying her desires, to escape her shackles, even if only briefly. Reporter Kang, a new recruit at the newspaper, takes a liking to Ji-yeon and approaches her. One day, after missing her train, Ji-yeon goes on a date with Reporter Kang, and Choi Dong-woo learns of this from his younger sister, who happened to witness the scene. However, lacking the courage to leave his wife, he cannot express his feelings directly and instead gradually changes the behavior of the heroine in the novel. As the distance between the couple grows, Reporter Kang proposes that Jiyeon break up with her husband and start over with him.

fields.title: Even if I have to grab them by the collar
fields.description: A noir melodrama depicting the events faced by two people who, having had to survive the present in their own ways in this desperate world tainted by money and violence, end up becoming each other's everything.

fields.title: My Heart Beats
fields.description: Daesu, a promising Taekwondo prospect once known as the "Prince of Missed Kicks," and Mira, a spirited woman who dreamed of becoming an idol. However, having conceived at 17, they find themselves the parents of a 16-year-old son named Areum at the tender age of 33. Suffering from progeria, a congenital condition that causes premature aging, Areum has the physical age of 80. Despite being young and immature parents, Daesu and Mira live a spirited and bright life with Areum. Then, one day, their story becomes known to the world, and heart-fluttering events begin to unfold for Areum, for whom simply growing older day by day had been his entire existence...

fields.title: puppy
fields.description: Min-su is committed to leaving work on time for the sake of his dog Rooney, whom he treats like a younger sibling. Just as he is about to get married, he faces the crisis of an early exit from his life as a dog owner! His cousin Jinguk, whose life itself is in crisis after his ambitiously opened cafe failed, agonizes over Min-su's urgent SOS before suggesting an interview for a new butler. As the two brothers head to Jeju Island in search of the perfect butler, they are met with the unexpected appearance of puppies...

fields.title: Gentleman
fields.description: Ji Hyun-soo, the owner of a private detective agency who handles every case he is commissioned to handle 100% of. While at a pension with a client to search for a dog, he is attacked by an assailant and collapses. His memory is severed, and his client has vanished. When he regains consciousness, he finds himself suddenly framed as a suspect in a kidnapping case. While being helplessly arrested, he gets into a car accident and is mistaken for a prosecutor. To find his missing client, Ji Hyun-soo disguises himself as a prosecutor and begins an investigation. Kim Hwa-jin, the prosecutor's prosecutor, also known as the "Crazy X" of the Internal Affairs Department. Once arrogant and suffering the bitter taste of demotion, he encounters Ji Hyun-soo, who is posing as a prosecutor, while investigating a kidnapping case. He discovers that the case, which he considered a simple kidnapping, is connected to Kwon Do-hoon, the law firm tycoon who had previously thwarted him. Ji Hyun-soo, determined to clear his name, and Kim Hwa-jin, wanting to catch Kwon Do-hoon, join forces for their respective goals. However, as they uncover the heinous crimes of the massive law firm tycoon, they face a completely unexpected situation...

fields.title: intern
fields.description: Sunwoo is a young CEO who has grown the brand WOO22 into a dark horse in the fashion industry, achieving tens of billions of won in sales within just three years of its founding. Now, on a state of passion overload from relentlessly racing toward success, Kiho appears before her as the youngest member of the team—a "silver intern." Although a veteran with 37 years of experience and a mastery of the professional world, Kiho struggles to adapt to the unfamiliar digital work environment and free-spirited culture. However, his characteristic sincerity and warm, humane communication move Sunwoo's heart, and these two individuals, completely different in every way, share perspectives and experiences they lacked in each other, adding unexpected warmth to their ceaseless daily lives…

fields.title: tropical night
fields.description: Min-ki's older brother, Min-hoon, commits suicide after returning from military leave. Min-ki heads to Thailand to find his brother's girlfriend, Jae-hee, in his place. Meanwhile, Jae-hee lives in Pattaya, Thailand, with Tae-kyung, who is not related by blood but is like a brother to her. Min-ki, believing that Jae-hee was responsible for Min-hoon's death, gradually begins to clear up the misunderstanding. Tae-kyung suffers whenever the two grow closer.

fields.title: My Dictator
fields.description: Ahead of the first-ever inter-Korean summit, unknown actor Seong-geun passes the audition to play Kim Il-sung's stand-in for the summit rehearsal. Desperately immersing himself in his first-ever leading role, Seong-geun focuses on everything from his manner of speech to every single gesture. Although the summit ultimately falls through, he remains unable to shake off the role of Kim Il-sung. Twenty years later, his son Tae-sik is on the verge of madness because of his father, Seong-geun, who still believes himself to be Kim Il-sung. Forced to bring his father back to their old home to pay off debts, Tae-sik spends his days in chaos alongside the fake Supreme Leader...

fields.title: Carnival
fields.description: The carnival is an opportunity to release repressed desires and cravings. However, there are those who remain outside, unable to enter the carnival. Since expensive admission fees are required to view the carnival, most people watch through the gaps in the long fences. They merely gaze at the desires (capital) of others. Unable to enter, their bodies and desires linger outside. Their desires fail to become language, instead turning into fragmented syllables and sounds.

fields.title: Madonna
fields.description: Haerim, a nursing assistant, and Hyukgyu, a doctor, are assigned to care for Cheol-oh, a quadriplegic patient in need of a heart transplant. They discover that Cheol-oh's son, Sang-woo, is using every means possible to forcibly prolong his father's life in order to inherit his fortune. One day, Mina, a mysterious accident victim, is rushed in, and Sang-woo, a ruthless second-generation chaebol heir, proposes a dangerous deal to Haerim: find Mina's family and obtain their organ donation consent forms. Facing difficult circumstances, Haerim reluctantly accepts the offer, and as she tracks down the past of Mina, who was nicknamed "Madonna," she confronts shocking secrets…

fields.title: The Open Society and Its Enemies
Miss Wife
fields.description: Lee Yeon-woo is a successful single lawyer with a 100% win rate. Just before her transfer to the New York headquarters, Yeon-woo is involved in a sudden car accident. A suspicious man named Director Lee appears before her as she faces a life-or-death crisis; he proposes that if she lives someone else's life for a month, he will return her to her original life. However, what awaits her after accepting the offer is an overly doting husband and a war-like daily life as a married woman with two children! Yeon-woo falls into a panic over this sudden twist of fate, while her husband, Seong-hwan, and children begin to be bewildered by their wife and mother, who have changed without knowing why…

fields.title: Incheon Landing Operation
fields.description: On June 25, 1950, North Korea launched a surprise invasion, resulting in the fall of Seoul in just three days and the loss of the entire Korean Peninsula—excluding the Nakdong River region—within a month. Against all odds, Supreme Commander of the United Nations Forces Douglas MacArthur planned the Incheon Landing Operation. It was a near-impossible operation; the only thing that could make it possible was securing a path to Incheon. Under MacArthur's orders, Navy Intelligence Captain Jang Hak-su was deployed to the "X-RAY" intelligence operation against North Korea. He infiltrated the North disguised as a soldier to monitor the situation in Incheon and begin gathering intelligence. However, facing the crisis of his identity being exposed by Incheon Defense Commander Lim Gye-jin, Jang Hak-su and his unit members embarked on a perilous mission to guide the Incheon Landing Fleet for a single day's operation, offering a one-time chance to turn the tide of the war...

fields.title: witness
fields.description: In the early hours of the morning, while everyone is asleep, Sang-hoon goes out onto the balcony after hearing a scream and witnesses a murder. Just as he is about to call the police, he makes eye contact with the killer, Tae-ho, who is tapping his fingers to count the floors of his apartment building…

fields.title: Dream
fields.description: It is too early to be eliminated! Homeless athletes are training with fierce effort and dedication to compete in the world championships. The coach has a somewhat eccentric personality, but there is no giving up.

fields.title: I am also a nature lover
Citizen Deok-hee
fields.description: One day, Deok-hui, a man of unrivaled survival skills looking for a loan following a fire at his dry cleaner, receives a call from Assistant Manager Son at his bank, who offers to propose a reasonable loan product. After sending money to Assistant Manager Son, who demanded various fees claiming they were necessary for the loan, Deok-hui is shocked to realize too late that the entire process was a voice phishing scam. Just as Deok-hui is about to lose all his possessions and end up homeless with his children, Assistant Manager Son calls again... this time, begging for help! With the police having given up on the case, Deok-hui flies directly to Qingdao, China, with his colleagues, each equipped with a special skill, driven by the sole determination to rescue Assistant Manager Son and recover his lost money.

fields.title: Paraparamita
fields.description: At the Cosmos Car Wash, there is Noah, a stuttering part-timer who dreams of becoming an actor, and Jose, an eccentric who dreams of becoming a film director. "The Fool and the Loser"—that is what the world calls Noah and Jose. It is unfair! Noah and Jose want to be recognized by this world, by this distorted world; they want to prove themselves! Thus, they create their own film, <Parapalamita!>, based on the multidimensional world, parallel universe theory, and chakra theory.

fields.title: Lee Hee-soo, Class 2
fields.description: A coming-of-age romance depicting the first love and true friendship of Heesu, an ordinary eighteen-year-old boy who seems like he lives next door but harbors a secret he cannot tell anyone.

fields.title: Walkers
fields.description: Middle school girls nearing graduation roam the neighborhood at night. As they move from their own homes to friends' houses, and then to the empty homes of strangers, their one-night adventure turns into a perilous transgression.

fields.title: pupil
fields.description: Seo-jin is a photographer gradually losing his sight due to a genetic disease. One day, he discovers the body of his twin brother, Seo-in, who lost his sight before him but became a successful ceramic artist. While everyone claims it was suicide, Seo-jin instinctively senses that something is wrong. There are mysterious artworks in his brother's studio, and someone who was present at the scene that day. When no one believes his insistence that it wasn't suicide, Seo-jin begins to pursue the truth himself, only to become another target of the killer as his vision fades. Detective Do-hyuk becomes Seo-jin's eyes as he tracks the case alongside him, but the slowly unfolding truth plunges the two into even deeper confusion…

fields.title: I am here
fields.description: Detective Seon-du (Jo Han-sun), who miraculously survived an organ transplant after being stabbed in the lung while apprehending a murderer in the past, returns to the front lines of investigation. While chasing serial killer Gyu-jong (Jung Jin-woon), he discovers through organ transplant coordinator Ah-seung (No Susanna) that Gyu-jong received an organ from the same donor as himself, and that the donor is the very murderer he had arrested in the past… A hot-blooded detective vs. a rampaging killer—the extreme chase begins between two men entangled in a cruel fate!

fields.title: Your dad
fields.description: A father striving hard toward the goal of success as an actor, and a son walking alone while watching his father's retreating figure. A story seeking the answer to the role and meaning of family.

fields.title: homework
